Title: Engineering Manager
Description:
**Job Purpose:**

Lead team of software engineers within the Engineering & E-commerce function. Own the delivery, quality and production reliability of the systems within the assigned domain, such as ordering, menu serving, payments, loyalty, aggregator integration, in-store technology or customer platforms. Turn approved priorities into working, reliable software, delivered on time and at a controlled cost. This enables the company to serve customers and locations across markets and grow digital sales.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the assigned domain end to end - Own the architecture, roadmap execution, quality and production reliability of the domain’s systems and APIs. The scope of the domain will be assigned in writing by the line manager.
* Deliver the approved roadmap predictably - Define scope, estimate, sequence, manage risks and dependencies, and report status and trade-offs early, in line with the department’s software development lifecycle, so that commitments to the business are met.
* Own the system design and architecture of the domain - Propose designs and architecture changes and make technical trade-offs related to performance, resilience, data consistency, security, cost and time to market. Decisions must remain within the architecture principles and engineering standards established by the Director of Engineering & E-commerce and the engineering leadership.
* Own the reliability of the domain systems - Define and meet service-level objectives. Run on-call support, incident response and root-cause analysis. Monitor systems using the reliability tools provided by Platform Engineering and keep systems fast and efficient under peak loads.
* Use AI by default and advocate its use - Use AI for software development and the automation of other tasks, in line with the department’s AI usage standards. Maintain engineering quality through automated testing, code reviews, continuous integration and deployment, secure coding and controlled releases, including feature flags, progressive rollouts and rollback plans.
* Act as custodian of the domain’s spend - Track cloud consumption, licences and contractor time. Identify and remove waste and raise cost risks early with the line manager. Commercial and budget decisions remain with the line manager and must follow company processes.
* Build, lead and grow a team of software engineers - Coach team members, provide regular feedback, manage performance and support career development. Contribute to hiring through the company’s recruitment process. Direct the day-to-day work of external developers, contractors or vendors when assigned to the domain.
* Align with peers and stakeholders before acting - Agree on interfaces, dependencies and priorities with other Engineering Managers, Product, Operations and business teams. Escalate disagreements to the line manager with clear options. Do not make unilateral decisions that change another team’s work, cost or risk.

**Leadership Requirements:**

* Ownership: Takes full accountability for the domain, its production systems and its people.
* Hands-on credibility: Designs systems and understands the code sufficiently to make sound technical decisions and coach engineers.
* AI-first mindset: Uses AI by default and leads the team to do the same.
* Delivery discipline: Plans realistically, commits carefully and keeps commitments.
* Calm under pressure: Leads clearly during incidents and peak periods.
* Decides through alignment: Works across team boundaries through agreement rather than authority.
* Financial responsibility: Treats company money responsibly in every technical decision.
* People development: Develops software engineers and builds a culture of engineering excellence.

**Major Challenges**

* Deliver new features while maintaining production stability.
* Manage dependencies on other teams and vendors that the role does not directly control.
* Reduce technical debt and modernize legacy systems while keeping the systems operational.
* Maintain delivery quality across a team comprising employees and external developers working in different locations.
* Migrate existing systems to the department’s standard programming language, Golang, while continuing ongoing delivery.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field
* Cloud or architecture certification is an advantage

**Experience:**

* Five or more years of software engineering experience, including at least two years managing engineering teams
* Proven experience designing and delivering production-grade, high-availability systems
* Experience with consumer digital platforms within quick-service restaurants, retail, e-commerce, marketplaces or logistics is preferred
* Experience working with external developers, contractor teams or vendor teams is an advantage

**Job-Specific Skills:**

* System design and architecture: Service architecture, API design, data modelling, distributed systems, modern system design and cloud principles
* Programming: Golang is preferred. Java, C#, Node.js or PHP are accepted. Willingness to learn Golang and migrate systems to Golang is required
* Databases and caches: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis or Aerospike
* Messaging and streaming: Kafka and RabbitMQ
* Monitoring and reliability: Logs, metrics, traces, service-level objectives, alerting and incident response
* Performance: Profiling, load testing, latency optimisation and cost optimisation
* AI for engineering: Daily use of AI tools for development and the automation of other tasks
* Engineering quality: Automated testing, code reviews, continuous integration and deployment, and secure coding.

**Generic Skills:**

* Clear communication and the ability to translate engineering details into business impact
* Stakeholder management
* Project management, including planning, estimation, risk management and dependency management
* Coaching and performance management

**Competencies:**

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Ownership and accountability
* Delivery focus
* Collaboration and influence
* Developing people
* Customer focus
* Integrity

**Technical Competencies**

* System Design and Architecture: Advanced
* Backend Engineering: Advanced
* Reliability, Monitoring and Performance: Advanced
* AI-Assisted Engineering: Advanced
* Data Stores and Messaging: Advanced
* Cloud Principles: Intermediate
* Security and Data Privacy: Intermediate

Title: Technical Account Manager - Openshift (Remote, Doha with French)
Location: Doha, DAW, Qatar | Doha, Doha, Qatar
Description:
Red Hat's Technical Services team is looking for an experienced, enterprise-level engineer to join us as a OpenShift Technical Account Manager (TAM).

In this role, you'll work with a small set of key customers to provide hands-on technical and architectural guidance for the Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform.

At Red Hat, customer support includes far more than just “break-fix” solutions. Customers get industry-leading resources that enable their technical environments to run efficiently, so they can focus on growing their businesses.

Technical account management is a premium support offering that builds, maintains, and grows long-lasting customer loyalty between Red Hat and our customers.

You will forge relationships with your customers, develop a deep technical understanding of their Red Hat implementation, share technical best practices and act as point of contact for any major incidents, managing the customer’s expectations and communications through resolution of such incidents.

You will tailor support for each customer's environment, facilitate collaboration with their other vendors and advocate on their behalf. At the same time, you'll work closely with our Engineering, Research and Development, Product Management, and Global Support teams to debug, test, and resolve issues.

The ideal TAM is a team player, enjoys working hard, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, building relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, is able to learn new technologies quickly and uses their time efficiently.

**What you will do:**

  

* Develop relationships with key business and IT stakeholders and become an expert on a customer’s implementation by understanding their top business goals and priorities.
* Perform technical reviews and share knowledge to proactively identify and prevent issues
* Forewarn customers of technology changes or potential disruptions to their service and advice on mitigation strategies.
* Provide advice and guidance to customers about their current and future Red Hat products;
* Troubleshoot technical issues and drive issue escalation with Red Hat and customer teams
* Complete analysis and present periodic reviews of operational performance to customer leadership
* Manage customer use cases and maintain clear and concise case documentation
* Create customer engagement plans and keep the documentation on the customer's environment updated
* Manage and grow customer relationships by delivering attentive, relationship-based support
* Build a sense of trust with customers and serve as their advocate within Red Hat
* Contribute internally to the Red Hat team, share knowledge and best practices with team members, contribute to internal projects and initiatives, and serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and mentor for specific technical or process areas
* Partner closely with Red Hat Engineering, Product Management, and Technical Support teams to debug, test, and resolve issues
* Travel, as necessary, to visit customers and attend events within the region
* Learn new technologies quickly, including topics like container orchestration, container registries, container build strategies, and microservices on container platforms
* Establish and maintain parity with Red Hat cloud technologies strategy
* Engage with Red Hat’s product engineering teams to help develop solution patterns, based on customer engagements, as well as personal experience, that drive platform adoption
* Engage with Red Hat’s field teams, customers, and partners to ensure a positive cloud technology experience and a successful outcome resulting in long-term enterprise success
* Communicate how specific Red Hat cloud solutions and our cloud roadmap align to customer use cases

**What you will bring:**

* **5 years experience in a support, development, engineering, or quality assurance** organisation
* Expertise with enterprise cloud solutions like **Platform-as-a-Service** **(OpenShift by Red Hat), containers, Kubernetes**, **cloud management**, and **IT automation** (Ansible Automation Platform by Red Hat)
* Ability to manage and grow existing enterprise customer relationships by delivering proactive, relationship-based support
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills; ability to convey complex information to customers clearly and concisely
* Competent comprehension of enterprise architecture and strategic business drivers
* Ability to manage multiple issues and projects with an eye for detail
* Direct experience with a variety of hardware vendors
* Good verbal and written communication skills in French

**The following are considered a plus:**

* Experience in system management, cloud or server virtualization
* Bachelor's degree in a technology-related discipline, preferably computer science or engineering
* **Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE)**
* Prior experience in a technical leadership or mentorship role
* Experience with training and presentation delivery

**About Red Hat**

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. Title: Business Development Manager - Saudi National
Description:
**Business Development Manager - Saudi National**  
**Impact a better future**

At **Serco**, we bring together the right people, technology, and partners to deliver innovative solutions that impact a better future.

We have been operating in the Middle East since 1947 and have a profound understanding of the region.

With over 4,500 colleagues here, we support governments across defence, space, transport, emergency services, justice and migration, and other vital public services. Our core capabilities span service design and advisory, customer experience, complex programme management, systems integration, and asset and facilities management, alongside environmental and case management services.

Guided by our unique service model, we work together with clients and partners to achieve long-term visions and tackle some of the world’s most complex challenges.

**Your Opportunity**

The **Business Development Manager** is responsible for delivering new business revenue and converting opportunities in these sectors across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Working under the direction of the Chief Growth Officer, the role drives pipeline development, builds and maintains client relationships and leads the sales effort on assigned opportunities and accounts, supporting Serco's positioning as a trusted, high-quality partner in delivering Vision 2030 priorities.

The role works side by side with the Business Development and Advisory teams, combining personal origination and account management with close collaboration on propositions, bids and the client engagement programme. It targets ministries, government entities, PIF-backed organisations, giga-projects and national energy, defence and space players, converting opportunities into sustainable revenue and operational growth.

**Key Accountabilities**

**Sales Delivery and Revenue Growth**

* Accountable for delivering assigned new business revenue and profit targets across the government, energy, defence and space sectors in the KSA, through personal origination, account growth and pipeline conversion.
* Execute the sector sales plan agreed with the Sales Director, covering government services, ministries, PIF and giga-projects, energy (oil and gas, power and utilities, renewables and energy transition), defence and space.
* Build and maintain a qualified, high-quality pipeline that meets short- and long-term growth ambitions, with accurate pipeline data maintained in MS Dynamics.
* Use market analysis and intelligence, shared with the Business Development and Advisory teams, to identify target clients, emerging trends, competitor activity and whitespace aligned to Vision 2030 priorities.
* Track and report on pipeline, forecast and conversion performance, escalating risks to targets to the Sales Director.

**Client Access and Relationship Development**

* Own relationships with assigned clients at senior level across ministries, government agencies, PIF entities, giga-projects and energy, defence and space organisations, escalating strategic and executive-level engagement to the Sales Director.
* Build and sustain a network of clients, partners and key stakeholders across the target sectors.
* Engage clients early in their decision-making cycle to understand requirements and position Serco's solutions.
* Implement the structured Client Engagement Programme and maintain account plans for assigned major customers, in line with the framework set by the Sales Director.
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients, working with the Advisory team to offer insight that leads to repeat business.

**Commercial Support and Negotiation**

* Lead commercial negotiations on assigned opportunities within delegated authority, escalating major or strategic negotiations to the Sales Director and General Manager – KSA.
* Contribute to the structuring of contracts, partnerships and joint ventures, working with Commercial and Finance colleagues to ensure commercial robustness.
* Maintain awareness of pricing, margin performance, risk allocation and contract terms to support profitable, sustainable growth.
* Balance client needs, delivery credibility and commercial outcomes when closing opportunities.

**Propositions and Joint Working**

* Work alongside the Business Development and Advisory teams to shape government, energy, defence and space propositions, bringing client insight and helping validate market need and competitor positioning.
* Contribute to joint propositions and commercial models, including local partnerships and strategic supplier relationships, that showcase end-to-end solutions.
* Support go-to-market activity, including customer segmentation, sales analytics and the packaging of propositions with marketing experts.
* Work with the Advisory team to create an advisory-to-operations pathway that unlocks downstream implementation and long-term contract opportunities.
* Share client feedback and market insight to strengthen Serco's existing unique selling propositions and inform new products and service offerings.

**Bid Support**

* Work closely with the Bidding team to ensure timely, high-quality submissions for all targeted opportunities.
* Lead the sales input to bids on assigned opportunities, ensuring a persuasive, commercially competitive offering that fully reflects customer requirements.
* Guide assigned bids through Serco's internal governance and approval process, with the support of the Bidding team and the Sales Director.
* Understand local laws, public procurement processes and government buying environments in the KSA.

**Stakeholder Engagement and Representation**

* Advocate for Serco externally and internally at a senior level, representing the Sales Director where required.
* Pitch Serco's capabilities and deliver value propositions against client requirements through high-quality presentations and proposals.
* Represent Serco at industry conferences, trade shows and networking events in KSA.
* Work with colleagues to share operational good practice, exploit synergies and promote cross-selling across sectors and business units.

**Team Contribution, Reporting and Compliance**

* Support and guide junior sales and business development colleagues, and contribute to the development of local talent in line with Saudization and capability-building objectives.
* Act as sales sponsor on assigned accounts, working with Operations to ensure quality, client satisfaction and measurable outcomes.
* Maintain accurate records of sales activity and provide regular updates to the Sales Director and senior management.
* Ensure compliance with local laws, regulations and cultural considerations in KSA, and contribute to Serco-wide corporate governance and good practice.

**Specific Requirements**

* 10 to 15 years of relevant experience and an established network across Saudi government, semi government organisations, PIF companies and major infrastructure operators.
* Demonstrable experience working with government entities, ministries, giga-projects, sovereign-backed organisations and/or PIF-related environments.
* Experience in the energy sector (oil and gas, power and utilities, renewables or energy services), with a network among key energy-sector stakeholders.
* Exposure to the defence and space sectors, including engagement with defence and space entities, programmes and partners.
* Proven track record of originating and closing complex opportunities and delivering significant annual revenue in government services, consulting or related sectors.
* Experience contributing to commercial negotiations, including strategic partnerships, JVs and multi-stakeholder opportunities.
* Bidding and commercial experience on large, complex business opportunities.
* Good understanding of the Saudi business and government landscape, Vision 2030 priorities, and national transformation programmes and investment themes.
* Experience navigating public procurement and relationship-led market development.
* Familiarity with PIF ecosystem dynamics, giga-project stakeholder structures and local partnership models.
* Appreciation of localization, Saudization and in-Kingdom value creation expectations, with high cultural awareness.

**Join Us**

At Serco, we believe there is a place here for everyone. A place where you can bring your authentic self to work every day. Our workplace culture is one that embraces diversity and fosters equity, respect, and belonging for every individual. We are committed to equal employment opportunities and creating an inclusive environment that proudly celebrates the perspectives and backgrounds that each of our employees bring to work every day.

Join Serco and be part of a values-driven organization that invests in the development and well-being of its employees and offers a rewarding and fulfilling career.

Serco is committed to Equal Employment Opportunities and is committed to ensuring the safety of all of its employees through its Zero Harm initiative. Please visit **careers.serco.com** for more information.

Title: Senior Business Dvelopment Manager (WhatsApp, Chatbots)
Description:

**Location:** Saudi Arabia, Riyadh, 100% onsite  
**Salary:** Fixed plus variable (Depending on experience)

**About CEQUENS**

CEQUENS is a leading cloud communication platform in the Middle East and Africa region and is dedicated to simplifying communications and building bridges to allow businesses to communicate with their customers, no matter where they are. The company provides Omni-Channel communication API’s enabling enterprises and developers to communicate with their

Our partner network covers MEA region with international access to messaging hubs worldwide and our clients include major banks, credit cards, digital payments, OTT applications, government authorities, health and education, and other industry verticals.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of selling SaaS/CPaaS solutions, specifically **AI agents, AI-powered chatbots and WhatsApp automation platforms**, to businesses looking to improve sales performance, customer engagement, and customer support.

Alongside direct sales, the successful candidate will be responsible for identifying, recruiting, and managing channel partners who can resell or refer our platform, including digital agencies, system integrators, resellers and technology partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

**New Business Development & Direct Sales**

* Own an deliver an individual new business sales target across the Saudi Arabian market.
* Identify, prospect and win new customers for our AI agent and chatbot platform
* Sell subscription-based software solutions to businesses across relevant sectors.
* Build relationships with senior decision-makers, including CEOs, Commercial Directors, Heads of Sales, Marketing Directors and Customer Experience leaders.
* Understand customer requirements and demonstrate how AI agents and WhatsApp automation can improve sales conversion, customer engagement and support efficiency.
* Personally deliver compelling product demonstrations, showing prospective customers the platform's capabilities and commercial value.
* Manage the complete sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through demonstrations, proposals, negotiation and closing.
* Develop and maintain a healthy sales pipeline, accurately forecasting opportunities and revenue.
* Consistently achieve and exceed monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.

**Partnerships & Channel Development**

* Identify and recruit suitable channel partners across Saudi Arabia
* Build relationships with digital and marketing agencies, system integrators, software resellers and technology partners.
* Develop partner propositions that encourage third parties to refer or resell the platform.
* Onboard, train and enable partners to confidently position, demonstrate and sell the solution.
* Establish partner commercial agreements, referral arrangements and reseller models.
* Actively manage partner relationships, ensuring partners generate qualified opportunities and contribute to revenue growth.
* Develop a scalable partner ecosystem that supports market penetration and long-term recurring revenue.

**Market Development**

* Develop a strong understanding of the Saudi Arabian market for AI-powered customer engagement and conversational commerce.
* Identify target industries and businesses with strong demand for WhatsApp automation, AI sales agents and customer service solutions.
* Monitor competitor offerings, market trends and emerging opportunities.
* Develop effective go-to-market approaches to accelerate customer acquisition.
* Represent the business at relevant industry events, networking opportunities and customer meetings.

  
**Requirements**

We are specifically looking for candidates with experience selling products similar to ours.

The ideal candidate will have:

* **Proven SaaS/CPaaS sales experience:** A strong track record of selling subscription-based software, ideally with recurring monthly or annual revenue models.
* **Relevant product experience:** 4 years plus experience of selling WhatsApp Business, automation platforms, AI agents, AI-powered chatbots or conversational AI software.
* **Quota-carrying experience:** Personally owned and delivered against a new business sales target, with demonstrable success in winning new customers.
* **Product demonstration skills:** Confident delivering their own software demonstrations and presenting product capabilities to prospective customers.
* **Full sales cycle experience:** Comfortable managing opportunities from initial prospecting through to commercial negotiation and closing.
* **Partnership development:** Experience recruiting, onboarding and managing partners who resell or refer software products.
* **Commercial acumen:** Able to articulate the business case, ROI and commercial benefits of AI-powered customer engagement solutions.
* **Relationship-building skills:** Confident engaging with senior business stakeholders and decision-makers.
* **Market knowledge:** Good understanding of the Saudi Arabian business environment and B2B technology sales landscape.

**Particularly Relevant Backgrounds**

* We are interested in candidates who have worked for businesses selling products in areas such as:
* WhatsApp Business API platforms and WhatsApp automation software.
* AI-powered sales agents and customer service agents.
* Conversational AI and chatbot platforms.
* Customer engagement and messaging automation SaaS.
* AI-powered customer experience and contact centre solutions.
* Omnichannel customer communication platforms.

**The Ideal Candidate**

* You are a commercially minded, self-starting sales professional who knows how to sell SaaS products and understands the opportunity in AI-powered customer engagement.
* You are not simply an account manager or relationship builder. You are a proven new business hunter who carries a number, creates opportunities, delivers demonstrations and closes deals.

* You also understand the value of building a partner ecosystem and have experience turning agencies, resellers and technology partners into productive sales channels.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

Title: Director of Business Technology
Description:
Liteline Corporation is a privately held Canadian commercial lighting manufacturer with more than 160 employees, selling across Canada and the United States. We are adding a Director of Business Technology to our leadership team, a senior, hands-on role with ownership of technology across the business.

The role has two halves. The first is the job every growing company needs: keep our technology running, secure and recoverable across roughly 130 computers, Microsoft 365, our server cluster and our network. The second is newer. Our own people, from the three Co-Presidents to staff in Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service, now build software tools with AI assistants. The Director of Business Technology will give that work a professional backbone: version control, permissions, backups and fast recovery.

This is an enabling role as much as a technical one. We want our people to keep building quickly. The person in this position will make sure what they build is safe, recoverable and well looked after, without slowing anyone down.

This is a build role. Liteline’s people are already creating their own tools with AI. We are looking for a leader who can keep the core IT environment solid, put the right platforms and guardrails under home-built software, and teach non-programmers to work safely.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Keep Things Running**

* Own day-to-day IT across the business: computers, email, servers, networking, security and backups.
* Run Microsoft 365, including sign-in, multi-factor authentication (MFA), user access and licensing.
* Look after our on-premises server cluster, storage and network infrastructure.
* Oversee security monitoring and incident response together with our security monitoring partner.
* Maintain tested backups and the ability to restore systems and data quickly.
* Lead the help desk and set the service standards the business is held to.

**Own the Platforms**

* Set up and run, hands-on, the platforms our home-built tools live on.
* Own Liteline’s company GitHub organization, where code is saved with full history, including structure, permissions, single sign-on (SSO) and branch protection.
* Administer hosted databases (Supabase / Postgres), including access control, backups and recovery.
* Manage website and application hosting (Netlify), including deployments, domains and environments.
* Maintain a clear inventory of the tools in use, who owns each one and where it runs.

**Govern and Teach**

* Decide what AI assistants can access and set sensible guardrails for company data and credentials.
* Set light, practical rules that protect the business without getting in the way of the people building.
* Decide which home-built tools are business-critical and what level of protection each one needs.
* Run and rehearse restores so that recovery is proven, not assumed.
* Teach staff who are not programmers to work safely, for example explaining version control to someone in purchasing.
* Run training, enablement and “lunch and learn” sessions across the business.

**Team and Partners**

* Lead two on-site IT staff.
* Manage our outside partners for managed services, security monitoring and backup.
* Own the technology budget, licensing and vendor relationships, and bring forward stronger options as the market moves.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader who is equally comfortable running core IT and building platforms that sit under modern, AI-assisted development.

The successful candidate will understand infrastructure, identity and security, and will also understand how software is built, saved, deployed and recovered. Just as importantly, you will be able to explain those ideas in plain language to people who have never written code and help them adopt habits that last.

**Strong candidates will bring:**

* Hands-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO and branch protection.
* Experience running a Microsoft Power Platform Centre of Excellence, citizen-developer or low-code programme.
* Hands-on experience running Supabase, Postgres, Netlify, Vercel or similar platforms.
* Solid Microsoft 365, identity, MFA, endpoint and security fundamentals.
* A track record of training and enabling non-technical staff, such as “lunch and learn” or enablement programmes.
* Experience building a function or process from scratch at a growing company.
* Clear communication and sound judgment about when rules help and when they get in the way.

There is no single path to this role. You might be:

* An IT lead at a 100-to-500-person manufacturer or distributor who personally ran a Power Platform governance programme, a low-code programme or the company’s GitHub organization.
* A developer or DevOps engineer who moved into an IT management role at a small or mid-sized company.
* A solutions architect or senior consultant at a managed services provider (MSP) serving small and mid-sized businesses, ready to go in-house.
* The “first IT hire” at a startup who set up sign-in, devices and GitHub from scratch, then moved to a mid-sized company.
* Experience in mid-sized manufacturing, distribution or wholesale is helpful but not required.

**REPORTING AND WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**

This position reports to the VP of Operations.

You will work closely with Liteline’s three Co-Presidents, who are technically capable and build their own tools, and with Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service. You will be a partner to the people building, not a gatekeeper.

**LOCATION AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT**

This position is based at Liteline's Richmond Hill head office and is on-site five days per week with regular presence at our distribution facilities.

The successful candidate should expect to be highly engaged with the business and to spend real time understanding how departments and facilities actually operate.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

This is a rare chance to shape how an established Canadian manufacturer builds and runs its technology at a moment when AI is changing who can create software.

Liteline is privately held, decisions are made without layers of approval, and good ideas get backed. Our leaders build with technology themselves and value this work. The Director of Business Technology will define the platforms, guardrails and habits that let the whole company build with confidence.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Liteline offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and life insurance following three months of service, and a group RRSP with partial company match.

**TO APPLY**

Qualified candidates are invited to apply directly through this posting.

*Liteline Corporation is an equal opportunity employer that values the unique skills and experiences of every candidate. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities throughout the recruitment and hiring process. To request accommodation, please contact Human Resources with the position title in the subject line.*

Title: Senior Vice President (Financial Services)
Description:
The Opportunity  
  
Toronto Financial Services is entering its next phase of growth. Artificial intelligence is changing how clients operate, Global Capability Centres are reshaping delivery models, and market disruption is accelerating. Clients increasingly look to CGI for strategic business outcomes.  
  
CGI is investing in a leader who can accelerate growth, strengthen executive relationships, expand consulting-led engagements, and position CGI as a partner for business and technology transformation.  
  
You will bring together CGI’s capabilities—including Business Consulting, Systems Integration, Managed Services, AI-enabled services, reusable IP, and strategic partnerships—to solve clients’ business challenges and build long-term relationships.  
  
As leader of one of CGI Canada’s largest Financial Services businesses, you will have full accountability for growth, profitability, client relationships, delivery excellence, and leadership development. You will grow the business by connecting clients with the full breadth of CGI’s capabilities.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

What you’ll deliver  
  
Accelerate growth  
Grow organically and win new business across Managed Services, Systems Integration, Business Consulting, and IP—in existing client ecosystems and new markets.  
  
Elevate Business Consulting  
Make Business Consulting a primary driver of transformational engagements. Build consulting-led opportunities that create lasting strategic partnerships and deepen CGI’s influence within client organizations.  
  
Drive profitable growth  
Improve profitability through disciplined portfolio management, innovative commercial models, and operational excellence. Expand higher-value, outcome-based engagements and strengthen contribution margins.  
  
Build AI into the business  
Use AI to improve productivity, delivery, and client outcomes. Develop new revenue opportunities through AI-enabled services.  
  
Build a high-performing culture  
Develop a strong leadership bench and attract exceptional talent. Simplify the operating model to support growth without proportional increases in headcount, while fostering energy, collaboration, and belonging.  
  
Create new demand  
Raise CGI’s profile with clients, alliance partners, and the market through measurable client outcomes, strategic relationships, and thought leadership.  
  
Grow through partnerships  
Work with hyperscaler and technology partners, and pursue client co-innovation, to extend CGI’s reach and create new growth opportunities.  
  
Who you’ll work with  

* Report to the BU Leader, Financial Services.
* Lead Vice Presidents and Directors across Consulting, Delivery, and Client Management.
* Partner with enterprise leaders in Business Consulting, IP and AI, HR, Marketing, and Operations.
* Build strategic relationships with alliance partners and industry leaders.
* Engage directly with C-suite executives across the client base.

  
The operating code  

* Own it: Address problems early with accountability and ownership.
* Move at the speed of the opportunity: Make timely decisions and respond to clients’ needs.
* Bring ideas before they’re asked for: Shape the agenda and anticipate opportunities.
* Make AI non-negotiable: Build AI fluency across the leadership team and the business.
* Protect the standard: Maintain quality, delivery excellence, and client trust.
* Say the hard thing early: Lead with transparency and clarity.
* Prove it with numbers: Measure success through outcomes and business impact.
* Make noise about what works: Recognize success and share practices that can benefit the broader business.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

What you’ve done before:  

* Built or scaled a consulting, technology, or managed services business with full P&L accountability, growing revenue and margin together.
* Driven organic growth and new client acquisition across multiple service lines.
* Led executive-level client relationships and secured large, strategic engagements, including opportunities developed before formal procurement.
* Shifted staff augmentation or time-and-materials engagements to outcome-based commercial models.
* Built leadership teams and succession plans, and raised market visibility through analyst relations, media engagement, and industry recognition.
* Led AI adoption across a leadership team and the business.
* Earned a bachelor’s degree or gained equivalent experience. An MBA is an asset.

  
What success looks likeThree years from now:  

* Revenue growth has outpaced the market.
* Business Consulting represents a larger share of the business.
* AI-enabled services generate meaningful revenue.
* Contribution margins have improved.
* Clients engage CGI earlier and more strategically.
* Leaders have advanced into broader enterprise roles.
* Capabilities developed within the sector are being applied across Toronto Financial Services

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  
  
Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  
  
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  
  
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  
  
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.  
  
At CGI, we value the strength that diversity brings and are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. We collaborate with our clients to build more inclusive communities and empower all CGI partners to thrive. As an equal-opportunity employer, being able to perform your best during the recruitment process is important to us. If you require an accommodation, please inform your recruiter.  
  
That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.  
  
To learn more about accessibility at CGI, contact us via email. Please note that this email is strictly for accessibility requests and cannot be used for application status inquiries.  
  
Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

Title: Payroll Operate Services - Director
Description:

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1762459

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

  

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

  

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**The opportunity**

  

Payroll is a business-critical function, and organizations are looking for more efficient, technology-enabled ways to deliver it.

  

We’re looking for a senior payroll or employment tax professional who knows the market, sees where it’s going and wants to turn those insights into growth.

  

As a Director in EY’s Payroll Operate team, you’ll lead significant client relationships and help organizations transform how payroll is managed through EY’s managed payroll services. You’ll oversee complex payroll operations and new client transitions, bring together people, process and technology, and help build scalable solutions that improve the payroll experience.

  

This is an opportunity to combine payroll leadership, client delivery and commercial thinking while helping shape the growth of EY’s Payroll Operate business in Canada and contribute to the global business.

  

This posting does not relate to an existing vacancy. We are actively recruiting for this strategic hire to support the continued growth and development of our business.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Lead managed payroll services for complex client organizations, with accountability for quality, controls and client experience.
* Build strong relationships with senior payroll, HR and finance leaders and provide practical guidance on payroll operations.
* Lead new client implementations and transitions, establishing effective processes, governance and service expectations.
* Oversee end-to-end payroll delivery, including processing, reconciliations, reporting and payments.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate payroll through technology and better ways of working.
* Shape and grow the business by identifying market opportunities and expanding our work with Canadian and multinational organizations.
* Grow client relationships and contribute to new opportunities, proposals and payroll solution design.
* Develop high-performing teams through coaching, collaboration and clear leadership.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Strong knowledge of Canadian payroll and the end-to-end payroll lifecycle.
* Understanding of global payroll and the ability to collaborate with colleagues across regions and countries to support organizations with global operations.
* Deep familiarity with enterprise payroll and HRIS systems (e.g., ADP, Workday, Dayforce), multi-jurisdictional tax laws, and advanced data analytics/Excel proficiency
* Experience leading complex payroll operations, implementations or managed services.
* Ability to build credibility and strong relationships with senior clients.
* A continuous improvement mindset and interest in payroll technology, automation and transformation.
* Strong operational judgment with the ability to manage risk and resolve complex delivery challenges.
* Collaborative leadership style with a focus on developing people and teams.

  

**Qualifications**

* Typically, 10+ years of progressive payroll experience, including significant leadership responsibility.
* A bachelor’s degree in business, accounting, finance, human resources or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Strong knowledge of Canadian payroll requirements, processes, controls and reporting.
* Experience leading payroll teams, complex implementations, client relationships or significant payroll programs.

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have,**

* A PLP, PCP, CPA or other relevant professional designation.
* Experience in managed payroll, outsourced payroll or a shared services environment.
* Experience transitioning payroll operations to a new delivery model or provider.
* Exposure to payroll technology, automation, data analytics or transformation.
* Experience contributing to proposals, solution design or new client opportunities.

  

**What we look for**

  

We’re looking for an experienced payroll leader who knows how to deliver payroll reliably at scale while continually looking for ways to make it better. You combine strong operational judgment with a client mindset and are comfortable leading change, solving complex delivery challenges and building strong teams. You’re also excited by the opportunity to strengthen client relationships and help grow EY’s Payroll Operate business.

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package allows you to decide which benefits are right for you and which ones help you create a solid foundation for your future. Our Total Rewards package includes a discretionary bonus program, a comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage plan, a defined contribution pension plan, a great vacation policy plus firm paid days that allow you to enjoy longer long weekends throughout the year, statutory holidays and paid personal days (based on province of residence), and a range of exciting programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

* *Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry*
* *Learning opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career*
* *The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you*

Title: Gestionnaire, plateformes technologiques d’ingénierie
Description:
**Job Description**
**Et si vous pouviez redéfinir ce qui est possible? Avec nous, vous le pouvez.**
Avec nous, vous le pouvez. Vous recherchez un travail qui a du sens. Des possibilités de croissance. Des occasions de vous dépasser. Des gens qui vous comprennent.
  
  
Nous sommes le foyer de personnes ambitieuses, passionnées et innovantes qui façonnent le monde de demain.
  
  
Grâce à une expertise inégalée en ingénierie, en services-conseils et en sciences, nos équipes à travers le monde unissent leurs forces pour créer des solutions adaptées aux réalités locales.
  
  
Nous ouvrons la voie et générons un impact.
  
  
Nous sommes des visionnaires.
  
  
Nous sommes WSP.
  
  
**L’opportunité**
Prenez les commandes de la stratégie, de la livraison, de la gouvernance et de l’excellence opérationnelle des plateformes technologiques qui soutiennent les applications d’ingénierie de WSP à l’échelle mondiale. Dans ce rôle de leadership, vous contribuerez à créer des environnements sécuritaires, évolutifs, résilients et rentables couvrant notamment l’hébergement d’applications, les plateformes infonuagiques et hébergées par des fournisseurs, l’infrastructure de bureau virtuel (VDI), la gouvernance des données, l’automatisation et les technologies d’ingénierie de nouvelle génération.
  
  
En collaborant avec les équipes Client Delivery Solutions (CDS), Infrastructure, Sécurité, Architecture, Données et IA ainsi qu’avec les équipes d’ingénierie, vous contribuerez à créer les conditions permettant à nos équipes de projets et à nos professionnels de l’ingénierie de donner le meilleur d’eux-mêmes, tout en préparant WSP aux technologies et aux méthodes de travail de demain.
  
  
**Votre impact**

* Façonner la stratégie et les opérations des plateformes d’ingénierie : Définir et gouverner la stratégie technologique des plateformes soutenant les applications d’ingénierie mondiales. Assurer la préparation opérationnelle, la disponibilité, la performance, la résilience et l’évolutivité des environnements technologiques d’ingénierie. Établir les normes de plateforme, les cadres de gouvernance technique et les procédures d’exploitation des services, tout en dirigeant la planification du cycle de vie et les initiatives de modernisation.
* Faire évoluer l’infrastructure de bureau virtuel et les environnements informatiques d’ingénierie : Définir la stratégie et la feuille de route relatives aux environnements VDI et aux solutions informatiques à distance pour l’ingénierie. Collaborer avec les équipes Infrastructure afin d’optimiser la performance, l’expérience utilisateur, l’accélération graphique et les charges de travail d’ingénierie. Définir les normes relatives aux postes de travail d’ingénierie, aux postes infonuagiques et aux modèles de prestation hybrides, tout en évaluant les technologies et les nouvelles approches de déploiement.
* Gouverner la demande, la livraison et les ressources : Superviser l’admission, la priorisation et la réalisation des initiatives technologiques d’ingénierie. Gérer l’affectation des ressources, la planification de la capacité des équipes et les priorités de livraison. Collaborer avec le CDS Front Door, le PMO, l’Architecture et les parties prenantes d’affaires afin d’assurer la bonne exécution des initiatives de plateforme, tout en surveillant la performance de livraison, les risques, les dépendances et la réalisation de la valeur.
* Renforcer la gouvernance des données et la gestion du cycle de vie de l’information : Définir les pratiques de gouvernance et de gestion du cycle de vie des données provenant des applications d’ingénierie. Élaborer des stratégies de conservation, d’archivage, de récupération, de conformité et d’accessibilité à long terme. Gouverner les environnements applicatifs hébergés par des fournisseurs ainsi que ceux hébergés dans l’environnement infonuagique de WSP. Collaborer avec les équipes Gouvernance des données, Sécurité, Juridique et Conformité afin de respecter les normes de l’entreprise et soutenir les stratégies favorisant l’analytique, l’IA et la livraison numérique.
* Accélérer l’innovation et l’adoption de technologies d’avenir : Évaluer les technologies émergentes, les services infonuagiques, les plateformes d’ingénierie alimentées par l’IA et les possibilités d’automatisation. Élaborer des feuilles de route technologiques adaptées à l’évolution des modèles de prestation en ingénierie. Cerner les possibilités d’amélioration de la productivité, de l’évolutivité, de la durabilité et de l’expérience utilisateur, et diriger des preuves de concept, projets pilotes d’innovation et programmes de modernisation technologique.
* Diriger la gouvernance des plateformes et la collaboration interfonctionnelle : Collaborer avec les équipes Infrastructure, Cybersécurité, Architecture d’entreprise et Opérations afin d’assurer l’alignement des plateformes. Définir les normes techniques, les pratiques de gestion du changement et les processus de gouvernance opérationnelle. Veiller à ce que les changements apportés aux plateformes d’ingénierie soient testés, documentés et soutenus sur le plan opérationnel, tout en assurant un leadership lors d’escalades techniques complexes et d’initiatives de plateforme à l’échelle de l’entreprise.
* Assurer la gestion financière et le leadership auprès de la haute direction : Gérer les budgets des plateformes, les prévisions, la planification des investissements et les initiatives d’optimisation. Élaborer des analyses de rentabilité et des recommandations d’investissement technologique. Favoriser l’optimisation des coûts liés à l’infonuagique, à l’infrastructure, à l’hébergement et aux services opérationnels, et produire des rapports destinés à la direction, des tableaux de bord, des présentations et des mises à jour de gouvernance.
* Développer l’équipe mondiale et le modèle opérationnel : Diriger et développer une équipe mondiale de spécialistes des plateformes et des technologies d’ingénierie. Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des modèles évolutifs de prestation et de soutien. Diriger la planification de la main-d’œuvre, le développement des capacités, le perfectionnement des compétences et la planification de la relève. Établir des structures de gouvernance et des modèles d’engagement pour les parties prenantes d’affaires et les équipes TI interfonctionnelles, tout en favorisant une culture de responsabilisation, d’innovation, de collaboration et d’amélioration continue.

**Les compétences qui vous distinguent**

* Formation et leadership des plateformes d’entreprise : Baccalauréat en technologies de l’information, informatique, ingénierie ou dans une discipline connexe, ainsi qu’une expérience significative dans la gestion de plateformes d’entreprise, de services d’infrastructure, de technologies infonuagiques ou d’environnements d’applications d’ingénierie.
* Expertise des environnements informatiques d’ingénierie : Expérience des environnements VDI, de l’informatique d’ingénierie, des plateformes d’hébergement infonuagique et de la prestation d’applications à l’échelle de l’entreprise. Une expérience des écosystèmes d’applications liés à l’ingénierie, au BIM, aux SIG/GIS, à la livraison numérique, à la simulation ou à la conception constitue un atout.
* Expertise en gouvernance des données : Solide compréhension des pratiques de gouvernance, de conservation, d’archivage et de gestion du cycle de vie des données, combinée à une connaissance des cadres d’architecture d’entreprise, de cybersécurité et de gouvernance des données.
* Leadership dans la réalisation d’initiatives complexes : Expérience de la gestion de portefeuilles de livraison technique et d’initiatives interfonctionnelles complexes. Expérience avec ITIL, Agile, SAFe ou des méthodologies de livraison comparables.
* Leadership mondial et modèles opérationnels : Expérience de la direction d’équipes techniques mondiales et de la transformation de modèles opérationnels.
* Gestion financière et investissements technologiques : Solide expérience de la gestion financière et des investissements technologiques, notamment en matière de budgets, de prévisions, de dossiers d’affaires, d’investissements et d’optimisation des coûts.
* Transformation infonuagique et modernisation : Expérience avec Microsoft Azure, les architectures cloud natives, les plateformes DaaS/VDI ainsi que les initiatives de modernisation de l’infrastructure. Expérience dans la direction de transformations infonuagiques et d’initiatives de modernisation des plateformes.

Title: Manager, Technology Audit
Description:
Job Description:

Referral Level: Level 1

Location: Toronto/Winnipeg

**Mackenzie Investments**

IGM Financial Inc. is a leading wealth and asset management company in Canada, managing approximately $310 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025. It offers financial planning and investment services to over two million Canadians through IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments.

Mackenzie Investments, founded in 1967, is a key part of IGM's business model, serving as a comprehensive asset-management partner for Canadian financial advisors and their clients.

**At Mackenzie Investments, we believe being invested starts with our people.** We are proud to be recognized as one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers for the fourth consecutive year and one of Canada’s Best Diversity Employers. Our vision and strategy aim to innovate the industry and support Canadians in achieving their financial goals.

Join our team to engage in continuous learning and skill development in a supportive environment. Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work environment, where you spend three days a week in the office, connecting, collaborating, and enjoying quality time with your amazing colleagues! Our Values: Be better; we strive for improvement in everything we do. Be accountable; we foster clarity and are empowered to act responsibly. Be a team; we are united to drive collective impact to achieve our goals.

**Role Overview**  
The Manager, IT Audit reports to the Director, IT Audit and is responsible for planning and executing risk-based technology audit and advisory engagements. This role focuses on assessing risks and controls across cloud environments, DevSecOps practices, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, and enterprise technology platforms. The successful candidate will work closely with technology and business stakeholders to provide practical, risk-based recommendations that strengthen governance, risk management, and control processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Leverage AI and analytics tools to improve audit efficiency, risk assessment, testing methodologies, and reporting processes.
* Assess governance and controls over AI and machine learning solutions, including model development, validation, monitoring, explainability, accountability, bias management, and data governance.
* Develop and execute data-enabled audit approaches using analytics, visualization, automation, and continuous auditing techniques.
* Assess risks associated with generative AI technologies, large language models, agentic systems, and third-party AI services.
* Lead and execute technology audit engagements from planning through reporting.
* Perform audits of cloud environments, including governance, security, identity and access management, resilience, and third-party risk controls.
* Assess DevSecOps processes, CI/CD pipelines, secure software development practices, and deployment controls.
* Evaluate governance, risk management, security, privacy, and regulatory considerations associated with AI solutions and emerging technologies.
* Assess IT general controls, automated controls, application controls, and cybersecurity controls.
* Participate in audits of major technology transformation initiatives, cloud migrations, and digital programs.
* Support integrated audits by identifying technology risks that may impact business processes.
* Develop clear and concise audit findings and recommendations.
* Build effective relationships with technology, cybersecurity, risk management, and business stakeholders.
* Monitor emerging risks and industry trends related to cloud computing, AI, cyber security, and software engineering.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across audit methodologies, quality assurance processes, audit technology, and reporting practices.
* Act as a trusted advisor to technology leadership on risk, governance, and control matters.
* Provide guidance and coaching to junior auditors and co-op students where applicable.

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong understanding of technology risk management and control frameworks including NIST, COBIT, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
* Hands-on experience auditing cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Experience reviewing DevSecOps environments, Agile delivery practices, CI/CD pipelines, and software development lifecycle controls.

* Experience using data analytics and visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Diligent/ ACL, Python, SQL, Databricks, or equivalent tools.
* Understanding AI governance, AI model risks, data quality, privacy, explainability, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience with scripting, automation, or audit technology solutions to improve assurance effectiveness.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity concepts including identity and access management, vulnerability management, logging and monitoring, and incident response.

**Professional Experience**  

* 5-8 years of experience in IT audit, technology risk, cybersecurity, data analytics, or related assurance functions, with demonstrated experience leading complex audit engagements.
* Experience in financial services, asset management, wealth management, or other regulated industries is preferred.
* Experience working with cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, and AI-related risks is required.

**Education and Certifications**

**Mandatory Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or related field.
* CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) or CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control)

**Preferred / Optional Certifications**  

* CPA (Certified Professional Accountant) or CIA (Certified Internal Auditor)

* CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) certification.
* CISM (Certified Information Security Manager).  
  + CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional).
  + Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert or Azure Security Engineer Associate.
  + ISACA Advanced in AI Audit (AAIA) or equivalent AI audit certification.

**Leadership and Competencies**  

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Strong stakeholder relationship management skills.
* High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.

**Additional Information**  

* Hybrid work model (3 days in office per week).
* Occasional travel may be required.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for annual short-term incentive, health and well-being benefits, retirement and savings plan, paid time off and career development.

**Position Summary**  
The Director, Provider Network Strategy and Contracting leads Aetna’s provider network strategy and contracting agenda for a geographic area of Florida “Market(s)”. This leader owns the market’s network performance, from the design and negotiation of strategic agreements with major health systems, physician organizations, and ancillary providers through to the delivery of measurable gains in affordability, access, and quality. The Director shapes the long-term direction of the network, serves as Aetna’s senior executive voice to the provider community, and leads a team of contract negotiators and network professionals. The role is accountable for market-level financial results and for aligning provider strategy with Aetna’s growth, product, and clinical priorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Strategy and Leadership*

* Set and execute the multi-year network strategy for a Market across commercial, Medicare Advantage, and Medicaid lines of business, balancing cost, access, quality, and competitive positioning
* Lead, develop, and coach a team of network negotiators and contracting professionals, establishing clear performance objectives, negotiation standards, and accountability for results
* Serve as an enterprise thought partner to senior leadership on market dynamics, provider consolidation, and emerging risks and opportunities

*Negotiation and Provider Partnerships*

* Lead high-stakes negotiations with hospital systems, large physician groups, and independent physician associations, including fee-for-service, value-based, and risk-based arrangements
* Establish and sustain executive-level relationships with provider C-suite leaders, system presidents, and physician group principals to foster long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships
* Direct escalated contract disputes, reimbursement issues, and strategic provider conflicts to resolution, protecting both member access and Aetna’s financial interests

*Financial and Market Performance*

* Own market-level medical cost and affordability targets, using cost and utilization analytics, market intelligence, and competitive benchmarking to guide negotiation strategy and deal structure
* Partner with Finance and Actuarial to evaluate the financial impact of major agreements and ensure contract economics align with business objectives
* Oversee pipeline management, negotiation sequencing, and reporting of savings and performance results to senior leadership

*Value-Based Care and Quality*

* Advance the market’s transition to value-based and total cost of care arrangements, driving provider adoption and measurable improvements in quality and member outcomes
* Hold provider partners accountable to contract performance, directing corrective action, renegotiation, or network changes where warranted

*Cross-Functional Alignment and Compliance*

* Collaborate with Medical Management, Legal, Compliance, Provider Operations, Sales, and Product to align contract strategy with enterprise priorities and member needs
* Ensure network adequacy, access, and regulatory compliance across Florida requirements, CMS standards, and Aetna and CVS Health policies
* Maintain rigorous governance over contract documentation, approvals, and reporting

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of progressive experience in health care provider contracting, payer-provider negotiation, managed care, or a related field, including 3+ years in a people leadership role
* Demonstrated success leading complex, high-value negotiations with hospital systems and large physician organizations
* Deep expertise in provider reimbursement methodologies (DRG, per diem, fee schedules, capitation) and value-based and risk-based models
* Strong financial acumen, with the ability to evaluate complex financial models and translate claims and utilization data into negotiation strategy
* Proven executive presence, with exceptional negotiation, communication, and relationship management skills
* Track record of managing multiple concurrent negotiations and competing priorities in a fast-moving environment
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree (MBA, MHA, or MPH)
* Established relationships with leadership at major Florida health systems and independent physician associations

* Experience with Medicare Advantage and Medicaid contracting
* Success driving value-based contracting and total cost of care strategies at scale

Collectivus Holdings is seeking a strategic and execution-focused Head of Digital Experiences to lead the vision, strategy, performance, and the ongoing evolution of our external-facing digital platforms across our portfolio of businesses.

This leader will oversee the digital product strategy and roadmap for our Learning Management System (LMS), Sorted app, and other customer-, retailer-, and partner-facing digital experiences.

The role is responsible for ensuring our digital products deliver meaningful value to users, support business objectives, and create a connected, intuitive experience across the Collectivus ecosystem.

Working closely with business leaders, Technology, Product, Sales, and Operations, this individual will translate business needs into clear digital priorities, partner on scalable software delivery and support processes, and drive measurable results.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Digital Strategy & Leadership**

* Develop and own the enterprise-wide strategy for external-facing digital products and experiences.
* Establish a cohesive digital vision across Collectivus businesses while addressing the unique needs of each brand and customer segment.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer engagement, retailer adoption, operational efficiency, and revenue through digital solutions.
* Build and manage a prioritized digital roadmap aligned with business objectives, available resources, and expected returns.
* Evaluate new digital opportunities, partnerships, and capabilities that support long-term business growth.

### **Digital Product Ownership**

Provide strategic direction and product leadership for key digital platforms, including:

* **Learning Management System (LMS):** Guide platform development, user experience, educational content delivery capabilities, community engagement, and adoption.
* **Sorted App:** Own the product vision, user experience, feature prioritization, and ongoing evolution of the platform.
* **Additional Digital Experiences:** Provide oversight and strategic alignment for other external-facing websites, applications, portals, and digital tools across the organization.
* Ensure each platform has a defined product strategy, roadmap, ownership structure, and measurable performance expectations.

### **Customer & Partner Experience**

* Champion a customer-first approach to digital product development.
* Ensure digital experiences are intuitive, reliable, accessible, and aligned with customer and partner needs.
* Use customer feedback, usage analytics, and market insights to inform product enhancements.
* Identify opportunities to create more connected experiences across platforms and business units.
* Partner with commercial teams to improve digital adoption, engagement, and customer retention.

### **Execution & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Product Engineering to translate product requirements into scalable, secure, reliable solutions, with clear accountability for product priorities, engineering execution, and business acceptance.
* Work with business leaders to understand priorities, evaluate requests, and establish clear product requirements.
* Lead product prioritization and make recommendations on resource allocation and investment.
* Establish clear product milestones, acceptance criteria, launch readiness expectations, and accountability for digital initiatives in partnership with delivery teams.
* Coordinate internal teams and external vendors to ensure successful product development and launches.
* Identify and resolve competing priorities, dependencies, and execution risks.
* Ensure new functionality is supported by appropriate launch, training, and adoption plans.
* Ensure each product has appropriate production-readiness criteria, monitoring, service expectations, documentation, and support arrangements before launch.
* Help establish a scalable keep-the-lights-on (KTLO) operating model for digital products, including service ownership, support processes, incident escalation, and ongoing enhancements.
* Define clear decision rights and handoffs among product, engineering, project delivery, and operations teams, including ownership of requirements, technical delivery, business acceptance, and production support.

### **Business Performance & Accountability**

* Establish KPIs for each digital platform, including revenue and monetization where applicable, user adoption, engagement, retention, customer satisfaction, and financial performance.
* Own digital product operating budgets and develop business cases for new digital investments, including anticipated benefits, costs, and ROI.
* Monitor product performance and use data to guide prioritization and continuous improvement.
* Provide regular updates to executive leadership on roadmap progress, performance, risks, and investment needs.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of existing platforms and recommend where to invest, improve, consolidate, or discontinue functionality.

### **Team & Vendor Leadership**

* Build and lead a high-performing digital product function as business needs evolve.
* Establish clear roles, responsibilities, and decision-making processes across digital initiatives.
* Manage relationships with external development partners, technology vendors, and service providers.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and measurable outcomes.

  

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Digital Product Management, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in digital product management, digital strategy, or platform leadership.

Title: Manager - Cybersecurity
Location: Sharjah, Sharjah Emirate, United Arab Emirates
Description:
**Job Purpose**
The Manager of Cyber Security is responsible for leading the enterprise cyber security strategy, operations, and governance across on-premises and cloud environments. This role oversees a dedicated cyber security team responsible for protecting infrastructure (Windows/Linux servers, cloud platforms: Oracle, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes clusters, enterprise networking, and databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, MSSQL, MySQL, CouchDB). The Manager ensures compliance with industry regulations, reduces cyber risks, and implements proactive security measures to safeguard critical business systems and data.
  
  
Key Result Responsibilities
  
  
**Strategic & Governance**

* Develop and implement the organization’s cyber security roadmap aligned with business and regulatory requirements.
* Establish security policies, standards, and procedures across infrastructure, cloud, and application environments.
* Collaborate with the Manager of Cloud & Infrastructure Services or Technology Infrastructure Manager to embed security into system and network architecture.
* Manage security budgets, vendor relationships, and third-party risk assessments.
* Ensure compliance with standards such as ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, HIPAA, or local regulatory requirements.

**Operational Security**

* Oversee Security Operations Centre (SOC) activities, including monitoring, threat detection, and incident response.
* Manage vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and remediation plans.
* Implement and maintain security controls for servers, networks, cloud services, Kubernetes, and databases.
* Lead incident response and forensic investigations, ensuring timely resolution and root cause analysis.
* Ensure strong identity and access management (IAM), privilege escalation control, and zero-trust practices.

Key Result Responsibilities-Continued
  
  
**Risk Management & Assurance**

* Conduct regular risk assessments and security audits across IT infrastructure and applications.
* Manage enterprise endpoint protection, intrusion detection/prevention (IDS/IPS), and SIEM platforms.
* Drive awareness and training programs to promote a strong cyber security culture across the organization.
* Oversee data protection measures, encryption standards, and backup/recovery procedures.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor a dedicated cyber security team including analysts, engineers, and incident responders.
* Define KPIs and success metrics for cyber defence and resilience.
* Provide continuous skill development to stay ahead of evolving threats and technologies.

**People Management**

* Provides direction, coaching and guidance to team members for their career and professional development.
* Creates a conducive working environment to build and sustain a performance driven, engaged, and committed team.
* Ensures people management responsibilities are handled effectively in line with company procedures.

**Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)**

* Bachelor’s degree in cyber security, Information Technology, or related field (master’s preferred).
* CISSP, CISM, CISA, CEH, CCSP, or equivalent industry certifications.
* Cloud security certifications (AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, Oracle Security).
* Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS) is a plus.
* Fluent in English Language
* Strong background securing Windows/Linux servers, cloud (AWS, Azure, Oracle), and enterprise networks.
* Knowledge of enterprise databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MSSQL, MySQL, CouchDB) and their security best practices.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

Work Experience
  
  

* With 8+ years of IT security experience, with at least 3+ years in a managerial role.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes security, container hardening, and cloud-native security tools.
* Proven track record in leading incident response and crisis management.

Title: IT Technical Programme Manager
