**The Role**

At Capco, we are looking for an experienced **IT Technical Programme Manager** with strong expertise in smart building technologies and modern workplace infrastructure to lead the technology delivery of a major relocation programme in Doha, Qatar.

The role requires a combination of technical depth and programme delivery experience, with particular emphasis on smart building systems, IoT, intelligent building controls, Digital Twin technologies and AI-enabled solutions, alongside a strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure and connectivity.

Working closely with technology teams, facilities, construction partners, specialist vendors and senior stakeholders stakeholders, you will ensure that technical workstreams are delivered in line with programme milestones, enterprise standards and regulatory requirements.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a complex, high-profile technology programme, ensuring a seamless transition to a modern, secure and fully operational workplace environment.

**What You'll Do**

* **End-to-end technology delivery:** You will own the programme from planning and design through infrastructure deployment, testing, migration, go-live and operational handover, ensuring alignment with business objectives and delivery milestones.
* **Critical IT infrastructure and connectivity:** You will coordinate enterprise networking, telecommunications, structured cabling, IDF/MDF facilities, workplace technologies and infrastructure resilience to deliver a secure, connected and reliable office environment.
* **Smart building and digital workplace integration:** You will oversee the delivery and integration of intelligent building management and control systems, IoT platforms, connected infrastructure, Digital Twin capabilities and AI-enabled building technologies, ensuring interoperability across building and enterprise IT systems.
* **Programme governance:** You will manage integrated plans, budgets, vendors, contractors, risks, issues and dependencies while providing clear executive reporting and coordinating technology requirements across construction, facilities and business teams.
* **Security, operational readiness and business continuity**: You will coordinate and oversee physical security and cybersecurity requirements, testing, commissioning, disaster recovery validation, technical documentation, change control and service transition activities to ensure a secure and smooth relocation with minimal business disruption.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Extensive technical programme delivery experience:** At least 7 years of experience managing complex technology programmes, ideally including modern corporate office fit-outs, smart building deployments, workplace transformations or greenfield technology implementations.
* **Smart Building, IoT & Emerging Digital Technologies:** Recent, demonstrable experience delivering and integrating smart building technologies, including Building Management Systems (BMS), intelligent control systems, IoT platforms and connected infrastructure, with exposure to emerging technologies such as Digital Twins, digital avatars and AI-enabled building solutions.
* **Enterprise IT infrastructure expertise:** Strong technical understanding of enterprise networking, telecommunications, structured cabling, IDF/MDF environments, data centre dependencies and infrastructure resilience, including integration with modern building systems.
* **Security and workplace technology understanding:** Experience coordinating physical security and cybersecurity requirements, ccess control, CCTV, end-user computing, meeting room technologies, collaboration platforms and associated operational support services.
* **Programme management and governance:** Demonstrated experience managing multiple technical workstreams, delivery partners, budgets, risks and dependencies, including coordinating technology delivery with construction and facilities teams, and overseeing business continuity and operational readiness.
* **Stakeholder engagement and communication:** Ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders, technical specialists, construction teams and external vendors.

**Bonus Points For**

* PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, ITIL or other recognised project and programme management certifications.
* Experience delivering technology programmes within Financial Services, Government or other highly regulated environments.
* Hands-on experience implementing Digital Twin platforms, digital avatars or AI-enabled building management and automation solutions.

**Why Join Capco**

* Deliver high-impact solutions for leading organisations.
* Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.
* Access continuous learning, training, and industry certifications.
* Work alongside multidisciplinary teams on complex transformation initiatives.

Title: Senior Manager, Technology Sourcing
Description:
Requisition ID: 279434
  
  
Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

  

Join Scotiabank at a pivotal time of transformation, where Procurement is driving strategic value and innovation. As the Bank accelerates its adoption of AI and digital capabilities, you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of sourcing within a global organization.

Shape the future of Technology Sourcing at Scotiabank

  

Scotiabank's Procurement function is at a pivotal moment — driving strategic value, commercial discipline, and innovation as the Bank accelerates its digital and AI transformation. As Senior Manager, Technology Sourcing, you'll lead high-impact sourcing strategies across some of the Bank's most complex and fastest-evolving technology categories.

This is a role for a commercially sharp procurement leader who thrives on solving complex problems, influencing spend decisions, and delivering measurable outcomes beyond savings.

  

**Is this role right for you? In this role you will:**

  

* Lead end-to-end sourcing for enterprise technology categories from opportunity assessment and market intelligence through negotiation, contracting, and benefits realization.

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related; CPSM, CIPS, or equivalent is preferred.

Title: Senior Program Delivery Manager

The Senior Program Delivery Manager ensures that Applause understands those decisions and translates them into an effective service-delivery strategy.

* Strong customer confidence in Applause’s delivery organization.
* Accurate, decision-ready reporting and reliable executive-review preparation.
* Clear accountability across Applause, customer, and partner teams.
* Early identification and effective mitigation of delivery risks.
* Healthy utilization, capacity planning, and resource continuity.
* Effective leadership and development of the LQAM team.
* Measurable improvements in testing value, quality coverage, and operational efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* Experience managing or leading distributed, cross-functional teams.

Title: Technical Program Manager
Description:
**About Blackbird Health**

Blackbird Health is clinician-founded, owned, and operated by dedicated professionals. We believe that providing the best care for children starts with building the best possible team. We deliver virtual and in-person mental health services across Pennsylvania, Virginia, New Jersey & Maryland—and we're growing into new markets in 2027.

At Blackbird, we take a whole-child approach, looking at how the brain, body, and behavior interact to address the root causes of challenges, not just the symptoms. Every role matters here, and you'll join a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team that's shaping the future of pediatric mental health care. If you're passionate about helping children and families while growing your career, Blackbird is the place to make an impact.

Join us and help change mental health care for children for the better!

**Position Summary**

Blackbird Health is looking to hire a Technical Program Manager (TPM), Clinical Data & Operations to join our growing Data & Technology team. This role will own the end-to-end delivery of our clinical data initiatives—serving as the strategic engine for clinical operations. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Data and Technology, you will translate complex operational bottlenecks (provider capacity, patient throughput, scheduling workflows) into scalable data products. Leveraging our modern cloud data stack (Snowflake, AWS, GCP, and dbt), you will define KPIs, eliminate manual reporting, and operationalize data so our clinics run as efficiently as possible. This is not a traditional TPM role. You won't just coordinate roadmaps or track deliverables; you will build analytics solutions from prototype to production partnering with respective experts in the organization.

**What makes you, you:**

* **Player-Coach Mentality:** You are comfortable leading projects strategically while also rolling up your sleeves to write SQL or build data models when needed to unblock your team.
* **Clarity of Thought:** You can translate ambiguous clinical and operational challenges into precise technical requirements and clear strategies for non-technical stakeholders.
* **Empathy & Integrity:** You lead with heart and high EQ, understanding the day-to-day stress of clinical directors and framing data as a tool to help them, not police them.
* **Operations Obsessed:** You don't just look at numbers; you deeply understand how clinics actually run in the real world and care about the human impact of your workflows.
* **Ambiguity Navigator:** You thrive when handed a vague business problem, quickly structuring it into a clear, actionable technical project and agile roadmap.

**How you'll make an impact:**

* **Technical Program Management & Delivery:** Own the data product roadmap for clinical operations; scope, prioritize, and drive the execution of complex data projects from initial concept to production delivery.
* Translate ambiguous clinical and operational challenges into precise technical requirements and data models.
* Manage cross-functional project lifecycles, acting as the primary bridge between clinical leadership, engineering, and operations teams to ensure data solutions are adopted and effective.
* **Clinical Operations & Change Management:** Deeply analyze provider utilization, appointment scheduling, wait times, and capacity planning to build predictive models that anticipate resource constraints.
* Map and evaluate existing clinical workflows, identifying operational bottlenecks and leading data-backed process improvement initiatives.
* Drive change management across the clinical team; ensure clinical leaders understand the data, trust the insights, and actually use them to change how their teams operate.
* Track the operational and financial ROI of implemented data products and workflow adjustments over time.
* **Data Architecture & Pipeline Oversight:** Tackle complex, unstructured clinical data (including EHR feeds, notes, and third-party data) to build robust, scalable analytics workflows.
* Provide hands-on technical guidance (and execution when necessary) using **dbt** to build, test, and maintain clean data models within our **Snowflake** environment, hosted across **AWS/GCP**.
* Ensure strict adherence to **HIPAA** compliance, data security, and patient privacy standards in all data models and reporting outputs.

**The basics you'll need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Health Informatics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in technical program management, data product management, or a senior analytics role heavily embedded in clinical operations.
* Deep, practical understanding of clinic operations (e.g., provider scheduling, utilization metrics, patient throughput).
* Strong understanding of modern cloud data warehouse architecture (specifically Snowflake, with exposure to AWS or GCP environments).
* Experience with or strong conceptual understanding of dbt (data build tool) for data modeling and pipeline transformation.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL and experience with modern BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker) to build compelling data narratives.
* Solid understanding of HIPAA regulations and data governance best practices in healthcare.
* Proficiency with agile methodologies and modern project tracking tools (Jira, Linear, Asana, etc.).

**Nice to have:**

* Familiarity with clinical interoperability standards and data formats, specifically HL7 and FHIR, as well as billing codes (ICD-10, CPT).
* Expert-level understanding of workflows within major Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.
* Experience with Python or R for statistical analysis and predictive modeling.

**Why Blackbird is unique:**

* **High-Impact Ownership:** Direct opportunities to shape how our clinics run and directly improve the mental healthcare experience for families.
* **Modern Tech Stack:** Autonomy to build scalable solutions using best-in-class cloud and analytics engineering tools.
* **Leadership Impact:** You will report directly to technology leadership and act as a key liaison across the entire clinical organization.
* Supportive work culture

**Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental & Vision coverage (available on day 1 of employment)
* 401k (with a company match)
* Employer-paid life insurance coverage
* Generous paid time off
* Opportunities for career growth
* Final compensation determined based on experience

**Join us!**

To raise the standard of pediatric mental health care through accurate understanding and precise treatment that reflect how each child's brain, body, and behavior work together.

"It's so rare to find comprehensive care like this-from testing to therapy to med management (and more)-all in one place. In addition, the school advocacy support we receive is unprecedented. We no longer feel like we are managing things alone."

**Fostering an inclusive environment:**

Blackbird is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and belonging. We are able to grow and learn better together with a diverse team of employees. In recruiting for our team, we welcome the unique contributions that you can bring in terms of your education, opinions, culture, ethnicity, race, sex, gender identity and expression, nation of origin, age, languages spoken, veteran status, color, religion, disability, sexual orientation and beliefs. Blackbird provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at recruiting@blackbirdhealth.com so we can support you.

*Our patient support team is busy helping children and families, please do not call or email them about your application — this helps us process your application more efficiently.*

Title: Project Manager
Description:
**About Cat5 Resources LLC**

Since 2013, we’ve supported telecommunications, utilities, and essential industries with services including **Disaster Recovery, Operations and Maintenance, Electrical, Civil and Construction, and Transportation and Logistics.** In 2016, we expanded into Puerto Rico with **Cat5 Caribbean**, and in 2024, we launched **Cat5 Power Solutions** to deliver portable power sales and rentals across the region.

  
  

We are committed to powering and protecting the infrastructure that keeps businesses and communities running—whether during daily operations or times of disaster.

**Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Fueling for Data Center**
================================================================================

**Cat5 Resources**

**Position summary**
--------------------

The Project Manager leads Cat5’s preventive maintenance and fueling program for a national wireless infrastructure client, with a fleet made up mostly of portable generators. The role coordinates scheduled maintenance, routine and emergency fuel deliveries, portable unit deployment and recovery, field personnel and vendors, safety, client communications, and complete service and fuel-delivery documentation.

**Department**

Operations – Generator Services

  

**Reports to**

Director of Operations

  

**Location**

Mostly on-site in North Texas, with travel to vendor shops and field sites

  

**Type**

Full-time, exempt

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Program and client management**

* Serve as the client’s main point of contact; run regular status meetings and escalations.

* Build and manage the program plan, budget, staffing and subcontractor mix (in-house vs. third party).

* Get all subcontractors through the client’s qualification process before they access any site.

* Track and report performance against contract SLAs: preventive maintenance completion, on-time fueling, emergency response, fuel-delivery accuracy and work-order closeout.

* Protect client confidential information.

* Turn around client quote requests and purchase orders quickly, within contract response times.

* Track every scheduled maintenance visit and fueling commitment; flag at-risk work orders early and communicate revised completion dates.

**Preventive maintenance and fueling operations**

* Oversee scheduled preventive maintenance inspections and servicing of portable generators and, where applicable, installed generators and automatic transfer switches (ATS).

* Review maintenance findings, identify deficiencies and coordinate escalation of repair needs to the appropriate repair team for client approval.

* Plan recurring generator fueling, fuel-level checks and emergency refueling based on client requirements, site access and generator operating needs.

* Coordinate routine portable generator checks, operational testing and follow-up on deficiencies identified during preventive maintenance, including ATS checks where applicable.

* Enforce quality standards through maintenance checklists, fuel-delivery tickets, meter readings, photographs and complete site-level work-order records.

* Investigate missed services, fueling discrepancies, fuel shortages and repeat service issues; document corrective actions.

* Ensure preventive maintenance and fueling activities follow applicable safety, spill-prevention, environmental and fuel-handling requirements.

* Ensure technicians record generator condition, alarms, fluid levels, battery checks, fuel levels and test results during service visits.

* Obtain required client approvals for nonroutine fueling, emergency deliveries and out-of-scope maintenance before proceeding.

* Maintain complete preventive maintenance and fueling history for each serviced asset and site.

* Track portable generator inventory, location, deployment, transport and return, recording unit ID, run hours and condition at each move.

* Coordinate qualified maintenance subcontractors, fuel suppliers and delivery partners when work cannot be self-performed.

* Escalate generator faults, fuel-system concerns, suspected leaks and repair needs with supporting site documentation.

**Fuel, parts and materials management**

* Maintain availability of preventive maintenance supplies, filters, fluids and approved fueling resources.

* Forecast maintenance supplies and fuel-delivery demand based on schedules, site consumption and seasonal or emergency needs.

* Publish reports on fuel deliveries, consumption, maintenance supplies, missed visits and service delays.

* Coordinate approved fuel suppliers and maintenance-material vendors, including delivery coverage and service expectations.

* Record maintenance materials, delivered fuel quantities, delivery confirmations and associated costs in designated systems.

* Use maintenance schedules, historical fuel usage and generator run time to plan service materials and fueling requirements.

* Review fuel-supply capacity, delivery lead times and critical maintenance materials with the client.

* Support client audits of maintenance records, fuel tickets, invoices and vendor compliance.

**Field operations and technician coordination**

* Assign preventive maintenance routes, fueling dispatches and portable generator deployments based on geography, site priority and personnel qualifications.

* Monitor technician and fuel-vendor productivity, service quality, safety compliance and work-order completion.

* Coordinate follow-up maintenance visits, missed fuel deliveries and client communication for incomplete work.

**Scheduling, dispatch and work-order management**

* Manage multi-site preventive maintenance schedules, fueling routes, dispatch priorities and travel logistics.

* Complete scheduled preventive maintenance and fuel deliveries within contractual service windows.

* Escalate missed appointments, access issues, low-fuel conditions and delivery delays; keep the client informed.

* Track maintenance and fueling work orders, assigned personnel, delivery dates, gallons delivered and outstanding actions.

* Close out each work order with service details, fuel quantities, delivery tickets, photographs and client-required documentation.

* Investigate recurring service exceptions, fuel discrepancies, incomplete deliveries and quality concerns.

* Ensure proper handling of fuels and service waste, including spill response and reporting under applicable procedures.

**Site services**

* Plan preventive maintenance visits, routine fueling, emergency refueling and portable generator deployment at tower and other remote sites with client operations teams.

* Make sure field technicians hold the required electrical and mechanical certifications and follow site safety rules.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of project or program management in field services, maintenance, fuel logistics or telecom infrastructure.

* 3+ years working with portable and standby diesel or natural gas generators; automatic transfer switch (ATS) experience is a plus.

* Working knowledge of Generac, Kohler and other portable generator platforms and their controllers.

* Experience managing generator preventive maintenance and fueling programs with field documentation and quality controls.

* Experience with fuel logistics, delivery verification, vendor coordination and maintenance-material planning.

* Experience managing subcontractors and vendors, including qualification, scheduling and performance.

* Comfortable working from contract terms: POs, work orders, SLAs, fueling requirements and service scopes.

* Strong Excel skills and experience with field service, maintenance management or work-order systems.

* Clear written reporting to an enterprise client on a daily, weekly and monthly cadence.

* Able to work independently and remotely, and to manage on-site work from a distance.

* Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* EGSA Generator Technician certification, or prior hands-on generator technician experience.

* Experience with tower or cell-site backup power programs for a national carrier or tower company.

* Experience with generator fueling, emergency fuel delivery, fuel monitoring and remote field service.

* Knowledge of applicable environmental and safety requirements for fuel, fluids, batteries and field maintenance.

* Familiarity with OSHA 10/30 and site-access qualification for subcontractors.

* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

* Based primarily at our Power Solutions location in North Texas, with coordination of remote field operations.

* Travel to fuel vendors, maintenance partners and field sites, up to 40% of the time.

* Availability outside normal hours for emergency fueling, portable generator deployment, generator outages and storm response.

* Field visits involve tower-site conditions, heat, noise, outdoor weather and required PPE.

* Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs and walk uneven ground at sites.

**Success measures**
--------------------

* On-time preventive maintenance completion, fueling delivery and work-order closeout.

* Fueling dispatch, emergency delivery and maintenance response within contract requirements.

* Every maintenance visit and fuel delivery documented with required readings, quantities and asset identification.

* Daily, weekly and monthly client reports delivered complete and on time.

* Improved generator readiness, fewer low-fuel incidents and timely resolution of maintenance deficiencies.

* Accurate fuel reconciliation, strong safety performance and zero unauthorized work.

* Invoices submitted promptly after work is accepted.

**Equal opportunity**
---------------------

Cat5 Resources is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected status. Employment may be contingent on a background check and drug screen.

Our platform powers the global engagement industry, enabling companies to deliver impactful employee recognition, customer loyalty, rewards, sales, and channel incentive programs. We partner with over

.

carltonone.com
.

**About the Opportunity:**

CarltonOne is seeking a highly motivated Director, Information Technology to lead CarltonOne's global enterprise IT function, owning IT strategy, service management, governance, and employee technology experience.

This role is responsible for delivering a best-in-class employee technology experience across the organization, ensuring employees have the tools, systems, support, and infrastructure they need to be productive and successful. The Director, IT will lead internal IT support, service delivery, endpoint management, identity and access management, collaboration tools, workplace technology initiatives, and global hardware operations across CarltonOne's international workforce.

This is a strategic leadership role. The Director, IT is accountable for the outcomes of IT service delivery rather than working the support queue, leading through managers, team leads, and managed service partners who handle Level 1 and Level 2 support. The Director serves as the senior escalation point and leader during major IT and security incidents, and focuses on strengthening process, governance, and measurement to deliver an exceptional, proactive employee experience. The successful candidate will focus on improving service levels, modernizing IT processes, strengthening security practices, and scaling internal technology operations to support a growing global organization.

**Responsibilities:**

**IT Service Management & Incident Leadership**

* Own CarltonOne's global IT operating model, including service desk structure, tiered support (L1/L2/L3), escalation paths, and the balance of in-house and managed service provider (MSP) coverage.
* Hold the service desk and support partners accountable for timely, high-quality resolution of employee requests and issues, without personally working day-to-day L1/L2 tickets.
* Define and publish SLAs, experience level agreements (XLAs), and an IT performance scorecard covering CSAT, first-contact resolution, mean time to resolve, SLA attainment, backlog age, and reopen rates, reported monthly to executive leadership.
* Run a continuous improvement program driven by ticket trend analysis, employee feedback, and experience data, with the goal of reducing ticket volume per employee year over year.
* Ensure consistent delivery of IT services across all regions and time zones.
* Act as Major Incident Manager and senior escalation point for high-impact IT outages, leading coordinated response, stakeholder communications, and service restoration.
* Partner with Information Security to support the response to security incidents, including containment of affected accounts and devices, evidence preservation, and executive communication, in line with the incident response plan.
* Implement a problem management practice that uses root cause analysis and post-incident reviews to eliminate recurring issues, with tracked corrective actions.
* Establish change, release, and configuration management processes that reduce change-related incidents and protect service stability.
* Own Jira Service Management as the IT service management platform, driving workflow design, automation, SLA tracking, and reporting.
* Partner with SaaS production, engineering, and DevOps teams to align IT processes such as access, change, and incident management with production operations, and provide the internal tools and access they need.
* Own the IT service management (ITSM) platform roadmap, service catalogue, and knowledge base, aligned to ITIL 4 practices.

**Employee Technology Experience**

* Develop and enhance the overall employee technology experience across the organization.
* Ensure employees have access to reliable hardware, software, collaboration tools, and support resources regardless of location.
* Partner with business leaders to understand technology needs and improve workplace productivity.
* Evaluate and implement technologies that improve employee efficiency, collaboration, and engagement.
* Champion self-service support resources, knowledge management programs, and technology adoption initiatives.
* Shift IT from reactive to proactive by using monitoring, digital employee experience (DEX) tooling, and endpoint analytics to detect and resolve issues before employees are affected.
* Measure employee technology sentiment through regular surveys and an IT Net Promoter Score, and act on the results with visible follow-through.
* Promote a shift-left approach that moves common requests to self-service and automation, freeing the team for higher-value work.
* Create seamless onboarding and offboarding experiences through standardized technology processes.

**Global Hardware & Employee Technology Management**

* Own CarltonOne's global hardware procurement, deployment, lifecycle management, and asset governance strategy.
* Develop and manage scalable processes for onboarding and offboarding employees across Canada, the United States, Brazil, the United Kingdom, Australia, and other international locations.
* Partner with global vendors, distributors, and logistics providers to ensure timely delivery, replacement, retrieval, and support of employee equipment worldwide.
* Establish global standards for laptops, peripherals, mobile devices, and collaboration technology to provide a consistent employee experience.
* Oversee hardware inventory management, asset tracking, auditing, and recovery programs across all regions.
* Manage relationships with international hardware partners and service providers to optimize cost, service levels, and operational efficiency.
* Develop regional technology deployment strategies that account for customs requirements, shipping timelines, local regulations, and business needs.
* Ensure all employee devices are properly configured, secured, encrypted, and compliant with company security standards prior to deployment.
* Partner with Information Security teams to maintain endpoint management, device compliance, and security controls globally.
* Lead technology refresh programs and lifecycle planning to ensure employees have access to modern and reliable equipment.
* Establish reporting and KPIs related to deployment timelines, inventory accuracy, hardware utilization, asset recovery, and employee satisfaction.

**IT Leadership & Talent**

* Build, lead, and develop a global IT organization, including people managers, team leads, and specialists, and manage MSP and outsourced support partners.
* Establish team goals, performance expectations, and professional development plans.
* Foster a customer-first service culture focused on responsiveness, accountability, and problem resolution.
* Design staffing models, global coverage, escalation processes, and on-call rotations so that routine support across all time zones is delivered by the team and its partners.
* Promote knowledge sharing, process consistency, and operational excellence across the team.
* Build a high-performing IT organization capable of supporting a rapidly growing global workforce.

**Infrastructure & Workplace Technology**

* Oversee the management of employee technology including laptops, mobile devices, conference room systems, printers, and collaboration tools.
* Ensure reliable operation of corporate productivity platforms including Microsoft 365, communication platforms, and workplace technologies.
* Support office technology infrastructure across multiple global locations.
* Own software licensing and SaaS governance, including licence optimization, application rationalization, and shadow IT controls.
* Identify opportunities to modernize and standardize workplace technology solutions.

**Identity, Access Management & IT Security**

* Oversee user provisioning, deprovisioning, and identity and access management processes.
* Partner closely with Information Security teams to maintain secure access controls and endpoint security standards.
* Support security awareness initiatives and IT compliance requirements.
* Ensure adherence to IT policies, security best practices, and governance standards.
* Participate in internal and external audits related to IT operations and controls.
* Help strengthen the company's security posture through proactive management of employee technology and access controls.

**Vendor & Technology Management**

* Manage relationships with IT vendors, service providers, telecommunications partners, and technology suppliers.
* Negotiate contracts, licensing agreements, and support arrangements.
* Evaluate technology investments and recommend solutions that align with business requirements and budgets.
* Monitor vendor performance and ensure service commitments are achieved.
* Identify opportunities to consolidate vendors and improve operational efficiency.

**Project & Program Leadership**

* Lead enterprise IT projects from planning through implementation and ongoing support.
* Support technology rollouts, infrastructure upgrades, collaboration platform enhancements, and automation initiatives.
* Partner with HR, Finance, Security, Operations, and Technology teams on cross-functional projects.
* Develop project plans, budgets, timelines, resource requirements, and success metrics.
* Drive automation and process improvement initiatives that increase productivity and reduce manual effort.

* Own disaster recovery planning and regular testing for internal systems and employee technologies, and partner with the business on continuity planning.
* Maintain an IT risk register, report key risks to leadership, and own mitigation plans through to closure.

* Experience leading internal IT within a SaaS company, including supporting SaaS production, engineering, and DevOps teams with access management, tooling, change coordination, and incident collaboration.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), endpoint management, collaboration platforms, and modern workplace technologies.
* Proven experience managing global hardware deployment and asset lifecycle programs.
* Experience supporting distributed workforces across multiple countries and time zones.
* Expert in ITIL 4 and IT service management (ITSM), with a proven record of designing, implementing, and maturing incident, problem, change, request, and knowledge management processes.
* Hands-on experience implementing and administering Jira Service Management, including workflows, service catalogue, SLAs, automation, and reporting.
* Proven experience implementing and improving controls aligned to the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Critical Security Controls, and SOC 2, including audit readiness, evidence collection, remediation of findings, and ongoing compliance.

* Proven experience leading IT projects and operational improvement initiatives.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Strong customer service mindset with a focus on employee experience.

* Experience with IT governance and control frameworks such as COBIT, ISO 27001, or ISO 20000.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity best practices, endpoint security, and compliance requirements.
* Experience supporting HRIS, Finance, and SaaS business applications.
* ITIL 4, Atlassian (Jira Service Management), Microsoft, CISSP, CISM, or related certifications.

**Additional Perks**

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Health, dental, and vision coverage.
* Vacation plus personal days.
* Access to our employee benefits portal for exclusive discounts.
* Monthly company-wide events, celebrations, and team activities.

Title: Director, Technology, Campana Systems
Description:
**We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this** **link** **directly.**

  

**Who we are**

At Aquila, we invest in category-defining B2B/B2G software companies globally, acting as a thought-partner, striving for the success of our companies in the long term. We are a well-managed, profitable company that operates like a startup with the financial backing of a parent company. For our people, this means limitless possibilities.

We are unapologetically unique, pivoting to respond to the needs of the multiple markets we operate in. We have ambitious goals, and we are looking for genuine contributors with integrity, energy, flexibility, and loyalty. We are investing in building future leaders who can take an idea and make things happen.

**About Campana Systems**

Campana Systems, a Gemini Group company within Aquila, develops specialized software solutions for AAA and CAA auto clubs across North America. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Waterloo, Ontario, Campana has built long-standing relationships with organizations that rely on its technology to manage their operations and deliver services to their members.

Our AXIS platform brings together membership management, customer relationship management, emergency roadside assistance, travel services, and business intelligence in an integrated suite of solutions. Looking ahead, we are focused on evolving our technology, strengthening our platform capabilities, and finding new ways to help our customers work more efficiently and deliver better member experiences.

**Who we need**

Reporting to the General Manager, we are hiring a Director, Technology to lead the evolution of Campana Systems’ technology strategy, architecture, infrastructure, and AXIS platform. In this newly created role, you will own the technology roadmap from strategy through execution, with accountability for modernization priorities, investment decisions, platform reliability, and measurable business outcomes. You will lead the Architecture and Infrastructure & Security teams, partner with the Director, Development, and establish the technical direction and capabilities needed to deliver on our product vision while supporting the customers who depend on our technology.

*This is a fully remote role open to candidates across Canada, with working hours of 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Eastern Time.*

**What’s in it for you**

*Shape a meaningful transformation.* You will have the autonomy to challenge established approaches, make consequential technology decisions, and guide the evolution of a business-critical software platform. You will see the impact of your work in stronger platform capabilities, improved delivery, and better customer experiences.

*Build what comes next.* You will lead experienced teams while shaping the standards, capabilities, and ways of working needed for the future. From strengthening engineering practices to developing technical leaders, you will have the opportunity to build a more effective technology organization and see the results of your leadership.

*Grow your executive influence.* You will work directly with the General Manager and contribute to decisions that connect technology investments with customer needs and business growth. Backed by Aquila and the broader Constellation Software network, you will have opportunities to expand your leadership experience and pursue broader responsibilities over time.

**As our new Director, Technology, you will**

* **Own the technology roadmap.** You will turn the product vision into a multi-year strategy with clear priorities, investments, milestones, and measurable outcomes. You will balance modernization, technical debt, customer commitments, and platform stability, taking accountability for delivery and results. You will establish architectural standards, technology governance, and engineering priorities. Partnering with the Director, Development, you will strengthen technical decision-making, CI/CD, automation, and delivery practices across Canadian and offshore teams.
* **Lead platform modernization.** You will define a phased approach to evolving AXIS, including its legacy Rocket UniVerse architecture. You will determine what to retain, integrate, replace, or modernize, guiding decisions on APIs, application architecture, CRM, data capabilities, and cloud or hybrid environments while protecting the reliability customers depend on.
* **Turn innovation into impact.** You will identify opportunities to improve CRM capabilities, business intelligence, reporting, and operational efficiency through AI, automation, and better use of data. You will evaluate feasibility and business value, establish priorities, and work with technical teams to turn promising initiatives into measurable results.
* **Strengthen security and reliability.** You will oversee infrastructure, hosting, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, and platform resilience. You will reduce technology risk, strengthen operational controls, and advance security and compliance readiness, including SOC 2-related requirements.
* **Build and grow technical capabilities.** You will lead the Architecture and Infrastructure & Security teams, develop talent, strengthen accountability, and identify capability gaps. You will improve collaboration with Development and Product to ensure teams have the direction and support needed to execute the roadmap.
* **Connect technology to business priorities.** You will partner with the General Manager on technology investments, budgets, resources, and strategic decisions. You will communicate risks and trade-offs, measure progress, and contribute technical leadership to customer conversations when needed.

**You bring**

* **The senior technology leadership.** You have led technology strategy, architecture, and technical teams within an enterprise software business, with accountability for investment decisions, organizational performance, and business outcomes. You bring the judgment to set direction, establish priorities, and deliver results through technical leaders and cross-functional teams.
* **The platform modernization expertise.** You have led the evolution of complex, business-critical software, navigating legacy architecture, technical debt, and customer dependencies. You know how to assess what to retain, replace, or integrate, develop a phased modernization roadmap, and introduce new capabilities without compromising reliability.
* **The technical depth.** You bring strong expertise in enterprise architecture, APIs, integrations, data platforms, and cloud or hybrid environments, along with an understanding of infrastructure, cybersecurity, and disaster recovery. You can establish technical standards, evaluate emerging technologies, and guide decisions that strengthen platform performance, security, and scalability.
* **The experience driving innovation.** You have improved engineering practices and delivery performance across distributed teams, including those outside your direct reporting structure. You understand CI/CD, automation, and modern development practices, and can identify practical opportunities for AI, analytics, and business intelligence that deliver measurable value.
* **The business acumen.** You connect technology decisions to customer needs, financial priorities, and long-term business growth. You can evaluate investments, communicate complex trade-offs, and align senior leaders while staying close enough to the technology to challenge assumptions and guide execution.
* **The influence.** You develop strong technical leaders, establish accountability, and build cross-functional, cross-location collaboration. You are comfortable making difficult decisions, navigating competing priorities, and owning outcomes in an environment where you have the autonomy to shape what comes next.

**Why join?**

Axis Campana and Aquila are part of Constellation Software Inc., one of Canada's largest and most successful software companies and its most successful technology stock over the last 10 years [TSE: CSU].

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. This is a place where high performance and hard work are rewarded, where leaders are grown, and where the best ideas win. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

We spend our days asking questions and challenging the status quo, manipulating our structure, roles, and internal operations in order to stay ahead in a competitive landscape.

If you share our growth mindset, relationship-focused approach, and high moral fibre, you will thrive at Aquila.

**Compensation**

At Campana and Aquila, we believe compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of both experience and impact. The salary range for this role is CAD $150,000 to $200,000 plus bonus.

Compensation is determined based on skills, experience, and the scope and complexity of the role. We value open conversations about compensation and are happy to discuss our approach at any stage of the hiring process.

**Apply now.**

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have most of the qualifications we are seeking, and want to play an integral role in our success, apply to express your interest.

**What you can expect from our interview process:**

* A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
* An interview with the General Manager to discuss your technology leadership experience, approach to platform modernization, architectural decision-making, and ability to connect technology strategy to business outcomes.
* A final virtual interview with the Portfolio Manager and members of the technology leadership team to explore your approach to leading transformation, collaborating across teams, and building the capabilities needed to execute the technology roadmap.

Aquila and Campana Systems promote equal employment opportunities for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status, marital status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and accommodations are available on request.

Title: eTrading Engineering Lead
Description:
In compliance with applicable laws, HSBC is committed to employing only those who are authorized to work in Canada. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada as HSBC will not engage in immigration sponsorship for this position.
  
  
In Canada, HSBC Global Services (Canada) Limited (HGCA) is a wholly owned subsidiary of HSBC Global Services Limited. Operating in Toronto, HGCA is part of a global service company, delivering services to support the operating entities of HSBC Group. We have different capabilities that provide tools and processes to facilitate the functions, business, and entities with their service management responsibilities.
  
  
**Ready to shape the infrastructure behind low-latency electronic trading platforms?**
**Why HSBC**
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Join Markets and Securities Services Information Technology (IT) as Regional Head of electronic Trading (eTrading) Infrastructure Engineering in Toronto, Canada. This role owns the regional infrastructure engineering capability supporting latency-sensitive and collocated electronic trading platforms. You’ll manage two infrastructure engineers while staying hands-on across data center compute, Linux, server hardware, network switching, and exchange connectivity. You’ll take end-to-end accountability for the regional infrastructure delivery pipeline aligned to agreed business priorities, alongside operational service performance and the regional risk and control agenda. Success means resilient, secure, and cost-effective services, strong control outcomes, and well-governed delivery across collocated data centers and exchange-facing infrastructure.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Oversee and develop two infrastructure engineers, setting objectives, allocating work, and building succession and capability plans
* Own the regional delivery pipeline and roadmap, translating business priorities into committed plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes while managing dependencies and trade-offs
* Manage the regional infrastructure budget, forecasts, and investment cases, controlling capital and operating expenditure and supplier and hardware lifecycle decisions
* Govern service availability, capacity, resilience, and support readiness, coordinating incident, problem, change, and recovery through to permanent remediation
* Own the regional risk and control environment, including technology risk assessment, audit and regulatory actions, security and firmware compliance, evidence quality, and timely issue closure
* Design, build, configure, and troubleshoot infrastructure across collocated and enterprise data centers including Linux platforms, physical servers, network switches, cabling, out-of-band management, and low-latency connectivity
* Define and maintain regional reference architectures, engineering standards, design blueprints, build patterns, and operational procedures aligned with global strategy
* Build repeatable infrastructure delivery and validation pipelines using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated testing, contributing production-quality Java and Ansible code
* Stakeholder management: Partner with trading business, application engineering, architecture, cyber security, operations, risk, finance, procurement, vendors, exchanges and carriers to deliver regional outcomes.
* Regional execution: Lead data-centre builds, migrations, refreshes and exchange onboarding, coordinating suppliers and remote-hands teams and providing hands-on support during critical implementations and incidents.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bring substantial hands-on experience in infrastructure, network, or compute engineering with accountability for regional or business-critical services
* Manage a small engineering team, establishing priorities, assuring delivery, and developing technical capability
* Own budgets, forecasts, vendors, operational performance, and technology risk and control obligations
* Apply deep expertise across Linux, enterprise server hardware, data center and colocation environments, network switches, and physical infrastructure lifecycle management
* Use strong knowledge of low-latency networking including Transmission Control Protocol and Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), routing and switching, multicast, packet capture analysis, and exchange or market data connectivity
* Build continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows and automated, version-controlled infrastructure delivery aligned to a Network Development and Operations (NetDevOps) approach
* Apply Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD) to infrastructure and network engineering using repeatable lab and pre-production validation
* Write production code in Java, or bring equivalent demonstrable production coding experience in Python or a comparable language
* Build Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Ansible including reusable roles and playbooks, automated testing, and integration into delivery pipelines
* Experience supporting electronic trading, market-data or other latency-sensitive financial services infrastructure.
* Professional network certification such as CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure or Data Center, or equivalent depth of experience.
* Experience with Docker, Containerlab, Molecule, Jira, Confluence and CI platforms such as TeamCity.

As an HSBC employee, you will have access to tailored professional development opportunities to ensure you have the right skills for today and tomorrow. We offer a competitive pay and benefits package including a robust Wellness Hub, all in a welcoming and inclusive work environment. You will be empowered to drive HSBC’s engagement with the communities we serve through an industry-leading volunteerism policy, a generous matching gift program, and a comprehensive program of immersive Sustainability and Climate Change Initiatives. You’ll want to join our Employee Resource Groups as they play a central part in life at HSBC, including the development of our employees and networking inside and outside of HSBC. We value difference. We succeed together. We take responsibility. We get it done. And we want you to help us build the bank of the future!

Title: IT Regional Manager, Canada
Description:
TI Automotive supplies safety and performance critical products and highly engineered components to the global automotive industry. We have more than 100 years' experience of solving customers' safety, efficiency and environmental challenges. Our exceptional team, powertrain agnostic product portfolio, vertical integration, global footprint and customer proximity make us a trusted partner to all the world's leading OEMs.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As an IT Regional Manager, Canada, you will be responsible for overseeing and managing the IT Operations infrastructure within the Canadian region. You will ensure that all IT systems, networks, and services across the Company's Canadian facilities are optimized, secure, and aligned with organizational goals. You will oversee a team of IT professionals and collaborate with local and global IT teams to ensure successful integration of IT solutions.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute an IT roadmap for Canada, ensure timely and efficient implementation of new systems, updates, and technologies.
* Work alongside Senior Management to ensure IT strategies are aligned with business goals and regional needs.
* Lead IT projects for the Canadian region, ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and meet specific goals.
* Oversee change management process for new technology implementations, ensuring smooth transitions and user adoption.
* Oversee the regional IT budget, ensuring cost-effective technology investments, and staying within financial constraints.
* Manage the regional IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, storage, and communication systems.
* Ensure continuous monitoring and maintenance of IT systems, with a focus on maximizing uptime and performance of business-critical systems.
* Lead the implementation of digital transformation initiatives within Canadian operations, including automation and IoT solutions.
* Manage relationships with IT vendors and third-party service providers, ensuring contracts and service agreements align with IT needs and requirements. Participate in contract negotiations, if required.
* Work closely with other departments to identify IT needs and ensure regional IT solutions.
* Ensure implementation of IT security policies and procedures to protect organizational data, systems, and intellectual property.
* Oversee disaster recovery and business continuity plans, ensuring that systems can be restored timely in the event of failures.
* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of IT professionals by setting performance goals, conducting regular evaluations, and providing feedback/development opportunities.
* Provide regular updates to senior leadership on regional IT performance, key projects, and challenges.
* Continuously assess and improve IT processes and services, enhancing efficiency, reducing costs, and boosting overall effectiveness.

**Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Relevant certifications, such as ITIL or Microsoft is beneficial.
* Minimum 5-8 years experience in IT operations, or a related role. Minimum 3 years experience in a leadership or management role.
* Proven experience with large-scale IT deployments, system migrations, or IT infrastructure upgrades.
* Prior experience managing, leading, and mentoring a team of IT professionals.
* Prior experience managing IT operations across multiple locations or regions is beneficial.
* Extensive experience in managing IT infrastructure (servers, networks, storage, etc.) and ensuring that these systems are reliable and secure.
* Experience leading IT change management processes, ensuring smooth transitions during technology upgrades, implementations, or system migrations.
* Experience in managing relationships with IT vendors, negotiating contracts, and ensuring service level agreements (SLAs) are met.
* Strong understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and security measures (firewalls, VPNs, encryption) to ensure secure, reliable connectivity across regional operations.
* Sound knowledge of backup and disaster recovery planning, ensuring that critical data and systems can be restored in case of failure.
* Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple IT projects, prioritize resources, track timelines, and ensure projects are completed within scope and budget.
* Ability to align regional IT strategies with overall business goals, ensuring that IT investments and initiatives are in line with company priorities.
* Familiarity with manufacturing and/or automotive industries, including the specific IT requirements, challenges, and technologies used.

**Why TI Automotive?**
**Benefits**
In addition to a workplace that emphasizes respect, teamwork and personal and professional growth, TI Automotive offers a broad range of health, wellness and financial benefits that promote the physical, mental and financial wellbeing of our employees and help them bring their best self to work, including:
  
  

* Competitive compensation package
* Competitive PTO Package
* Employee Group Benefits
* Employee and Family Assistance Program (TELUS Health)
* RRSP/DPSP Company Match
* Educational Assistance Program
* Perkopolis Program
* Vehicle Purchase Discounts
* Social events throughout the year
* Internal job opportunities

Title: Technical Solution Manager
Description:
**Job Description**
Metrolinx is connecting communities across the Greater Golden Horseshoe. Metrolinx operates GO Transit and UP Express, as well as the PRESTO fare payment system. We are also building new and improved rapid transit, including GO Expansion, Light Rail Transit routes, and major expansions to Toronto’s subway system, to get people where they need to go, better, faster and easier. Metrolinx is an agency of the Government of Ontario.
  
  
At Metrolinx, equity, diversity and inclusion are essential to living our values of serving with passion, thinking forward and playing as a team.
  
  
Metrolinx's Innovation and Information Technology group supports female team members via "Go Tech Women" an affinity group for women in Information Technology, led by our Chief Information Officer.
  
  
If you enjoy technology and innovation, value diversity, appreciate work/balance and are looking for an opportunity to make a better world via public service, Metrolinx would like to hear from you!
  
  
Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Foundational Technology and Infrastructure, the Technical Solution Manager is responsible for performing Cloud Infrastructure and Data Centre design-build and leading teams performing the same. Cloud and Data Centre Infrastructure includes but is not limited to Private Clouds, Public Clouds, Hybrid Clouds, Infrastructure-as-Code, Infrastructure-as-a-Service, Platform-as-a-Service and Software-as-a-Service.
  
  
**What will I be doing?**

* Designs and builds foundational technology and infrastructure solutions at scale (e.g. storage, compute, networking, backup, Database, Private Clouds, Public Clouds, Hybrid Clouds, Infrastructure-as-Code, Infrastructure-as-a-Service, Platform-as-a-Service and Software-as-a-Service).
* Collaborate with I&IT teams as a Solution Lead/Integrator to create and maintain Cloud and Data Centre Infrastructure architecture and detailed designs (conceptual, logical, integration and physical).
* Provides hands-on implementation or supports domain subject matter experts in validating designs for deployment, creating build documentation and other transition-to-operations artifacts.
* Works with the Cybersecurity team and ensures security resilience is designed and built into the Cloud Infrastructure solutions.
* Collaborate with I&IT teams to design and implement Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for the lifecycle of the Cloud Infrastructure and the overall solution stack.
* Assists stakeholders such as Solution Architects in designing solutions leveraging Cloud and Data Centre Infrastructure.
* Manages I&IT teams towards successful technical delivery, release, governance and validation of outcomes for assigned I&IT products.
* Provide technical leadership to virtual teams (greater than 15 resources) of vendor resources and internal technical experts responsible for delivering initiatives on assigned product roadmaps.
* Collaborates with I&IT teams and stakeholders to perform system capacity, performance, availability, and health management to meet business needs.

**What Skills and Qualifications Do I Need?**

* Completion of a post-secondary degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline – or a combination of education, training and progressive experience in solution delivery leadership positions deemed equivalent.
* Demonstrated years of related experience contributing to the success of midsize-to-large initiatives with above-average levels of complexity and business criticality
* Leadership, problem-solving, interpersonal, and oral/written/presentation skills
* Proficiency in working with Infrastructure as Code tools and CI/CD pipeline - Ansible and Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub
* Proficiency in designing and implementing solutions with Microsoft Azure IaaS and PaaS
* Proficiency in designing and implementing Cloud and Data Centre Infrastructure with high availability and disaster recovery capabilities
* Experience with the following:

+ Microsoft Hyper-V, SCVMM and VMware virtualization platforms
+ Microsoft SaaS platform - Office 365
+ Load balancers such as F5 LTM and GTM
+ Backup technologies such as Netbackup
+ Identity & access management such as AD, Azure AD and Okta
+ Storage systems – Fibre Channel SAN, Storage Array
+ Compute systems – HPE Synergy, Cisco UCS
+ Operating systems - Windows servers; Linux such as RedHat is an asset
+ Containerization – Kubernetes and Docker are assets
+ Disaster Recovery - HP Zerto and its implementation in multi-site Disaster Recovery
+ Microsoft SQL and multi site DR design and implementation
+ Oracle 19c, EXACC and Dataguard

* Knowledge of networking such as LAN, WAN, Cloud networking, etc.
* Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification is an asset
* Experienced in organizational frameworks for AI (Artificial Intelligence) tooling, deploying new models, risk mitigation, defining safety guardrails, governance policies, and trust standards for deploying emerging agentic technologies and LLM workflows in secure product environments.

**Don’t Meet Every Requirement?**
If you’re excited about working with Metrolinx but your past experience doesn’t quite align with every qualification of this posting, we encourage you to apply. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles. We are always looking for great talent to join our team.
  
  
We invite all interested individuals to apply and encourage applications from members of equity-deserving communities, including those who identify as Indigenous, Black, racialized, women, people with disabilities, and people with diverse gender identities, expressions and sexual orientations.

Metrolinx is an equal opportunity employer and committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. We are also committed to offering reasonable accommodation to job applicants in accordance with applicable legislation. If you require assistance or an accommodation at any point during the hiring process, please contact us at: 416-202-5601 or email hr.recruitment@metrolinx.com.

All applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada. Metrolinx will be using email to communicate with you for all job competitions. It is your responsibility to include an updated email address that is checked daily and accepts emails from unknown users. As we send time-sensitive correspondence, we recommend that you check your email regularly. If no response is received, we will assume you are no longer interested in pursuing the opportunity. Title: Head of Projects
Description:

Title: Technical Operations Center Manager
Description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
  
  
As a Technical Operations Center (TOC) Manager, you will be one of three global managers operating in a "Follow the Sun" model, ensuring continuous 24/7 coverage and operational excellence across our technical infrastructure. This role is accountable for more than ticket throughput. It turns operational signals into measurable reliability outcomes by strengthening service ownership, leading disciplined incident response, reducing repeat failure and toil, and moving the organization toward proactive, increasingly automated operations. Your leadership will be crucial in facilitating seamless handoffs between shifts, maintaining high performance, and upholding and improving they systems and processes that create operational drag.
  
  
**Job Functions**
Service Reliability & Operational Leadership
  
  

* Lead day-to-day operations for the Technical Operations Center, ensuring critical infrastructure and services are operated safely, reliably and consistently.
* Establish and maintain a service-centric operating rhythm covering service ownership, criticality, dependencies, SLOs/SLIs, incident trends, capacity, risk and operational readiness.
* Partner with service owners, engineering, cybersecurity, business technology teams and vendors to identify reliability risks before they become business-impacting incidents.
* Use observability, telemetry and service health data to improve detection, prioritization and decision-making.
* Maintain a regular operating review and publish a concise scorecard focused on outcomes rather than activity.

Major Incident Management & Swarming
  
  

* Lead or sponsor response to major incidents, acting as Incident Commander or ensuring the appropriate command structure is in place.
* Establish clear incident roles, escalation triggers, communication standards and decision rights for high-severity events.
* Make swarming repeatable through shared queues, structured triage-ready information and timely engagement of the right technical and business partners.
* Coordinate internal teams and third-party providers through restoration, stakeholder communication and service validation.
* Ensure blameless postmortems convert incident learning into prioritized problem-management, reliability and prevention work.

Problem Management, Toil Reduction & Automation
  
  

* Maintain a ranked backlog of repeat incidents, operational toil, alert noise and manual work, with owners and measurable outcomes.
* Drive the conversion of repeatable procedures into versioned runbooks, scripts, workflows, automation and self-service capabilities.
* Apply AI-assisted triage and knowledge discovery where appropriate, with human oversight, security controls, auditability and clear escalation paths.
* Improve the quality, findability and lifecycle management of operational knowledge, including runbooks, known-error records, as-builts and shift documentation.
* Track automation adoption and toil hours avoided using the results to redirect capacity toward reliability engineering and service improvement.

Change, Release & Operational Readiness
  
  

* Strengthen risk-tiered change practices, including pre-checks, peer review, testing evidence, implementation plans, monitoring and rollback readiness.
* Partner with engineering and delivery teams to shift operational readiness earlier in the lifecycle, including supportability, observability, runbooks and ownership before release.
* Analyze change-related incidents and failure patterns leading corrective actions that improve change success and reduce recovery time.
* Support paved-road standards and a transparent exception process for common infrastructure, cloud, identity, network and systems patterns.

Global Coordination & Follow-the-Sun Operations
  
  

* Facilitate structured handoffs between global teams, ensuring the incoming shift receives current service health, active incidents, risks, decisions, next actions and escalation needs.
* Maintain consistent severity, response, handoff, change and review practices across regions while respecting local context and coverage requirements.
* Build strong working relationships across time zones, technical domains, business units and strategic vendors.
* Participate in a rotating global coverage and escalation model, including occasional out-of-hours or weekend coverage when required. The schedule should support sustainable coverage rather than routine weekend office attendance.

People Leadership & Capability Building
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop Technical Operations Center specialists, creating a culture of accountability, learning, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Set clear expectations for performance, incident leadership, documentation, operational discipline and customer experience.
* Hire, onboard and develop talent while building role-based learning paths and cross-training plans for critical domains.
* Establish resilient coverage with documented SME and backup relationships, reducing key-person dependency.

**Skills/Abilities**
Job Requirements:
  
  

* Deep technical knowledge in infrastructure operations, site reliability, platform operations or related disciplines.
* Ability to assess impact, prioritize under pressure, communicate clearly and make sound decisions during high-severity events.
* Experience with service ownership, observability, SLOs/SLIs, operational readiness, runbooks and reliability metrics.
* Experience reducing operational toil through scripting, workflow automation, self-service or similar engineering practices.
* Working knowledge of cloud, identity, network, systems and/or enterprise infrastructure operations.
* Ability to build trust across engineering, security, business technology, vendors and geographically distributed teams.
* Commitment to blameless learning, continuous improvement and inclusive people leadership.

**Experience**

* Eight or more years of progressive experience in infrastructure operations, site reliability, platform operations, IT service management or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Three or more years leading technical teams, major incident response, operational programs or cross-functional reliability initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience operating mission-critical infrastructure or applications in a complex, globally distributed environment.
* Strong working knowledge of incident, problem, change, service-level and knowledge-management practices.
* Experience leading a follow-the-sun operating model or global shift handoff process is preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AI-assisted operations, event correlation, anomaly detection or intelligent triage, with appropriate governance and human review.
* Experience implementing or improving a service catalog, SLO framework, error-budget practices or reliability scorecard.
* Experience with ITSM, observability, automation/orchestration and knowledge-management platforms.
* ITIL, SRE, cloud, automation or related certification.
* Experience leading a follow-the-sun operating model or global shift handoff process.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Industry-standard IT certifications are desirable; ITIL, SRE, cloud or automation certifications are a plus.

Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. Here are some of the ways we support you along the way (and just a few of the benefits we offer):

A variety of ways to prioritize much-needed time away from work including:

Title: Manager, Security and Compliance
Description:
Skillable is a 100% remote and virtual tech company that’s modernizing the world of training. Come share your professional magic with highly talented, driven and fun colleagues who believe in the power of “skilling.” Experience what a team focused on doing the right thing feels like!

Our talented people are what makes us friendly and have fun! We work together to create amazing solutions and experiences for our customers and their clients. The **Manager, Security and Compliance** leads the Cybersecurity and GRC teams that protect Skillable, its customers and its data. Own security operations, risk management and audit programs, using AI to scale the work while governing its safe use across the business. Translate security and compliance risk into clear business decisions for executives, customers and auditors and ensure teams have the strategy, priorities and direction needed to strengthen Skillable’s security posture.

**What You Will Do:**

* Own security operations, including identity, cloud security, vulnerability management and threat detection and response.
* Build a detection and response as code practice, using AI agents to triage alerts and automate response, with detections and playbooks managed in version control and tested.
* Own risk management, security policies and the SOC 2, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 audit programs.
* Own the GRC platform and build a GRC engineering practice that uses code, integrations and AI agents to automate control monitoring and evidence collection.
* Run the AI governance program under ISO 42001, including the AI system inventory and AI risk and impact assessments.
* Manage third-party risk, using AI to speed vendor reviews while keeping a person accountable for every decision.

* Build a security-aware culture through practical training, including the safe use of AI tools.

* Lead the team's shift to AI-assisted work, finding where agents can take on tasks while the team stays accountable for every outcome.

* Other strategic business initiatives or cross-functional project involvement as required.

* 8+ years of information security experience across security operations and compliance.
* 2+ years of professional work experience in a leadership position. Direct management oversight required.
* Action oriented in thoughtfully evaluating how and where AI can enhance work, while applying sound judgment, critical thinking, and appropriate human oversight.
* Natural curiosity and adaptability in learning, adopting and applying emerging AI capabilities to evolve ways of working across individual responsibilities and departments.
* Proven experience mentoring and developing people, as well as, promoting best practices and standards within department and industry.
* Experience running SOC 2, ISO 27001 or ISO 42001 audit programs.
* Hands-on experience administering a GRC platform and automating controls and evidence through GRC engineering and AI.
* Familiarity with detection and response as code, including version-controlled detections, automated response playbooks and AI-assisted triage.
* Working knowledge of GDPR, US state privacy laws and the EU AI Act.
* Hands-on experience using AI agents in security or compliance work, and understanding of the risks they introduce.
* Track record of running security as a business enabler and explaining risk clearly to non-technical audiences.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA or ISO 42001 Lead Implementer are a plus.
* Confidence operating in an influential role, working collaboratively in cross-functional teams and contributing to company-wide initiatives.
* Proven ability to define short and long term strategy for scalability, operational efficiency and to ultimately drive execution.
* Proven ability to communicate effectively to various audiences/levels, both internal and external stakeholders, including leadership through various mediums.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize and manage workload and meet project deadlines.

* Strong Microsoft suite experience, including teams or similar web conferencing and internal communication software experience preferred.
