Title: Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Repairs
Description:
**About Cat5 Resources LLC**

Cat5 Resources is a diversified supplier of technical and operational services across the Southern US, Puerto Rico, and the US Virgin Islands.

In 2004, when Hurricane Charley devastated Florida, our CEO, Cindy Perez, received an out-of-the-blue call from a long-term telecom client in urgent need of help. Their other vendors could not deliver, so they turned to Cindy for assistance. She responded without hesitation, mobilizing a fleet of generators and emergency fuel to ensure the client’s critical infrastructure remained operational throughout the event.

In 2013, Cindy founded Cat5 Resources with a mission to provide reliable and innovative solutions for critical infrastructure resiliency. Since then, the Cat5 Resources team has consistently delivered exceptional customer service to clients nationwide. Over the years, Cat5 Resources has expanded its offerings to include Disaster Recovery Services, Operations and Maintenance, Civil, Electrical, and Construction, as well as Transportation and Logistics.

As a certified Woman-Owned Business, Cat5 Resources serves the entire Southern United States. In 2016, we extended our services into Puerto Rico with the launch of Cat5 Caribbean, focusing on critical infrastructure support in disaster-prone regions. Further expanding our capabilities, in 2024, we introduced Cat5 Power Solutions, our Portable Power Sales and Rentals Division, delivering versatile power solutions to businesses and communities across the Southern US.

**Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Repairs**
================================================================

**Cat5 Resources**

**Position summary**
--------------------

The Project Manager runs Cat5’s nationwide generator preventive maintenance and repair program for a national wireless infrastructure client with thousands of backup power units in service across the U.S. The role owns the full asset lifecycle: receiving decommissioned generators and ATS units, deciding repair vs. dispose, overseeing refurbishment and testing, managing stored inventory, and fulfilling orders to sites on time.

**Department**

Operations – Generator Services

**Reports to**

Director of Operations

**Location**

Remote with travel to field sites or client location if needed

**Type**

Full-time, exempt

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Program and client management**

* Serve as the client’s main point of contact; run regular status meetings and escalations.
* Build and manage the program plan, budget, staffing and subcontractor mix (in-house vs. third party).
* Get all subcontractors through the client’s qualification process before they access any site.
* Maintain and update Cat5’s hours and company information in Avetta so qualification and compliance status stay current.
* Track and report performance against contract SLAs: preventive maintenance completion, repair response times, first-time fix rates, equipment uptime and work-order closeout.
* Protect client confidential information.
* Turn around client quote requests and purchase orders quickly, within contract response times.
* Track every scheduled service and repair commitment; flag at-risk work orders early and communicate revised completion dates.

**Preventive maintenance and corrective repairs**

* Oversee preventive maintenance inspections and service of installed diesel and natural gas generators and ATS units.
* Review inspection findings, diagnose reported failures, and provide written repair recommendations and estimates for client approval.
* Schedule and oversee corrective repairs to controllers, alternators, starting systems, fuel systems, cooling systems, breakers, batteries, fuel tanks and enclosures.
* Coordinate ATS inspections, testing, troubleshooting and repairs, including contactors, controls, relays and communication components.
* Enforce QA through service checklists, operational testing, inspection reports, photographs and complete asset-level work-order records.
* Manage repair warranties, repeat-failure investigations and complete service documentation.
* Ensure maintenance and repairs comply with applicable safety, environmental and waste-handling requirements, including oils, coolant, batteries and fuel.
* Ensure technicians document generator operating conditions, alarms, fluid levels, battery condition and test results during site visits.
* Submit repair quotes for client approval and do not perform work requiring authorization before written approval is received.
* Maintain complete preventive maintenance and repair history for each client-owned asset.
* Coordinate qualified subcontractors and specialty repair vendors when work cannot be self-performed.
* Escalate generators requiring major repair or replacement recommendations with supporting diagnostics and cost estimates.

**Parts and materials management**

* Maintain availability of service parts, filters, fluids, batteries and critical repair components.
* Monitor critical parts stock and forecast material requirements based on scheduled maintenance and repair trends.
* Publish reports on parts usage, open repairs, backorders and material-related service delays.
* Source OEM-approved or client-authorized replacement parts through approved vendors.
* Record parts consumption and purchasing in designated systems and provide required client reporting.
* Use maintenance schedules and historical consumption to plan recurring service materials.
* Review critical spare-parts levels and lead times with the client.
* Support client audits of maintenance records, work orders and subcontractor compliance.

**Field operations and technician coordination**

* Assign preventive maintenance routes and repair dispatches based on technician qualifications, geography and priority.
* Monitor technician productivity, service quality, safety compliance and work-order completion.
* Coordinate follow-up visits, parts availability and client communication for incomplete repairs.

**Scheduling, dispatch and work-order management**

* Manage multi-site maintenance schedules, dispatch priorities and travel logistics across assigned territories.
* Complete scheduled preventive maintenance and corrective repairs within contractual service windows.
* Escalate missed appointments, access issues, outages and repair delays; keep the client informed.
* Track work-order status, technician assignments, service dates and outstanding actions.
* Close out each work order with labor, parts, test results, photographs and client-required documentation.
* Investigate repeat service calls, incomplete repairs and workmanship concerns.
* Ensure proper handling and disposal of used oil, filters, coolant, batteries and other service waste.

**Site services**

* Plan preventive maintenance visits, troubleshooting, load testing and repairs at tower and other remote sites with client operations teams.
* Make sure field technicians hold the required electrical and mechanical certifications and follow site safety rules.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of project or program management in field services, equipment repair, logistics or telecom infrastructure.
* 3+ years working with diesel or natural gas standby generators and automatic transfer switches (ATS).
* Working knowledge of Generac and Kohler generator platforms and their controllers.
* Experience managing field preventive maintenance and generator repair programs with testing and QA documentation.
* Parts and materials management experience: serialized asset tracking, cycle counts, stock levels and demand planning.
* Experience managing subcontractors and vendors, including qualification, scheduling and performance.
* Comfortable working from contract terms: POs, work orders, SLAs, service scopes and warranties.
* Strong Excel skills and experience with field service, maintenance management or work-order systems.
* Clear written reporting to an enterprise client on a daily, weekly and monthly cadence.
* Able to work independently and remotely, and to manage on-site work from a distance.
* Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* EGSA Generator Technician certification, or prior hands-on generator technician experience.
* Experience with tower or cell-site backup power programs for a national carrier or tower company.
* Experience with preventive maintenance programs, generator diagnostics, emergency repairs and remote field service.
* Knowledge of applicable environmental and safety requirements for fuel, fluids, batteries and field maintenance.
* Familiarity with OSHA 10/30 and site-access qualification for subcontractors.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

* Based primarily at our Power Solutions location in Jasper, TX, with coordination of remote field operations.
* Travel to repair vendors and field sites, up to 40% of the time.
* Availability outside normal hours for generator outages, emergency repairs and storm response.
* Field visits involve tower-site conditions, heat, noise, outdoor weather and required PPE.
* Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs and walk uneven ground at sites.

**Success measures**
--------------------

* On-time preventive maintenance completion and work-order closeout.
* Repair quote, dispatch and service response within contract requirements.
* Every service visit documented with required inspections, test results and asset identification.
* Daily, weekly and monthly client reports delivered complete and on time.
* Improved generator uptime, reduced repeat failures and timely resolution of deficiencies.
* Low repeat-repair rates, strong safety performance and zero unauthorized work.
* Invoices submitted promptly after work is accepted.

**Equal opportunity**
---------------------

Cat5 Resources is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected status. Employment may be contingent on a background check and drug screen.

* Keep a detailed repair history for every repaired client-owned unit.

* Manage nationwide transport, storage and preservation of assets, with handling and transit risk controls.
* Fulfill orders for refurbished and replacement units and parts to designated sites within agreed lead times.
* Run the escalation process for delays and keep the client informed.
* Track title and risk-of-loss transfer points on every shipment.
* Close out each order in our system with tracking and serial numbers sent to the client.
* Process dead-on-arrival returns and freight damage claims with proper documentation.
* Handle hazardous materials and disposal correctly, with disposal reporting to the client.

**Site services**

* Plan generator removal and replacement at tower sites with the client’s operations and construction teams.
* Make sure field technicians hold the required electrical and mechanical certifications and follow site safety rules.

* 3+ years working with diesel or natural gas standby generators and automatic transfer switches (ATS).
* Working knowledge of Generac and Kohler generator platforms and their controllers.
* Experience managing a repair, refurbishment or reverse-logistics operation with testing and QA documentation.
* Inventory management experience: serialized asset tracking, cycle counts, stock levels and demand planning.
* Experience managing subcontractors and vendors, including qualification, scheduling and performance.

**Job Description**

As Head of Business Systems Product & Transformation for Fiix, Rockwell Automation's cloud-based maintenance management (CMMS) and asset management software business, you will own the systems and processes that run our software business from lead to cash to renewal.

  
  
  

Your first and most important priority is to perform: stabilize and run the business systems that support Fiix today. You will reduce a significant backlog, bring clear ownership and priorities, strengthen platform reliability and deliver at high velocity for Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success and Support.

  
  
  

Once the foundation is stable, you will lead the transformation: working with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation program to define the future-state operating model for the Fiix business (how our processes, systems and teams work across the Rockwell Automation organization) and to deliver coordinated outcomes across the software portfolio, including FactoryTalk Hub.

  
  
  

You will lead a team of Lead Product Managers across three areas – Go-to-Market & Salesforce CRM, Product & Integration (including FactoryTalk Hub), and Revenue & Support Operations – and partner closely with a dedicated PMO and a business systems engineering team to turn strategy into delivered results.

  
  
  

**What Fiix Business Systems Does**

Our business systems connect how Fiix markets, sells, quotes, provisions, bills and supports its customers. The platform spans Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ), revenue and billing systems, middleware and integrations, product provisioning, and marketing and customer success tools. Today these systems are dedicated to Fiix. As Rockwell Automation's enterprise systems and software portfolio evolve, including FactoryTalk Hub, this role will help determine how Fiix systems and processes should work alongside them.

  
  
  

**Your Responsibilities**

Perform: Stabilize & Execute

* Stabilize the Fiix business systems in the first 6–12 months: triage and reduce the backlog, fix the highest-impact issues and restore confidence with business stakeholders.
* Establish clear ownership, service levels and measures of success for core systems and processes (e.g., backlog age, quote-to-cash cycle time, system reliability, data quality).
* Partner with the PMO on a single intake process, prioritization, capacity planning, budget and status reporting.
* Partner with the business systems engineering lead on release planning, platform stability and delivery quality.
* Run a regular operating rhythm: weekly prioritization, regular delivery cycles and monthly roadmap reviews with business stakeholders.
* Reduce backlog and operational friction through clear ownership, process simplification and automation.
* Keep near-term delivery aligned with the enterprise direction so today's work does not create rework later.
  

  
  

Strategy & Roadmap

* Own the end-to-end vision, multi-quarter roadmap and architecture principles across nine domains: go-to-market, Salesforce enterprise architecture, product provisioning, middleware and integration, case management and support, finance systems (FinTech), marketing technology, customer technology and data.
* Set priorities across the three product areas, balancing business value, risk, cost and engineering capacity.
* Translate company and business-unit goals into a clear roadmap and measurable outcomes (e.g., quote-to-cash cycle time, forecast accuracy, data quality, backlog age, system adoption).
* Establish architectural standards and governance for changes that cross systems and teams.
  

  
  

Leadership & Team Development

* Lead, coach and develop Lead Product Managers; set clear decision rights, priorities and performance expectations.
* Build a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Recruit for open roles and strengthen capability through talent development and succession planning.
  

  
  

Cross-Functional Partnership

* Be a trusted advisor to Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, Support, Product and IT leaders.
* Balance stakeholder priorities and facilitate cross-functional governance and communication.
* Coordinate with Product Engineering and IT on product provisioning, integrations, identity and access.
* Keep management, peers and team members informed on priorities, progress and risks. Transform: Future-State Operating Model
* As the business stabilizes, lead the shift to transformation in partnership with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation team.
* Serve as the Fiix business systems lead with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation team, representing Fiix requirements in future-state design, release planning and roadmap decisions.
* Develop a multi-year strategy that evaluates, process by process, the right future-state approach for Fiix (keeping Fiix-specific systems, connecting with Rockwell Automation enterprise systems, or adopting shared capabilities as they become ready), with clear decision points, sequencing and risks.
* Define the architecture and data model needed to give customers a seamless experience across Fiix, Rockwell Automation enterprise systems and the software portfolio, including FactoryTalk Hub, across quoting, ordering, provisioning, billing, renewal and support.
* Lead change management for the Fiix business as the operating model evolves, protecting business continuity and customer experience.
* Build strong working relationships with enterprise transformation, IT, Finance and portfolio product leaders to deliver coordinated outcomes.
  

  
  

**The Essentials - You Will Have:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of relevant work experience.
* Legal authorization to work in Canada or the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.
* Ability to travel, including internationally, up to 25% of the time.

**The Preferred - You Might Also Have:**

* Experience owning a roadmap for Salesforce-based go-to-market and quote-to-cash systems.
* Experience leading business systems transformation, operating model design or platform modernization (e.g., CRM/quote-to-cash modernization or post-acquisition operating model design).

* Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and CPQ, and connected tools (e.g., NetSuite, Boomi, Gainsight, Marketo, LeanData, Zendesk).
* Experience leading organizational change, restructuring teams or scaling operations.
* Experience working in a product management / PMO / engineering operating model and with agile delivery.

* Familiarity with industrial software, asset management or maintenance (CMMS) markets.
* Experience defining the operating model for a SaaS business within a larger, multi-business enterprise.
* Experience working with large, multi-year enterprise transformation programs and global IT organizations.

Title: Senior Manager, Specialty Operations (Remote)
Description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Senior Manager of Specialty Operations to support the operational execution of our new specialty product launch. This role will be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day execution of specialty distribution, specialty pharmacy, and patient support operations for a rare disease product, with an initial focus on the successful commercialization of the new product launch. The role will also collaborate closely with Account Managers, Field Reimbursement Managers, and other internal stakeholders to resolve complex issues, improve processes, and ensure a seamless patient and provider experience.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Specialty Distribution Partner Management:**

* Support day-to-day operational execution across specialty pharmacy and specialty distribution services, ensuring coordination with internal teams and timely escalation of operational barriers.Partner with vendor program managers across specialty pharmacy and specialty distribution services to support operational activities, monitor open issues, and facilitate timely issue resolution and follow-up actions.

* Monitor and maintain operational performance standards with specialty distribution partners, ensuring alignment with agreed-upon service levels, KPIs, and regulatory requirements.

* Coordinate resolution of operational barriers involving prescription processing, medical benefit reimbursement, buy-and-bill, institutional procurement, billing and claims, and alignment of product delivery with treatment scheduling, engaging appropriate functional experts as needed. Create and manage various channel/SD/SP communications and documents

* Work closely with the Channel Operations team to monitor/maintain optimal inventory levels.

* Support the maintenance, implementation, and periodic review of established business rules and operational procedures with specialty distribution partners.

* Contribute to development of product and channel specific contract strategies

  
  

**Collaboration with Internal Stakeholders:**

* Coordinate operational activities across the vendor program manager, Access Strategy, Patient Services, Trade & Distribution, Data & Analytics, and field leadership.

* Maintain documented responsibilities and handoffs, and route strategic, policy, and customer-facing decisions to the accountable function. Work cross-functionally with Market Access on product access issues and Medical team on resource development and pull-through.

* Develop relationships and work closely with the Patient Services team and/or Field Reimbursement Managers to help resolve patient/ provider access issues.

* Provide regular updates regarding partner performance, patient access issues, and any operational challenges, continuously evolving/challenging our support model with learnings related to medical/pharmacy benefit coverage learnings

* Collaborate with the team to continuously improve patient services and operational processes, including reviewing and optimizing workflows to enhance the overall customer experience.

  
  

**Issue Investigation & Resolution:**

* Take ownership of investigating operational issues and work with internal and external teams to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.

* Address challenges related to patient enrollment, medication distribution, insurance verification, or other issues impacting pharmacy operations.

* Escalate critical issues as needed and ensure effective communication with all relevant parties to resolve problems quickly and efficiently.

  
  

**Reporting & Data Analysis:**

* Identify appropriate metrics and tracking to ensure the right execution and success; analyze procedure volume, trends and growth for the specialty channel.

* Compile operational metrics, document performance trends, and provide reporting support for management reviews and business update meetings. Provide regular reports on operational performance, issue resolution, and process improvements to the Director of Specialty Operations.

* Analyze specialty reporting and work with data and analytics team to create patient, provider, physician, pharmacy and payer data dashboards in order to help improve processes

* Monitor specialty distributor/pharmacy data (ie; Time to First Fill, Conversion Rate, Gap days and Adherence)

  
  

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Participate in regular process improvement initiatives aimed at optimizing specialty distribution network operations and enhancing the patient experience.

* Provide input into the development and refinement of training materials, operational procedures, and best practices for working with specialty pharmacy partners.

  
  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelors degree from an accredited four-year college or university.

* Minimum 3–5 years of relevant pharmaceutical industry experience, including hands-on management of specialty partner operations, patient services, and complex access workflows. Demonstrated experience coordinating hub, specialty pharmacy, and specialty distribution services and managing vendor performance is required.

* Experience with medical benefit therapies, institutional delivery, and launch implementation is preferred.

* Experience evaluating data sources for insights, specifically specialty distribution and patient services data.

* Strong communication skills, including the ability to communicate the data management subject matter to a non-technical/unfamiliar internal customer.

* Pharmacy experience preferred

**Competencies**  
**Accountability for Results -** Stay focused on key strategic objectives, be accountable for high standards of performance, and take an active role in leading change.
  
**Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving -** Make decisions considering the long-term impact to customers, patients, employees, and the business.
  
**Patient & Customer Centricity -** Maintain an ongoing focus on the needs of our customers and/or key stakeholders.
  
**Impactful Communication -** Communicate with logic, clarity, and respect. Influence at all levels to achieve the best results for Otsuka.
  
**Respectful Collaboration -** Seek and value others’ perspectives and strive for diverse partnerships to enhance work toward common goals.
  
**Empowered Development -** Play an active role in professional development as a business imperative.

Title: Digitalisation & Technology Manager
Description:
Six Construct, a subsidiary of the BESIX Group, is the largest Belgian construction company operating in the Middle East. The company combines the efforts of a highly skilled workforce, along with strategic planning and innovative use of technology to overcome the most complex business challenges. Six Construct is a multi-services company that operates in the construction of commercial and residential buildings, sport and leisure facilities, infrastructure and marine-related projects. The company currently employs a workforce of approximately 4,000 in the Middle East, and a total of 10,000 worldwide.

**Job Description**

**Why This Role Matters**

We are seeking a forward-thinking
**Digital & Technology Manager**
to drive the digital transformation agenda across our business. This role will be responsible for identifying, evaluating, and implementing innovative technologies that improve operational efficiency, project delivery, collaboration, and data-driven decision-making.

The successful candidate will play a key role in shaping our digital strategy, fostering a culture of innovation, and ensuring the effective adoption of emerging technologies, including AI, automation, advanced analytics, digital platforms, and construction technologies. The role will work closely with business leaders, operations teams, project teams, and external technology partners to create measurable business value.

**What You'll Drive**

* Shape the digital journey of the new construction company, defining how technology and data can support the company from start-up through its first project and subsequent growth.
* Embed digitalisation from Day 1, ensuring new processes are designed digitally rather than reproducing traditional construction processes and legacy ways of working.
* Continuously scout and evaluate modern technologies that could improve productivity, quality, collaboration, speed of delivery and decision-making, including AI, automation, mobile solutions, reality capture, BIM, data analytics and emerging construction technologies.
* Translate innovation into practical use cases, working directly with project and functional teams to identify pain points, test solutions and demonstrate measurable operational value.
* Build a culture of experimentation, enabling rapid pilots and proof-of-concepts while quickly stopping initiatives that do not demonstrate sufficient value.
* Create a connected digital environment, avoiding fragmented applications and information silos and ensuring that data can progressively become a business asset.
* Establish a scalable technology foundation capable of supporting the first project and evolving as the new Construction Company grows, without creating unnecessary complexity or legacy constraints.
* Ensure security and confidentiality by design, making these requirements an integral part of technology selection and digital processes rather than an obstacle to innovation. Confidentiality and control of information are foundational principles of the new Construction Company.
* Connect business, construction and technology, acting as the interface between management, project teams, technical functions, technology providers and specialist partners.

**Qualifications**

**You're a Great Fit If You Have**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
* Proven experience leading digital transformation, innovation, or technology-driven business improvement initiatives.
* Experience implementing digital platforms, automation tools, AI solutions, analytics platforms, or enterprise technologies.
* Strong understanding of change management and technology adoption.
* Demonstrated ability to bridge business needs and technology solutions.
* Experience within construction, engineering, infrastructure, industrial, manufacturing, energy, logistics, or other project-based industries is preferred but not mandatory.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Passion for innovation, emerging technologies, and continuous improvement.

**Preferred**

* Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI
* Automation and Digital Workflows
* Data Analytics and Business Intelligence (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
* BIM and Digital Construction Technologies
* Common Data Environments (ACC, BIM 360, ProjectWise, etc.)
* Digital Twins, IoT, Reality Capture, or Smart Infrastructure Solutions
* Cloud-based collaboration and enterprise platforms

**Additional Information**

**What Success Looks Like**

* Digital principles are embedded into the company's operating model from day one.
* Core business systems and digital platforms are successfully implemented.
* Manual and repetitive processes are reduced through automation and digital workflows.
* Measurable productivity improvements are achieved through technology adoption.
* Data-driven decision-making becomes part of everyday operations.
* The organization develops a sustainable culture of innovation and continuous improvement.
* A secure, scalable, and integrated digital ecosystem supports future business growth.

Title: Group Operational Asset Lifecycle Manager
Description:
Job description:
  
  

**Group Operational Asset Lifecycle Manager**

We are a leading independent telecoms infrastructure company, with one of the most extensive tower portfolios across Africa and the Middle East. Our business model promotes tower infrastructure sharing and enables mobile network operators (MNOs) to deliver mobile connectivity more quickly, reliably, cost-effectively and with a lower carbon footprint. In turn, this supports the expansion and quality of mobile connectivity, driving sustainable development in our markets.

**What we do**

We build, acquire, lease-up and operate telecommunications towers that can accommodate and power the needs of multiple tenants. Our tenants are major mobile network operators (MNOs), and we serve them across nine high-growth markets: eight in Africa and Oman in the Middle East. Our purpose, mission and sustainable business strategy are underpinned by our values of integrity, partnership and excellence.

**Overview**

Reporting into the Operations & Performance Engineering function, you will develop, govern and improve Group operational asset lifecycle strategies for telecommunications infrastructure assets. You will help ensure strong operational performance, reliability, safety, QHSE compliance and long-term value across the asset portfolio.

Working with Engineering, Operations, Finance, Procurement, IT and Maintenance Partners, you will lead lifecycle planning, asset performance optimisation, change governance, capital investment planning and asset information management. You will use data-led decision-making and digital asset management to improve lifecycle costs, governance and engineering standards across the Group.

**Location:**
UAE or South Africa
  
**Travel:**
Approximately 6–12 times per year

**Role responsibilities**

As Group Operational Asset Lifecycle Manager, you will be responsible for:

* Developing Group lifecycle and governance strategies for power systems, shelters and associated infrastructure.
* Preparing and implementing long-term asset replacement, refurbishment and renewal plans.
* Establishing and governing asset refurbishment programmes across operating companies.
* Improving preventive, predictive and condition-based maintenance strategies to strengthen reliability and extend asset life.
* Optimising total cost of ownership, return on invested capital and asset utilisation through effective lifecycle investment decisions.
* Owning the Group Asset Change Governance process for engineering modifications, integrations, transfers, refurbishments, relocations and disposals.
* Establishing and improving the Group Asset Governance Framework, including asset ownership, approval authorities, engineering acceptance and retirement controls.
* Developing the annual maintenance CAPEX investment programme and prioritising work according to asset condition, criticality and operational risk.
* Monitoring and reporting asset health, reliability, utilisation and effectiveness, using analytics to identify improvement opportunities.
* Governing asset information standards and data quality across Group systems, including asset master data, serialisation, configuration records and technical documentation.

**Requirements for the role**

To succeed in the role, you will have:

* A degree in Engineering, Business, Asset Management or a related technical discipline.
* 7–10 years’ experience in telecommunications infrastructure or another asset-intensive industry.
* At least five years’ experience leading asset management, asset governance or engineering lifecycle management in a multi-site environment.
* Experience with enterprise asset management (EAM), lifecycle costing, asset master data governance and engineering change control.
* Experience in digital asset management, asset analytics and using data to inform lifecycle decisions.
* A background in telecommunications infrastructure, power systems or utilities.

**Desired skills and qualifications**

* ISO 55001 Asset Management qualification or experience applying its principles.
* IAM Certificate or Diploma.
* Certified Asset Management Assessor (CAMA) qualification.
* Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP) qualification.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 qualification.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt.

**Benefits**

* Competitive basic salary
* Discretionary bonus
* Health insurance
* Life insurance

Please submit your application within four weeks of the advert being published.

Helios Towers is committed to promoting equal opportunities in employment. You and all job applicants will receive equal treatment regardless of age, disability, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief.

Title: IT Director of Operations
Description:
**Job Summary**
Reporting to the VP of Infrastructure, the IT Director of Operations provides strategic and operational leadership for the organization's Service Desk, Field Services, IT Service Management, Change Control, Major Incident Management, Problem Management, service request fulfillment, and end-user support functions. This role is accountable for delivering reliable, responsive, secure, and consistent technology support to corporate offices, service centers, remote workers, and operating locations.
  
  
The Director establishes a customer-focused operating model, develops high-performing support teams, improves service quality through standardization and automation, and ensures operational processes produce measurable improvements in user experience, service availability, response time, resolution time, change success, and cost efficiency. The position partners closely with Infrastructure Engineering, Information Security, Enterprise Applications, Clinical Applications, Human Resources, Compliance, Finance, vendors, and business leaders, and serves as a senior leader during major incidents and high-risk changes.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Provide leadership, direction, and accountability for Service Desk, Field Services, IT Service Management, Change Control, Major Incident Management, Problem Management, and related operational support functions, including organizational design, workforce planning, recruiting, coaching, succession planning, performance management, and professional development.
* Develop and maintain a multi-year IT operations strategy and service improvement roadmap aligned with business growth, acquisitions, technology modernization, cybersecurity requirements, financial objectives, employee experience, and operational risk tolerance.
* Own the Service Desk operating model, including intake channels, call handling, ticket triage, prioritization, escalation, request fulfillment, knowledge management, shift coverage, quality assurance, customer communications, and service-level performance.
* Lead Field Services and deskside support across distributed locations, including onsite incident resolution, device deployment and recovery, site support, technology readiness for openings and relocations, executive support, inventory coordination, and local vendor management.
* Own IT service management practices and governance, including incident, request, major incident, problem, change, knowledge, service catalog, configuration, and continual improvement processes, using ITIL-aligned practices and clearly defined ownership, controls, and measures.
* Lead enterprise Change Control and the Change Advisory Board process. Establish risk and impact criteria, approval thresholds, peer and technical review requirements, testing expectations, implementation and rollback standards, maintenance-window governance, emergency change controls, post-implementation validation, and reporting.
* Serve as the senior operational leader for major technology incidents. Ensure rapid business-impact assessment, clear command and escalation structures, timely stakeholder communications, cross-team coordination, service restoration, executive updates, after-action reviews, root-cause analysis, and completion of corrective actions.
* Establish problem management practices that identify recurring incidents and service degradation, prioritize root-cause investigation, assign accountable owners, track known errors and workarounds, and verify that permanent corrective actions reduce repeat demand.
* Build and govern a usable service catalog, supported by defined services, request offerings, ownership, fulfillment workflows, service targets, knowledge articles, and customer-facing expectations.
* Improve employee technology experience through self-service, automation, shift-left support, remote-support tools, standardized knowledge, proactive communications, customer feedback, and reduction of avoidable contacts and repeat incidents.
* Partner with engineering, security, and application teams to establish effective operational handoffs, support readiness, monitoring and alert response, escalation paths, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria before new or changed services enter production.
* Ensure effective joiner, mover, and leaver support in coordination with Human Resources, Identity and Access Management, Security, and business leaders, including equipment, access requests, onboarding readiness, transfers, and timely recovery of company assets.
* Establish asset and endpoint support controls, including device inventory accuracy, stock and depot processes, warranty and repair coordination, refresh planning, secure disposal, loaner equipment, peripheral standards, and accountability for equipment assigned to users and locations.
* Define and report meaningful operational metrics, including contact volume, abandonment rate, speed to answer, first contact resolution, response and resolution attainment, mean time to restore, backlog age, reopen rate, escalation rate, customer satisfaction, change success rate, emergency change rate, incident recurrence, field dispatch performance, and cost per contact.
* Use performance data, customer feedback, quality reviews, trend analysis, and process audits to identify service gaps, prioritize improvements, and hold teams accountable for measurable outcomes rather than activity alone.
* Manage operating budgets, forecasts, staffing models, contracts, licensing, support tools, managed-service providers, hardware support partners, and vendor performance. Identify opportunities to reduce total cost of ownership without creating unacceptable service, security, compliance, or resilience risk.
* Lead operational due diligence and integration for acquisitions, divestitures, new locations, relocations, and major business initiatives, including support discovery, staffing impacts, device and asset planning, service onboarding, cutover support, communications, and stabilization.
* Ensure operational services comply with company policies, contractual requirements, data-protection obligations, records requirements, and healthcare-related security and privacy requirements, including HIPAA where applicable.
* Communicate service performance, customer-impacting risks, staffing needs, process maturity, investment priorities, and improvement progress clearly to technical teams, business leaders, executive leadership, auditors, and other stakeholders.
* Perform other job-related duties as assigned and provide hands-on operational leadership when business-critical conditions require it.

*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. The employee may be asked to perform other job-related duties consistent with the role.*
**Job Requirements**
**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Management, Computer Science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience.
* Eight or more years of progressive experience in IT service delivery, service desk, field services, or technology operations, including at least five years leading technical teams or managers in a complex, multi-site enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading Service Desk, Field Services, IT service management, change enablement, major incident management, problem management, and service improvement functions.
* Experience establishing service levels, operating procedures, quality controls, staffing models, escalation structures, knowledge management, service catalogs, and performance reporting.
* Experience with enterprise IT service management platforms such as ServiceNow, Zendesk, Jira Service Management, BMC Helix, or comparable tools, including workflow, reporting, knowledge, and self-service capabilities.
* Experience managing operating budgets, strategic vendors, managed-service providers, and distributed support delivery. Experience in healthcare, home health, hospice, post-acute care, or another regulated industry is strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting acquisitions, site openings or relocations, large technology deployments, endpoint refreshes, organizational change, and critical-incident response is preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Strong working knowledge of ITIL-aligned incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, service catalog, major incident, configuration, and continual improvement practices.
* Strong knowledge of service desk and field support operations, including call and ticket workflows, prioritization, escalation, workforce planning, queue management, remote support, deskside support, asset handling, and customer communications.
* Ability to design and govern mature change controls using business impact, technical complexity, implementation risk, security exposure, validation requirements, rollback readiness, segregation of duties, and approval thresholds.
* Ability to lead major incidents using clear command roles, business-impact assessment, technical workstreams, communication cadences, restoration priorities, and disciplined after-action follow-through.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows endpoints, Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, collaboration tools, endpoint security, remote-support technologies, identity and access processes, and common enterprise support dependencies.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret service metrics, identify demand and failure patterns, distinguish activity from outcomes, and translate data into staffing, process, automation, and investment decisions.
* Proven ability to improve customer experience while balancing service quality, security, compliance, standardization, speed, cost, and operational risk.
* Strong financial and vendor-management skills, including budgeting, forecasting, contract review, licensing analysis, staffing and sourcing models, and service-level accountability.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate operational performance, business impact, risks, and recommendations in clear business terms.
* Demonstrated commitment to documentation, automation, knowledge-centered support, standardization, continuous improvement, service ownership, customer experience, and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to participate in after-hours escalation as needed, support planned maintenance or deployment windows, and travel to company locations based on business needs.
* Relevant certifications such as ITIL 4 Managing Professional, HDI Support Center Manager, HDI Support Center Director, Certified Change Management Professional, Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, or comparable credentials are preferred, not required.
* Positive attitude and commitment to the Company's culture, core values, ethical standards, privacy expectations, and service-oriented operating model.

Title: Director - Worker Welfare (RD 4)
Description:
Job Summary

Lead the Worker Welfare function for City Operations, with a practical focus on occupational health, workplace safety, ergonomics and the quality of the working environment. Establish the governance, assurance and monitoring arrangements needed to protect worker wellbeing, identify workplace risks and support fair, safe and healthy working conditions across City Operations and its service-provider activities.

Core Responsibilities  

* Lead the City Operations Worker Welfare function and translate corporate requirements into practical standards, plans and controls.
* Establish a worker welfare governance, assurance and monitoring framework covering occupational health, workplace safety, ergonomics, welfare facilities and working-environment conditions.
* Develop risk-based inspection and review programs for City Operations workplaces and service-provider operations.
* Monitor worker welfare performance, trends, concerns and corrective actions, escalating material issues to leadership.
* Coordinate with Health & Safety, FLS, Human Capital, Procurement, Operations, Asset Management and service providers to embed worker welfare requirements into operational delivery.
* Support the assessment and improvement of workplace ergonomics, job design, welfare facilities and environmental conditions affecting worker health and wellbeing.
* Oversee investigation and follow-up of worker welfare concerns, non-compliances and recurring workplace issues.
* Ensure worker welfare requirements are incorporated into contractor scopes, mobilization, performance monitoring and service reviews.
* Build awareness and capability through guidance, training and engagement with employees and service providers.

  
Specific Responsibilities  

* Develop and maintain the City Operations Worker Welfare Plan, procedures, checklists and reporting arrangements.
* Maintain a worker welfare risk and action register with accountable owners and closure evidence.
* Coordinate occupational health and ergonomic assessments where required and track recommended improvements.
* Conduct or coordinate worker interviews, workplace observations and welfare-facility reviews as part of assurance activities.
* Produce periodic dashboards and management reports covering leading indicators, findings, trends and overdue actions.
* Support continual improvement of working conditions across City Operations.

Generic Responsibilities

* Contribute to annual business planning, workforce planning and budget management for the function.
* Lead, coach and develop assigned teams and specialist service providers.
* Promote a culture of accountability, prevention, continual improvement and evidence-based decision-making.
* Maintain accurate records and provide timely reports, presentations and recommendations to City Operations leadership.
* Perform other related duties consistent with the role and business requirements

Key Internal Interactions

* City Operations leadership and functional directors
* Health & Safety, FLS and Environmental teams
* Human Capital and Employee Relations
* Contracts & Procurement
* Operations, Asset Management and Community Management
* Governance, Risk & Controls
* Communications and relevant project/handover teams

Key External Interactions

* Relevant government and regulatory authorities
* Occupational health and ergonomics specialists
* Operations, maintenance and service-provider contractors
* Worker welfare auditors and consultants
* Healthcare and employee-assistance providers, as applicable
* Developers and delivery partners

 **Requirements**

Minimum Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in occupational health, Health & Safety, Human Factors, Ergonomics, Public Health, Human Resources or a closely related discipline.
* Master’s degree in a relevant field is desirable.

Professional certifications

* Relevant professional certification in occupational health and safety, ergonomics, worker welfare or auditing is desirable.
* Professional membership with a recognized health, safety, ergonomics or human-resources body is desirable.

Skills

* Strong knowledge of worker welfare, occupational health, workplace safety, ergonomics and working-environment controls.
* Strong inspection, investigation, assurance and corrective-action management skills.
* Ability to engage constructively with workers, managers, contractors and senior leadership.
* Strong analytical, reporting, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to manage sensitive welfare matters professionally and consistently

Title: L2 Technical Support Leader (Integration & Middleware)
Description:

Title: Portfolio Manager, Short-Term Strategies & Cash Management
Description:
**Why you’ll love working here:**

* high-performance, people-focused culture
* our commitment that equity, diversity, and inclusion are fundamental to our work environment and business success, which helps employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves
* learning and development initiatives, including workshops, Speaker Series events and access to LinkedIn Learning, that support employees’ career growth
* membership in HOOPP’s world class defined benefit pension plan, which can serve as an important part of your retirement security
* competitive, 100% company-paid extended health and dental benefits for permanent employees, including coverage supporting our team's diversity and mental health (e.g., gender affirmation, fertility and drug treatment, psychological support benefits of $2,500 per year, parental leave top-up, and a health spending account).
* optional post-retirement health and dental benefits subsidized at 50%
* wellness seminars, yoga classes, and free nutritional consultations
the opportunity to make a difference and help take care of those who care for us, by providing a financially secure retirement for Ontario healthcare workers  

**Job Summary**

  

HOOPP's Short-Term Strategies team runs the Plan's short-term liquidity portfolio: a global book of high-quality liquid assets (HQLA), money market instruments, and the rates, FX and funding derivatives that hedge and finance it. The mandate is twofold: keep the Plan liquid under all market conditions, and generate meaningful, risk-adjusted value from the portfolio and the balance sheet. The mandate is broad and flexible and so we are looking for a collaborative Portfolio Manager who will partner closely with another Portfolio Manager to deliver on the mandate together.

  

The book invests in North American and global fixed-income markets, so you will think across currencies, curves and funding sources every day. You will own strategies end to end, from idea generation and execution to risk management. You will help shape the frameworks that govern liquidity at one of the world's leading defined benefit pension plans.

  

The size of the portfolio is not fixed, and neither is how it is allocated across strategies. Relative value considerations in cash and collateral markets as well as the needs of the Plan can require the mandate to be scaled up and down and thus allocation of balance sheet is a core part of this role.

  

**What you will do:**

  

Portfolio management and trading

* Manage a global short-term portfolio of HQLA, including government bills and bonds, agencies and SSAs, Canada Mortgage Bonds (CMB), NHA MBS pools, commercial paper and other money market instruments.

* Scale strategies up and down, and move material amounts of balance sheet between them, as relative value, funding conditions and the size of the portfolio change.

* Trade and hedge across rates, FX and funding markets (for example cross-currency basis, FX swaps, interest rate swaps and swap spreads) to fund and swap assets across CAD, USD, EUR, GBP, JPY and other currencies.

* Identify, research and execute relative-value and carry strategies across cash rates, high-quality credit, repo and derivatives markets, including financing spreads across cash, synthetic and financing markets.

* Measure and manage convexity, prepayment and extension risk in mortgage pools, and optionality across the book.

Manage risk and returns over the full life of each position and structure, from sizing and execution to hedging and exit.  

  

Liquidity and balance sheet

* Ensure the Plan holds sufficient liquidity and collateral to meet derivative margin, repo, capital call and benefit obligations, including under stress.

* Integrate funding cost, collateral, leverage and balance sheet constraints into investment decisions with the broader Investment Management team.

Monitor regulatory, industry and market developments (e.g., benchmark reform, central bank operations, margin rules) that affect funding, liquidity risk or portfolio activity.  

  

Relationships and market intelligence

* Maintain and grow the Plan's existing relationships with dealers, counterparties, custodians and other market participants. This is a top priority for the role.

* Take an entrepreneurial approach to relationships: reach out proactively, build new connections, and bring ideas and opportunities to the team early.

Build and use a North American market intelligence network, including deep sell-side relationships, to inform positioning, idea generation and execution.  

  

Governance, partnerships and analytics

* Prepare investment analyses, recommendations and reporting for senior investment leaders and committees.

* Partner with Risk, Finance, Legal, Operations and Treasury on governance and oversight; contribute to policies, guidelines, risk limits and monitoring frameworks.

Champion data, analytics, technology and process improvements that strengthen portfolio oversight and decision-making.  

  

Teamwork and leadership

* Work hand in hand with the other Portfolio Manager on strategy, positioning, risk and balance sheet allocation, sharing ideas, coverage and accountability.

Mentor junior investment professionals and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration and knowledge sharing.  

  

**What you bring:**

You do not need every skill below. We are looking for meaningful depth in several of these areas, and you will partner with another Portfolio Manager whose strengths complement yours.

  

Technical expertise (several of the following)

* Hands-on trading experience in rates, FX and funding markets, such as cross-currency swaps and FX basis, interest rate swaps, futures, OIS and swap spreads, with a strong grasp of curve, spread and carry dynamics.

* Experience managing HQLA and money market portfolios, including government securities, Canada Mortgage Bonds, NHA MBS pools and commercial paper.

* Understanding of convexity and optionality: how it arises in mortgage pools, callable instruments and hedges, and how to measure and manage it.

* Working knowledge of global fixed-income markets beyond North America (e.g., UK gilts, European government bonds, JGBs, SSAs) and their funding and repo conventions.

Command of repo, securities financing, collateral management and margin mechanics.  

  

Relationships and approach

* A record of maintaining and growing dealer and counterparty relationships, ideally with deep sell-side relationships and a North American market intelligence network.

* An entrepreneurial approach to relationships: you reach out proactively, create opportunities and follow through.

* A collaborative style, with the ability to work closely with another PM and share ideas, coverage and accountability.

Comfort scaling strategies up and down and reallocating balance sheet between them as the size of the portfolio and relative value change.  

  

Strongly preferred

* Experience trading interest rate swap spreads and equity swap / total return swap financing spreads.

* Background at a bank treasury, pension fund, central bank, ALM or short-term rates desk.

Proficiency with Bloomberg and risk systems; Python, SQL or similar for analytics is an asset.  

  

Experience and qualifications

* Minimum 5 years in fixed-income portfolio management, short-term rates or FX trading, liquidity management, treasury, ALM or related capital markets roles.

* Proven record of generating risk-adjusted returns and managing risk through volatile markets.

* Strong teamwork and the ability to partner effectively with another PM to deliver shared results.

* Strong analytical skills; able to turn complex market and portfolio information into clear, actionable recommendations.

* Excellent written and verbal communication, including materials for senior leaders and committees.

* Effective relationship builder with external counterparties and internal partners (Risk, Finance, Legal, Operations, Treasury).

* Sound judgement under pressure, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in fast-moving markets.

* Initiative, accountability, attention to detail and a commitment to continuous learning and investment excellence.

CFA designation (or meaningful progress toward it) preferred; CPA or FRM an asset.

### **This role is eligible to participate in discretionary incentive plan(s), subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan text.**

Title: Senior Program Manager
Description:

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services, delivering end-to-end solutions and service to clients across its global organization.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Senior Program Manager is accountable for the strategic direction, integrated planning and end-to-end delivery performance of AXI within the Investor Relations Value Stream. In addition to the official Senior Program Manager title, the role fulfils the Value Stream Delivery Lead responsibilities for Investor Relations, ensuring that agreed outcomes and priorities are translated into a coherent roadmap, single governed backlog and measurable delivery plan.
  
  
As a member of the Investor Relations Value Stream Leadership Team, the role partners with the Value Lead, Technology Lead and Operations Lead to connect strategy with execution. The Senior Program Manager owns the overall flow and coordination of delivery, providing clear visibility of progress, capacity, cost, dependencies, risks, impediments and outcomes across AXI and related work.
  
  
As a Grade 4 leader, the Senior Program Manager operates with a high degree of autonomy and organizational influence. The role shapes delivery strategy, challenges constructively, resolves complex cross-functional constraints and represents the Value Stream in portfolio and executive forums. The position also includes formal line-management responsibility for staff within the Project Management Department, combining Value Stream delivery accountability with people leadership and capability development.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
Investor Relations Value Stream and AXI Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Fulfil the Delivery Lead role within the Investor Relations Value Stream Leadership Team, partnering with the Value Lead, Technology Lead and Operations Lead to turn agreed outcomes and priorities into executable delivery commitments.
* Own the integrated Investor Relations Value Stream roadmap, AXI program plan, single backlog and delivery performance, ensuring investment and execution remain aligned to agreed strategic objectives and measurable business outcomes.
* Lead a complex portfolio of projects and workstreams, balancing platform development, business change, operational readiness, releases and production priorities.
* Translate strategic direction and business cases into sequenced, achievable delivery plans with clear ownership, dependencies, milestones and success measures.
* Provide direction across cross-functional and globally distributed teams, creating alignment, pace, transparency, and accountability.
* Anticipate material delivery challenges and establish practical mitigation, recovery or escalation strategies before outcomes are affected.
* Act as the senior delivery authority for AXI and the Delivery Lead for the Investor Relations Value Stream, representing delivery in Value Stream, portfolio, executive and governance forums.
* Drive consistent delivery practices, delivery metrics and continuous improvement while allowing teams to apply fit-for-purpose Agile, Waterfall or hybrid methods.
* Coordinate cross-Value Stream demand and dependencies, negotiate sequencing with shared services and escalate priority decisions where demand exceeds available capacity.
* Manage Value Stream capacity, resource demand and allocation, ensuring commitments are realistic and delivery constraints are visible early.
* Lead quarterly planning, roadmap reviews, execution reviews and delivery governance across strategic change, client work, business requests, platform change and KTLO activity.
* Maintain one visible and prioritized backlog linking Value Stream outcomes and objectives to executable epics, stories and delivery commitments, with clear ownership and no orphaned work.
* Establish and facilitate the regular Investor Relations Value Stream leadership cadence, ensuring shared ownership across value, delivery, technology and operations.

**Value Stream Delivery, Flow and Ways of Working**
Integrated Planning, Governance and Financial Control
  
  

* Develop and maintain integrated Value Stream plans, roadmaps, budgets, forecasts, capacity and resource plans, and delivery scenarios across AXI and related Investor Relations outcomes.
* Establish proportionate governance across the full delivery lifecycle, including business case, scope, schedule, financials, quality, RAID, decisions, dependencies and benefits.
* Ensure program commitments are realistic and supported by sufficient capacity, funding, technical readiness and business ownership.
* Lead Value Stream prioritization and trade-off discussions where demand exceeds capacity or where scope, sequencing, cost, dependencies or risk require leadership or executive decision.
* Provide concise, evidence-based reporting on delivery confidence, financial position, outcomes and material constraints.

* Oversee delivery across the SDLC, ensuring requirements, design, engineering, testing, UAT, performance, release and production-readiness activities are integrated and governed.
* Partner with product, business and technology leadership to maintain alignment between business outcomes, platform priorities and technical execution.
* Coordinate cross-platform, cross-program and cross-Value Stream dependencies, ensuring demand, blockers and integration risks are visible, owned, sequenced and resolved.
* Ensure releases have clear acceptance criteria, quality evidence, operational readiness, communications, implementation and support arrangements.
* Own the health of the Value Stream delivery system, using flow, quality, capacity and financial data to identify bottlenecks, remove impediments, improve predictability and support continuous improvement.
* Promote fit-for-purpose use of Agile, Waterfall and hybrid approaches rather than applying a single methodology by default.

**Executive and Stakeholder Leadership**

* Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors, business leaders, technology leaders, operations, control functions and external partners.
* Communicate complex delivery matters clearly and directly, adapting detail and recommendations to the audience.
* Present program status, risks, dependencies, investment choices and strategic recommendations to senior governance forums.
* Create a consistent program narrative across stakeholders and ensure decisions, commitments and accountabilities are understood and followed through.
* Challenge constructively where delivery confidence, scope, sequencing, ownership or expected value is unclear.
* Navigate competing priorities and organizational complexity while protecting agreed program outcomes.

**People Leadership and Project Management Capability**

* Provide formal line management for assigned staff within the Project Management Department, including regular one-to-ones, objective setting, performance and development conversations, and support for career growth.
* Set clear expectations for delivery quality, professional conduct, stakeholder management, governance and accountability.
* Allocate and balance work across direct reports, considering program priorities, individual capability, development needs and sustainable workload.
* Coach and mentor project and program management professionals, providing practical guidance on complex delivery situations and supporting sound judgement.
* Identify capability, capacity and succession needs within the team and contribute to recruitment, onboarding, talent development and retention.
* Promote consistent standards, reusable practices and knowledge-sharing across the Project Management Department and relevant communities of practice.
* Create an inclusive, collaborative environment where staff receive timely feedback, understand priorities and are supported to perform effectively.

**Measures of Success**

* Investor Relations Value Stream priorities and AXI investment are translated into one realistic, governed and outcome-focused roadmap and backlog.
* Program commitments are delivered with clear ownership, executive visibility and effective financial control.
* Material risks and dependencies are identified early, with timely decisions and credible mitigation or recovery plans.
* Business, product and technology stakeholders remain aligned on priorities, sequencing, delivery confidence and expected outcomes.
* Releases are delivered with appropriate quality, operational readiness and production support.
* Project Management Department staff have clear objectives, balanced assignments, regular feedback and meaningful development support.
* The Investor Relations Value Stream and AXI delivery teams demonstrate improving flow, predictability, transparency, collaboration and measurable value.

**Qualifications**
**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**
**Essential**

* Extensive experience leading large, complex and strategically important technology programs across multiple projects, workstreams and stakeholder groups.
* Demonstrated experience owning delivery execution, flow, planning, capacity, dependencies and governance within a Value Stream, product or comparable cross-functional operating model.
* Proven accountability for end-to-end program delivery, including strategy translation, integrated planning, governance, financial control, risk, dependency, quality and executive reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously, influence senior leaders and make sound decisions in ambiguous or high-pressure situations.
* Strong experience coordinating delivery across business, product, engineering, architecture, testing, operations and control functions.
* Deep understanding of SDLC and delivery methods, including Agile, Waterfall and hybrid approaches, with the judgement to tailor governance appropriately.
* Proven people-management experience, including objective setting, coaching, performance management, development planning, workload management and recruitment support.
* Experience leading and developing project or program management professionals across distributed teams.
* Excellent executive communication, facilitation, negotiation and influencing capability.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budget management, forecasting, resource planning and investment trade-offs.
* Ability to connect program outputs to business outcomes, adoption and measurable value realization.

Desirable
  
  
**Personal Attributes**

* Strategic and outcome-focused, while remaining close enough to execution to intervene effectively.
* Creible and composed with senior stakeholders in complex or high-stakes situations.
* Decisive, pragmatic and willing to make delivery issues visible.
* Strong ownership mindset with high personal accountability.
* Inclusive people leader who sets clear expectations and invests in the development of others.
* Collaborative and able to lead through influence across organizational boundaries.
* Resilient, adaptable and committed to continuous improvement.

**Role Accountabilities**
The Senior Program Manager fulfils the Delivery Lead role for the Investor Relations Value Stream and owns delivery execution, flow, integrated planning, governance, financial control, dependencies and delivery performance for AXI. The Value Lead remains accountable for value, vision and priority decisions; the Technology Lead remains accountable for architecture, engineering quality and technical direction; and the Operations Lead remains accountable for operational input, readiness and adoption. The Senior Program Manager brings these perspectives together into one executable delivery system and is accountable for the effective line management and development of assigned Project Management Department staff.

Title: Director of Business Technology
Description:
Liteline Corporation is a privately held Canadian commercial lighting manufacturer with more than 160 employees, selling across Canada and the United States. We are adding a Director of Business Technology to our leadership team, a senior, hands-on role with ownership of technology across the business.

The role has two halves. The first is the job every growing company needs: keep our technology running, secure and recoverable across roughly 130 computers, Microsoft 365, our server cluster and our network. The second is newer. Our own people, from the three Co-Presidents to staff in Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service, now build software tools with AI assistants. The Director of Business Technology will give that work a professional backbone: version control, permissions, backups and fast recovery.

This is an enabling role as much as a technical one. We want our people to keep building quickly. The person in this position will make sure what they build is safe, recoverable and well looked after, without slowing anyone down.

This is a build role. Liteline’s people are already creating their own tools with AI. We are looking for a leader who can keep the core IT environment solid, put the right platforms and guardrails under home-built software, and teach non-programmers to work safely.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Keep Things Running**

* Own day-to-day IT across the business: computers, email, servers, networking, security and backups.
* Run Microsoft 365, including sign-in, multi-factor authentication (MFA), user access and licensing.
* Look after our on-premises server cluster, storage and network infrastructure.
* Oversee security monitoring and incident response together with our security monitoring partner.
* Maintain tested backups and the ability to restore systems and data quickly.
* Lead the help desk and set the service standards the business is held to.

**Own the Platforms**

* Set up and run, hands-on, the platforms our home-built tools live on.
* Own Liteline’s company GitHub organization, where code is saved with full history, including structure, permissions, single sign-on (SSO) and branch protection.
* Administer hosted databases (Supabase / Postgres), including access control, backups and recovery.
* Manage website and application hosting (Netlify), including deployments, domains and environments.
* Maintain a clear inventory of the tools in use, who owns each one and where it runs.

**Govern and Teach**

* Decide what AI assistants can access and set sensible guardrails for company data and credentials.
* Set light, practical rules that protect the business without getting in the way of the people building.
* Decide which home-built tools are business-critical and what level of protection each one needs.
* Run and rehearse restores so that recovery is proven, not assumed.
* Teach staff who are not programmers to work safely, for example explaining version control to someone in purchasing.
* Run training, enablement and “lunch and learn” sessions across the business.

**Team and Partners**

* Lead two on-site IT staff.
* Manage our outside partners for managed services, security monitoring and backup.
* Own the technology budget, licensing and vendor relationships, and bring forward stronger options as the market moves.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader who is equally comfortable running core IT and building platforms that sit under modern, AI-assisted development.

The successful candidate will understand infrastructure, identity and security, and will also understand how software is built, saved, deployed and recovered. Just as importantly, you will be able to explain those ideas in plain language to people who have never written code and help them adopt habits that last.

**Strong candidates will bring:**

* Hands-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO and branch protection.
* Experience running a Microsoft Power Platform Centre of Excellence, citizen-developer or low-code programme.
* Hands-on experience running Supabase, Postgres, Netlify, Vercel or similar platforms.
* Solid Microsoft 365, identity, MFA, endpoint and security fundamentals.
* A track record of training and enabling non-technical staff, such as “lunch and learn” or enablement programmes.
* Experience building a function or process from scratch at a growing company.
* Clear communication and sound judgment about when rules help and when they get in the way.

There is no single path to this role. You might be:

* An IT lead at a 100-to-500-person manufacturer or distributor who personally ran a Power Platform governance programme, a low-code programme or the company’s GitHub organization.
* A developer or DevOps engineer who moved into an IT management role at a small or mid-sized company.
* A solutions architect or senior consultant at a managed services provider (MSP) serving small and mid-sized businesses, ready to go in-house.
* The “first IT hire” at a startup who set up sign-in, devices and GitHub from scratch, then moved to a mid-sized company.
* Experience in mid-sized manufacturing, distribution or wholesale is helpful but not required.

**REPORTING AND WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**

This position reports to the VP of Operations.

You will work closely with Liteline’s three Co-Presidents, who are technically capable and build their own tools, and with Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service. You will be a partner to the people building, not a gatekeeper.

**LOCATION AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT**

This position is based at Liteline's Richmond Hill head office and is on-site five days per week with regular presence at our distribution facilities.

The successful candidate should expect to be highly engaged with the business and to spend real time understanding how departments and facilities actually operate.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

This is a rare chance to shape how an established Canadian manufacturer builds and runs its technology at a moment when AI is changing who can create software.

Liteline is privately held, decisions are made without layers of approval, and good ideas get backed. Our leaders build with technology themselves and value this work. The Director of Business Technology will define the platforms, guardrails and habits that let the whole company build with confidence.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Liteline offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and life insurance following three months of service, and a group RRSP with partial company match.

**TO APPLY**

Qualified candidates are invited to apply directly through this posting.

*Liteline Corporation is an equal opportunity employer that values the unique skills and experiences of every candidate. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities throughout the recruitment and hiring process. To request accommodation, please contact Human Resources with the position title in the subject line.*

Pay: $150,000.00 per year

* Disability insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Extended health care
* Life insurance
* On-site parking
* RRSP match
* Vision care

* Have you built or significantly developed an IT, business technology, technology governance, or technology enablement function or process from the ground up?
* Do you have hands-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO, permissions, branch protection or repository governance?
* Do you have hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 environments, including identity, MFA, endpoint management, and security?
