Title: Manager, Care Operations
Description:
**Overview**
Tonal Care runs seven days a week across an in-house Toronto team and an outsourced partner operation. The Manager, Care Operations owns how that operation performs day to day.
  
  
You will own daily delivery across all tiers, the operational relationship with our outsourced partner, and the staffing and capacity plans that keep service levels intact. You will lead a Team Lead and a team of Customer Experience Specialists, each of whom owns one or two lines of business, and you will work the queue yourself when coverage requires it.
  
  
This is a hands-on, player/coach, operating role. You set the standard, work within it, and hold the operation to it.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
Daily Delivery
  
  

* Act as a player-coach during the initial phase, spending dedicated time working directly in the queue alongside specialists to model best practices, coach in real time, and establish baseline workflows
* Own daily delivery across all tiers, setting service levels, coverage models, and workflow standards that hold consistent delivery across phone, email, chat, and video.
* Own the daily, weekly, and monthly plans for SLA, CSAT, Average Handle Time, and First Contact Resolution, and be accountable for hitting them.
* Identify performance trends, operational risks, and root causes, and build the action plans that close the gap.
* Lead regular performance reviews and operational business reviews with internal stakeholders and partner leadership.
* Support incident and volume management during elevated contact periods, product issues, launches, and other business disruptions.
* Work the queue yourself when coverage requires it — absences, PTO, peak volume, or an uncovered line of business. You are the final backstop on coverage.
* Translate operational data into clear insights and recommendations for Care leadership.

Outsourced Partner Performance
  
  

* Serve as the day-to-day operational point of contact for Tonal’s outsourced partner, managing performance through their team leads and supervisors.
* Hold partner leadership accountable to agreed KPIs, SLAs, quality standards, staffing commitments, and Tonal’s brand voice.
* Run weekly performance reviews with partner teams.
* Report weekly to our Logistics, Field Operations, and Care Leadership team across all Care Operations metrics.
* Partner with their leadership on performance improvement plans, staffing strategies, coaching opportunities, and operational readiness.
* Monitor partner staffing, attrition, attendance, and utilization to catch capacity risk before it reaches Members.
* Make sure partner teams are aligned to Tonal policies, workflows, and operating standards, and are prepared for new programs, product changes, and launches.
* Escalate to the Senior Manager, Care Operations when partner performance issues cannot be resolved at the working level. Contract terms, rates, and renewals sit with the Director of Care Operations.

Staffing and Capacity
  
  

* Own workforce planning with partner Workforce Management and Tonal analytics, setting capacity and staffing models against forecast demand and adjusting intraday to protect service levels.
* Plan coverage across the full seven-day operating window, including weekends, holidays, and peak periods.
* Own the volume, staffing, and partner utilization assumptions that feed Care’s operating budget.
* Monitor forecast accuracy and adjust staffing assumptions based on actual contact volume, productivity, shrinkage, and service-level performance.
* Ensure schedules keep the teams at a sustainable working load rather than at full utilization, so there is room to absorb spikes and absences.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead and develop the team through the Team Lead and senior specialists, owning performance calibration, coaching, career development, and coverage planning.
* Make sure every line of business has a named owner, that the assignment is understood, and that owners are held to how their domain performs.
* Be accountable for the escalations programme. Specialists and the Team Lead resolve individual escalations; you own how the programme performs and where it needs to change.
* Sit in the health, safety, and legal escalation chain: Specialist → Team Lead → Manager, Care Operations → Senior Manager, Care Operations → Director, Care Operations.
* Ensure clear ownership and communication on sensitive, complex, or high-risk Member situations.
* Monitor escalation trends to surface recurring Member pain points, and work with the frontline to reduce avoidable escalations and lift first contact resolution.

Title: Director of Information Technology Services
Description:
**Description**
The City of Gaithersburg is seeking a visionary, collaborative, and service-oriented Director of Information Technology Services to join our dynamic senior leadership team. The IT Services Director oversees a talented and high functioning team of IT professionals who support the City's departments and their missions. The next IT leader will bring innovation and collaboration, working in support of City-wide goals to be a strategic partner in service delivery and smart IT solutions. This is a rare opportunity to serve in a pivotal role in a well-managed, effectively governed, incredibly diverse community with an exceptionally high quality of life.
  
  
As part of the Senior Leadership Team, the Director of Information Technology Services will have the opportunity to lead key City and departmental initiatives, drive operational excellence, and help shape the future of our City in partnership with dedicated department directors, elected officials, and community members. Applicants must have subject matter skills and knowledge, supervisory and management experience, and a track record in leadership working with a diverse workforce and affecting inclusive and effective outcomes. This position truly offers a skilled leader the opportunity to work in partnership with the City Manager and Senior Leadership Team to bring new perspectives, leadership, and additional innovation to further the City's mission, vision, core values, and long-range goals.
  
  
The IT Services Director reports directly to the City Manager. As a member of the City's senior leadership team, the Director collaborates with the City Manager, Assistant City Managers, and other department directors on strategy and policy to ensure that the City's mission, vision, core values, and long-range goals are incorporated into operational activities and services.
  
  
The position can accommodate both in-person and limited remote work at the discretion of the City Manager. Preparation for and attendance at meetings, events, and other work outside of regular business hours is required. Residency within the City of Gaithersburg is not required.
  
  
For more details about the role and the Gaithersburg community, please review the Position Profile [PDF].
  
  
Job Functions
  
  
**The Position**
The IT Services Director performs complex professional work in the planning, organizing, and coordinating of the development, implementation, and maintenance of the City’s electronic data processing, management information systems, and related operations. The Director provides leadership, direction, and advanced professional expertise and oversight to the Department and employees responsible for coordination of the IT services for the City and is responsible for short- and long-range planning of the City’s technical infrastructure to ensure that it supports current and future business needs.
  
  
The complete classification description for the Director of Information Technology Services position can be viewed here.
  
  
**The Department**
The Information Technology Services Department consists of 16.67 FTE, including the Director. The department has four groups, IT Central Support Services, Business Systems and Transformation Services, Network Operations and Security Services, and GIS and Data Services. IT Central Support Services provides City staff with Tier I and Tier II technical support of hardware, software, and systems. Business Systems and Transformation Services is responsible for maintaining business systems throughout their full lifecycle – requirements, procurement, implementation, and ongoing maintenance. Network Operations and Security Services is responsible for network, server, and telecommunication infrastructure as well as physical and cybersecurity, including identity management, emails, files, firewalls, and desktop and server patching. GIS and Data Services is tasked with creating, implementing, and maintaining geographic information data standards and enterprise GIS systems.
  
  
**Duties**
The department has a budget of $3.3 million. In addition to its regular operational duties, some of the Department’s current projects include:
  
  

* Support of the new City Hall construction at 12 South Summit Avenue.
* Implementation of a Rubrik-based backup and disaster recovery system.
* Creation of comprehensive IT policies and procedures.
* Replacement of the City’s phone system.
* Implementation of resilient WAN connections at major facilities.
* Evaluation and implementation of Artificial Intelligence technologies.
* Implementation activities surrounding major Public Works GIS initiatives.
* Selection and implementation of a centralized data warehouse with analytical services and artificial intelligence capabilities.
* Selection and implementation of a Constituent Relationship Management system.
* Implementation of a new HRIS, Payroll and Time and Attendance system.
* Implementation of a comprehensive ITSM/ITAM system.
* Replacement of the meeting management system.
* Supporting the City’s upcoming 2027 elections.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, computer science, information technology, cybersecurity, or related field.
* At least 10 years of experience managing information technology systems, the majority of which shall have been in a supervisory or managerial capacity.
* Valid driver's license.

**Desired/Preferred Qualifications**

* Local government experience is desired; municipal government experience is strongly preferred.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification; and/or
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)/Certified Information Security Manager (CISM); and/or
* Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Service Management (ITSM) certification; and/or
* Certified Geographic Information System Professional (GISP).

**The Successful Candidate**
The ideal candidate for the Director of Information Technology Services position is a proficient, accomplished and forward-thinking public sector leader who is passionate about transforming local government through technology and is dedicated to public service. This individual is a strategic thinker who can translate big-picture goals into actionable plans, while also possessing the hands-on practical expertise to ensure high-quality service delivery, technological security, and operational effectiveness. The ideal candidate demonstrates intellectual humility and curiosity, values the expertise and institutional knowledge of experienced staff, and fosters meaningful collaboration within the department and across the organization while building strong relationships with elected officials, community members, and regional partners. They will possess the ability to navigate sensitive issues and competing interests with diplomacy, fairness, and discretion.
  
  
An exceptional communicator and listener, the successful candidate understands the value of inclusive engagement, transparency, and trust-building. They are committed to cultivating a positive organizational culture, empowering and developing staff through coaching, recognizing collective accomplishments, and managing performance in a constructive, accountability-oriented manner. This person must be comfortable with ambiguity and change, capable of championing innovation while maintaining reliable IT operations, and skilled in balancing strategic priorities with available resources and long-term operational sustainability. With a solid understanding of information technology operations, public administration, municipal finance, and municipal operations, the ideal Director of Information Technology Services brings both a visionary mindset and an engaged leadership style. They are technically proficient and grounded in values of equity, integrity, and professionalism, and thrive in an evolving, team-oriented environment where collaboration, creativity, and service excellence are expected and rewarded.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
**Compensation**
The anticipated target hiring range is $175,00 to $200,000, depending on qualifications, with an excellent benefits package.
  
  
**How To Apply**
Interested candidates must complete and submit a brief online application and are required to attach the following supporting documents to the online application upon submission:
  
  

* Current Resume
* Letter of Interest
* List of References (at least 4 to include a manager [current/former], a subordinate, and a colleague). Please note: References will not be contacted without permission from the applicant.

Other supporting documents may be attached but are not required.
  
  
**First review of applications will begin by December 11, 2026.**
The position will remain open until filled; recruitment will close without notice when a sufficient number of qualified applications are identified or all hiring decisions have been made.

Description:
Trust is everything for financial institutions, but it gets harder to earn as customer expectations rise and fraud keeps evolving. At Casap, we’re on a mission to deliver outcomes that were once out of reach, building a future where fraud is rare and trust is a given.
  
  
We started with disputes, some of the highest-stakes work financial institutions can’t afford to get wrong, and have expanded the same approach across fraud, collections, claims and more. Today, more than 100 banks, credit unions, fintechs and processors trust our AI agents to make decisions, take actions, move money and file chargebacks, from first signal to final outcome.
  
  
Founded by product leaders from Robinhood and Chime, Casap has raised $90M, including a $56M Series B led by Base10 Partners with continued investment from Lightspeed and Emergence. We were named Tearsheet’s 2026 AI Company of the Year, and our CEO, Shanthi, was named to Inc.’s 2026 Female Founders 500. We have an exceptionally ambitious and kind culture, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**Location(s)**
This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco, CA office. Our team works in-office time on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Contact Center Manager to join our Managed Services team and oversee our BPO operations day to day. As Managed Services expands, our BPO engagement is the compliant, reliable entry point for every fintech and credit union client we support. You'll lead our outsourced contact center and back-office investigation teams, manage policies and procedures, optimize IVR routing and call scripts, and turn vendor partnerships into clear results for our clients.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own BPO Performance Day to Day: Serve as the primary operational contact for our contact center vendor(s). Manage SLA adherence, stand up performance reporting, run a regular vendor review cadence, and escalate underperformance with clear evidence and a path to resolution.
* Own IVR Design and Call Routing: Design, test, and optimize IVR flows and routing logic across vendor platforms. Reproduce routing issues, review call logs and data, and identify root cause before escalating to the vendor, engineering, or product.
* Own Scripting and Quality Standards: Partner with the QA/Performance Manager to build and maintain call scripts, quality standards, and calibration practices that keep every interaction compliant, consistent, and on-brand for each client.
* Partner on Workforce Management: Collaborate with WFM to align staffing, scheduling, and coverage planning with volume forecasts, and flag capacity risks before they affect clients.
* Own Security and Compliance for Phone Intake: Define and monitor controls for phone-based intake, including caller authentication and data handling. Audit the vendor against those controls and drive remediation of any gaps.
* Own Outcomes, Not Just Tickets: Treat recurring vendor or call-quality issues as programs to be solved. Define scope, align internal stakeholders and the vendor, and deliver durable resolutions rather than one-off fixes.
* Be the Bridge to Engineering and Product: Translate contact center and client friction into clear technical requirements and prioritized, business-context-rich input. Advocate for scalable solutions, including tooling integrations and automation.
* Optimize Contact Center Tooling: Partner with Managed Services Leadership on the integration and optimization of contact center platforms (e.g., TaskUs or equivalent).[C1]
* Support Client Relationships: Support the Vendor Ops Manager in client-facing work by providing performance data, preparing for business reviews, and connecting vendor results to each client’s operational goals.
* Drive Enablement and Documentation: Build the runbooks, escalation paths, and training materials that make the vendor self-sufficient and prevent repeat issues. Support the implementation team in standing up phone intake for new Managed Services clients.

**What You’ve Done**

* 4-7 years in contact center operations, vendor management, technical account management, or customer success, ideally at a B2B SaaS or fintech company serving financial institutions.
* Experience managing outsourced or in-house contact center operations at scale, ideally in a regulated industry, with hands-on IVR, WFM, and vendor SLA management.
* Experience in payments, disputes, chargebacks, or Reg E/Z compliance workflows, and familiarity with compliance requirements for phone-based financial services intake.
* A track record of turning vendor relationships into measurable, accountable performance.
* Ability to investigate issues independently: reviewing call data and logs, querying data, and identifying root cause before escalating.
* Strong relationship management skills, with the presence to build credibility with vendor leadership and with operational and executive stakeholders at clients.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication: able to make a complex operational or dispute issue clear to both frontline teams and leadership, and to work closely with QA, Product, and vendor partners.
* Structured problem-solver with great composure when an issue is live and the stakes are high, comfortable building process while doing the work in an early-stage environment.

* Oversee day-to-day clinical support, administrative and non-clinical operations
* Establish operational governance, process ownership, KPIs, SLAs and executive performance reporting
* Optimize patient flow, capacity, productivity, service quality and resource utilisation.

* Drive operational excellence, process improvement and measurable benefits realisation

* Partner with Finance and clinical leaders on budgets, cost optimisation, service-line growth and revenue performance
* Oversee patient experience, support services, vendor performance, business continuity and emergency preparedness
* Build, lead and develop a high-performing Operations team for the new hospital

* Strong UAE hospital experience with sound knowledge of DHA requirements and JCI standards
* Hands-on involvement in commissioning, opening, expanding or transforming a hospital
* Demonstrated success in patient flow, capacity planning, workforce productivity, cost optimisation and service improvement
* Experience with HIS implementation, performance dashboards, digital workflows, automation or AI-enabled operations

You will help shape the operational foundation, culture, and patient journey of a new academic hospital from commissioning through full 24/7 operations.

Title: Project Engineering Manager, Staff
Industry: Semiconductor Manufacturing, Software Development, and Computer Hardware Manufacturing
Description:
We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Own and maintain the integrated schedule and critical path across multiple Memory Interface IP development and release workstreams, from project kickoff and architecture through design closure, verification, customer delivery, and production readiness. Model dependency chains deeply enough to quantify the impact of slips and pull-ins, distinguish paths with float from those without it, and update the plan weekly using current engineering data.
* Drive the weekly project cadence by synthesizing inputs from architecture, RTL, design verification, analog and mixed-signal design, physical design, packaging, software, infrastructure, product engineering, and post-silicon teams into a single view of program health, emerging concerns, and required actions.
* Track verification convergence and engineering maturity as leading indicators. Monitor feature readiness, RTL closure, bug discovery and closure trends, regression health, coverage, design maturity, and block-level readiness. Recognize when convergence is stalling and drive a recovery plan before downstream milestones or customer commitments are affected.
* Analyze schedule scenarios and coordinate recovery plans. Work with engineering leads to understand technical constraints, resource limitations, and available float; quantify the impact of changes; develop practical options; and track agreed recovery actions to closure.
* Manage external partner and customer dependencies by owning delivery calendars, tracking execution plans and acceptance criteria, aligning technical dependencies, and supporting schedule negotiations with a clear understanding of downstream technical, commercial, and resource impacts.
* Lead cross-functional risk, issue, and decision management. Convert technical uncertainty into clear options, owners, dates, and decision points. Ensure risks, assumptions, and trade-offs are visible early and resolved at the appropriate level.
* Provide concise project insight to executives and customers. Distill complex engineering information into evidence-based updates that distinguish signal from noise, quantify schedule and delivery impact, and clearly identify the actions or decisions needed.

A Day In The Life
  
  
You start the morning reviewing verification-convergence dashboards and regression results, spotting a block where bug-closure velocity has slowed. You bring the DV lead and RTL owner together for a focused sync, clarify the cause, and align on a recovery plan before the weekly project review.
  
  
In that review, you walk leadership through an updated critical path that reflects an internal delivery shift, quantify the downstream impact on release timing and customer commitments, and identify the decisions needed to protect the plan. Later, you follow-up with R&D on the strategy to take to resolve the issue, then finish the day preparing a concise executive summary and following up on owners and due dates from the project review.
  
  
What You'll Need
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Applied Science, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience, with 8+ years of relevant experience in semiconductor, silicon IP, SoC, ASIC, or complex hardware development.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex semiconductor or silicon IP programs across multiple engineering disciplines and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong working knowledge of semiconductor development lifecycles and the relationships among architecture, RTL, verification, analog and mixed-signal design, physical design, software, infrastructure, and productization.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain integrated schedules with meaningful dependency and critical-path modeling, including float analysis, milestone confidence, and the downstream effects of schedule changes.
* Experience using engineering evidence such as feature readiness, bug trends, regression results, coverage, design closure, and delivery health to assess schedule risk and drive corrective action.
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex technical and program information, develop practical options, and recommend a course of action.
* Strong communication and influence skills, including the ability to gain cooperation across engineering teams, customers, suppliers, and external partners and to present crisp status and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Experience with project and program management tools and data-driven reporting. Familiarity with Jira, schedule-management tools, dashboards, and engineering lifecycle metrics is preferred.
* Knowledge of quality-management processes and the ability to navigate Linux environments are considered assets.

Who You Are
  
  
This is not a status-reporting role. You will connect a broad set of engineering workstreams into a coherent, dependency-driven plan, identify the real critical path week to week, and drive the cross-functional actions and decisions that keep complex Memory Interface IP projects on track. The work spans concurrent development efforts with significant interdependencies across engineering disciplines, customers, external partners, and development infrastructure.
  
  
Working with general direction, you will apply strong semiconductor-development knowledge and program-management judgment to analyze issues, recommend practical solutions, and gain cooperation across teams. Success requires attention to engineering detail, disciplined follow-through, and the ability to turn complex technical inputs into clear priorities, ownership, and delivery commitments.
  
  
The Team You'll Be Part Of
  
  
Our engineering teams develop advanced Memory Interface IP that enables customers to build high-performance, differentiated SoCs. We work at the intersection of architecture, analog and mixed-signal design, RTL, verification, physical design, software, infrastructure, and customer deployment. The programs are technically complex, globally distributed, and tightly connected to customer and business commitments.
  
  
We value people who combine advanced technical judgment with clear communication, disciplined execution, and the willingness to work through details without losing sight of the broader outcome. In this role, you will help shape how complex semiconductor programs are planned and delivered, strengthen execution practices across teams, and work alongside talented engineers solving consequential problems at scale.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

**Head of US Operational Technology**
=====================================

Every day, we deliver safe and secure energy to homes, communities, and businesses, connecting people to the energy they need for their lives. Our expertise and track record position us uniquely to shape the sustainable future of our industry as the pace of change accelerates. To succeed, we must anticipate customer needs, reduce energy delivery costs, and pioneer flexible energy systems. This requires delivering on our promises and seeking opportunities for growth.

In IT and Digital, we collaborate closely with the diverse energy businesses within the National Grid group, revolutionizing operations through technology. Embracing modern methodologies and digital mindsets, we drive efficiency and bring new capabilities to internal and external customers as we lead the charge toward a carbon-free future.

Our work is critical, as National Grid powers millions of homes and businesses across the UK and US, and the technology we employ is vital to this task. The successful applicant for this position will play a crucial role in our mission, supported by our multicultural, customer-centric global team, with opportunities for professional development.

**National Grid is hiring a Head of US Operational Technology role which operates under a hybrid working model and is open to candidates based at our Waltham, MA, Syracuse, NY, and Brooklyn, NY.**

**This is a hybrid role. Employees are expected to work from their assigned office or another approved work location outside the home at least three days per week. Additional in-person attendance may be required based on role, team, and business needs.**

### **Job Purpose**

The Head of U.S. Operational Technology (OT) is a senior leadership role accountable for the safe, reliable, resilient, secure and supportable operation of the technology environments that underpin real-time electric transmission, electric distribution and gas distribution operations across Massachusetts and New York. The role reports to the VP, Head of IT&D Electric and works in close partnership with Electric and Gas Operations, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Architecture, Regulatory, Capital Delivery and other enterprise technology leaders.

The role leads a multidisciplinary organization responsible for 24x7 operational support and lifecycle stewardship of OT applications and infrastructure. The scope includes Energy Management Systems (EMS), Gas Management System (GMS), Advanced Distribution Management Systems (ADMS), Distributed Energy Resource Management Systems (DERMS), SCADA-related capabilities and the supporting network, compute, storage, database, integration and recovery environments. It also includes designated technology supporting LNG operations, physical security systems, substation controllers and substation access points.

You’ll join an established team, building on its existing strengths to deliver meaningful outcomes. Working collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders, you’ll help shape priorities, improve ways of working, and support the team’s continued development and success.

The Head of OT leads directors responsible for application and infrastructure domains and is a key partner to control center, operations, regulatory and executive stakeholders. The role requires experienced, visible leadership during significant events; disciplined governance; strong technical judgment; and the ability to convert technical risk into clear business decisions.

### **Key Accountabilities**

**Safe, Reliable and Resilient Operations**

* Own the availability, resilience, performance, and recoverability of the OT estate.
* Establish clear 24x7 operational accountability, escalation, and decision-making.
* Lead technology response to major incidents and operational events.
* Maintain and test business continuity, disaster recovery, and recovery capabilities.
* Ensure readiness for storms, grid emergencies, outages, and critical operational events.
* Drive continuous improvement through incident analysis and root-cause elimination.

**Cybersecurity, Safety, Compliance and Risk**

* Ensure readiness and compliance with applicable regulatory and cybersecurity requirements.
* Embed safety, cyber, compliance, and risk considerations into technology decisions.
* Maintain auditable controls, remediation plans, and risk management processes.
* Provide transparent reporting on operational, technology, and compliance risks.
* Support regulatory filings, rate cases, and investment planning.

**Technology Strategy and Lifecycle Stewardship**

* Own OT technology roadmaps aligned to business, regulatory, and investment priorities.
* Proactively manage technology obsolescence and lifecycle risk.
* Drive risk-based management of patching, upgrades, vulnerabilities, capacity, and technical debt.
* Establish standards for integration, automation, observability, and platform management.
* Enable trusted operational data, analytics, and AI capabilities.

**Portfolio Prioritization and Investment Leadership**

* Own OT demand, capacity, and prioritization across operations and capital programs.
* Lead transparent prioritization and resource trade-off decisions.
* Maintain credible operational and capital forecasts.
* Translate technology investments into measurable business outcomes.
* Ensure effective governance, intake, and decision-making processes.

**Enabling Capital Delivery and Operational Acceptance**

* Align OT resources to the highest-priority initiatives.
* Represent operational requirements throughout delivery and implementation.
* Ensure operational readiness before service acceptance.
* Identify and manage cross-program dependencies and risks.
* Enable smooth transition from project delivery to steady-state operations.

**Team Leadership, Capability and Culture**

* Lead and develop senior leaders across OT applications and infrastructure.
* Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Establish role clarity across internal teams, partners, and suppliers.
* Build workforce capability, succession plans, and organizational resilience.
* Ensure teams are trained and prepared to meet operational and compliance obligations.
* Strengthen collaboration across OT, IT&D, Operations, Cybersecurity, Engineering, and Capital Delivery.

**Stakeholder, Executive and Vendor Leadership**

* Build trusted partnerships with operational and business leaders.
* Provide clear, data-driven reporting to executives and governance forums.
* Lead strategic supplier performance, accountability, and risk management.
* Challenge decisions that increase operational risk or reduce delivery credibility.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical operational and technology decisions.

### **Qualifications**

* Senior leadership experience within utility OT, critical infrastructure, or another highly regulated 24x7 operating environment.
* Demonstrated accountability for mission-critical services, operational risk, incident management, and service performance.
* Deep expertise in one or more OT domains (EMS, ADMS, DERMS, GMS, SCADA, OMS) with the ability to lead across a broader technology landscape.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams spanning applications, infrastructure, networks, integration, databases, and operational support.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity, resilience, and regulatory frameworks, including NERC CIP and TSA requirements.
* Proven track record supporting large-scale transformation while maintaining operational stability.
* Experience managing strategic vendors, managed services, and system integrators.
* Strong financial, workforce, and portfolio management capabilities.
* Excellent executive communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent relevant experience.

Title: Vice President of Product
Description:
**Job Summary**:

The Vice President of Product is accountable for the success of Tideworks' product portfolio: product strategy, roadmap priorities, customer adoption, product lifecycle management and the business outcomes delivered through Tideworks' products. The Vice President of Product owns what Tideworks builds and why. Reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer, the Vice President sets product strategy across the marine and intermodal rail portfolios, leads the product management organization  
(value stream managers, product managers, product owners, UX and data science), and runs the roadmap as a commitment to customers.

The role builds on deep product knowledge and long customer relationships and brings the product management discipline a growing software company needs: discovery with customers, design before build, business cases, competitive positioning and pricing. The VP sits on the product and technology leadership team and partners closely with the Chief Revenue Officer, Professional Services and Engineering. The first priority is modernizing the existing product suite while keeping customers successful, with AI, analytics and automation an explicit part of the product strategy.

The ideal candidate will possess deep knowledge of terminal operations and the software that runs them, a track record of building a product management practice, and executive presence with customers, partners and a board.

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

**Product Strategy and Portfolio**  
● Own the product strategy and portfolio across marine and rail: where Tideworks invests, where it holds, and the long-term direction of the product suite  
● Define the product vision with the CPTO and bring it to the executive team and the board with the evidence behind it  
● Own competitive positioning and the market view that informs it  
● Own product investment priorities: propose where roadmap capacity and investment go, with a business case and an expected outcome for each, and report results in adoption, revenue, customer value and operational improvement  
● Identify new market opportunities and adjacent segments for the product suite

**Product Modernization**  
● Lead the modernization of the existing products: evolve the architecture with the CPTO and Engineering, sequence modernization against new capability, and balance innovation with technical debt reduction  
● Keep customers successful through the transition: upgrade paths, compatibility and clear communication of what changes and when

**AI, Analytics and Automation**  
● Make AI, analytics, optimization and automation an explicit part of the product strategy: where they create value in terminal operations, the data foundations they need, and proposals with business cases  
● Partner with Engineering on AI-assisted development so product decisions keep pace with faster delivery

**Product Management Organization**  
● Lead the product management organization: value stream managers, product managers, product owners, UX and data science  
● Set role expectations at each level, coach, hire and develop the team, and propose the structure needed to deliver the strategy  
● Run the product leadership cadence and represent product in company planning

**Product Management Discipline**  
● Establish customer discovery as standard practice, with product managers in front of terminal operators and their teams  
● Require end-to-end design with UX ahead of development, a clear definition of done, and a business case for every significant investment  
● Define the metrics that tell us a release worked and review them after every major release

**Roadmap and Planning**  
● Publish a roadmap cycle customers can plan around, and run customer advisory groups for marine and rail  
● Agree with Engineering the allocation of capacity between roadmap, maintenance and  
customer projects, and hold the line on it  
● Lead product’s part of quarterly planning with the development and quality engineering teams

**Platform and Architecture Partnership**  
● Set platform direction with the CPTO and architecture: extensibility and configurable  
workflows, a consistent API surface across products, and product behaviour that holds together across the suite  
● Put an architecture and design review in front of new capabilities and services

**Commercial Accountability and Partnership**  
● Own competitive positioning and win themes with the Chief Revenue Officer, and support RFP responses and gap analyses  
● Agree scope and packaging with Professional Services for implementations and upgrades  
● Bring pricing and packaging recommendations to the executive team  
● Share accountability with the Chief Revenue Officer for revenue growth, customer retention and expansion, and bring new market opportunities to the executive team

**Strategic Customer and Partner Relationships**  
● Build executive relationships with key customers, global terminal operators and partners  
alongside the Chief Revenue Officer, who owns the commercial relationship; help shape long-term opportunities and bring them into the portfolio

**Product Analytics and Customer Insight**  
● Instrument usage and adoption in the products and maintain a product view of customer  
satisfaction, and measure product success through adoption, revenue, customer value and  
operational improvements  
● Turn customer feedback, support themes and sales findings into prioritized product work

**Qualifications:**  
● Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience  
● 12+ years of enterprise software product management, including 6+ years leading product leaders (managers of product managers)  
● Domain experience in terminal operating systems or the industry around them: marine  
terminals, intermodal rail, port logistics; experience in both marine and rail strongly preferred  
● A track record of building a product management practice (discovery, design, pricing, roadmap) with the artifacts and results to show for it  
● Experience taking a mature, installed enterprise product through a modernization or platform transition while keeping customers successful  
● Executive presence with customers, partners and a board, and experience in a growth-investor environment  
● Technical fluency: APIs, data models, integration (EDI and messaging) and cloud deployment  
● Experience bringing AI, analytics or automation into an enterprise product  
● Executive relationships with terminal operators and industry partners  
● Leads through managers, sets clear expectations, decides on evidence, and has led teams across time zones  
● Preferred: Class 1 railroad or intermodal operations experience; configurable or low-code  
workflow products; Spanish; product investment or P&L ownership

Title: Technical Account Manager, Federal

**Hypori, Inc.** is a high-growth cybersecurity SaaS company transforming how organizations think about secure mobility. Backed by $55M in funding from investors including UBS, AE Industrial Partners, Hale Capital Partners, and GreatPoint Ventures, Hypori is expanding into new commercial and regulated markets. **Overview**

Hypori is a high-growth cybersecurity SaaS company transforming secure mobility. Our virtual workspace platform gives users access to enterprise apps and data from any mobile device, with zero data on the endpoint and total personal privacy. Backed by $55M from investors including UBS, AE Industrial Partners, Hale Capital Partners, and GreatPoint Ventures, we are expanding into new commercial and regulated markets.

  

Hypori is looking for a hands-on, customer-obsessed Technical Account Manager focused on our federal accounts to join our Customer Success team. You will partner closely with Customer Success Managers, Sales Engineering, Product, Engineering, and Support, Sales, and report to the SVP of Customer Success.

  

Hypori is proven at scale. More than 95,000 Department of War users are on the platform today, the Army runs BYOD on it, and we hold IL5, FedRAMP High, NIAP Common Criteria, NSA CSfC, and CMMC 2.0 Level 2. As we grow into financial services, healthcare, and the Defense Industrial Base, the person in this seat makes sure every customer environment is configured right, fully adopted, and ready to expand.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary technical point of contact and trusted advisor for an assigned portfolio of commercial and federal customers

* Guide customers through deployment, configuration, and onboarding across cloud, on-prem, and hybrid environments

* Advise on identity and access integration, including SSO, SAML, PIV/CAC, and directory services, along with app delivery, device policies, and network configuration

* Own technical escalations, working with Support, Engineering, and Product to drive issues to resolution and keep customers informed throughout

* Lead technical check-ins, platform health reviews, and the technical portion of QBRs alongside the Customer Success Manager

* Monitor usage and environment health to spot risk early, and recommend optimizations that drive adoption

* Provide the configuration evidence and documentation security officers need for ATO, accreditation, and compliance reviews

* Plan and coordinate upgrades and new releases within each customer's change control process

* Train customer administrators and systems integrator staff so their teams become self-sufficient

* Bring customer feature requests and technical feedback to Product and Engineering, and advocate for what customers need

* Identify expansion opportunities and support renewals with Customer Success and Sales

* Build reusable assets such as runbooks, deployment guides, and knowledge base articles

  

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years in technical account management, solutions engineering, or a similar post-sale technical role in B2B SaaS or cybersecurity

* Hands-on experience with enterprise IT and security, including identity and access management (SSO, SAML, MFA), networking, and Linux or Windows administration

* Experience deploying or supporting cloud-based solutions on AWS, Azure, or government cloud environments

* Track record of managing escalations across a portfolio of enterprise or government accounts

* Able to explain technical topics clearly to administrators, security teams, and executives

* Proficiency with Salesforce, Jira, and Confluence

* Authorized to work in the United States without visa sponsorship

  

* Location: remote or hybrid with travel up to 20% percent to customer sites

  

* Required active Secret clearance with ability to get TS

  

**Who You Are**

* **Speed:** You move with urgency and get things done today, not next week

* **Focus:** You spend your time on the issues and accounts that matter most to customer outcomes

* **Extreme ownership:** Your customers, your environments, your escalations. No excuses

* **Accountability:** You do what you say, when you say. You flag risks early, to your team and your customer

* **Coachability:** You ask for feedback, act on it, and get better

* **Humility:** You know what you don't know, and you say so

* **Creativity:** You find new ways to solve technical problems and keep customers successful

  

**Preferred Attributes**

* Experience supporting the Department of War, Intelligence Community, or federal civilian agencies

* Familiarity with FedRAMP, NIST SP 800-53, DISA STIGs, DoD Zero Trust, or CMMC

* Experience with mobile, BYOD, VDI, MDM (such as Intune or Workspace ONE), or zero trust deployments

* Security or cloud certifications such as Security+, CISSP, AWS, or Azure

* Experience at a high-growth SaaS company

  

**About Us**

Compensation: $130,000 – $160,000 base salary (commensurate with experience), 10% annual performance bonus.

**About Us**

Hypori Inc. provides a generous benefits package for full-time employees that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, parental leave, and life and disability packages. We also invest in our employees' futures by providing a 401(k) plan with employer-matching contributions that vest starting from your first day of employment. **In addition to the base compensation, Hypori also offers a performance bonus, which is primarily contingent upon company-wide performance.** We are dedicated to investing in the tools and skills required to be strong, collaborative colleagues and people managers to help build and retain a strong workforce.

Title: Manager, Educational Technology
Description:
Reporting to the Director, Academic Quality and Teaching Innovation, the Manager, Educational Technology provides leadership and oversight vis-à-vis the SLATE (Sheridan's Teaching and Learning Environment) environment as well as broader educational technology strategy.

The incumbent is accountable for all operational aspects of SLATE, which operates for all Sheridan users on a continuous 24x7x365 basis. In this capacity the incumbent provides leadership for the administration, design, development, training, and support functions associated with SLATE as well as other integrated learning technologies, e-learning and digital innovation. This includes any internal integrations to Sheridan's infrastructure including but not limited to student information systems (SIS), HR systems, authentication services and other leveraged systems.

This position collaborates pan-institutionally to engage a wide range of key partners at Sheridan, i.e. Academic Division, IT, OTR, as it relates to planning, strategy, and operationalization of educational technologies, including but not limited to SLATE. The position engages and contributes to provincial and sector educational technology bodies. Further, the role is a key interface with educational technology vendors to ensure the provisioned tools are meeting the broader educational and pedagogical needs of the Sheridan teaching and learning community.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Managing system administration for SLATE and associated learning technologies, leading teams to improve the experience of faculty, students, and employees.
* Plans and assesses upgrades, patches, and pilots of new features; oversees the e-learning design and digital innovation teams; and advises the Director on the development and review of programs and services.
* Evaluating emerging technologies and, with the Director, builds business cases for adopting them, while managing the life cycle of learning technologies from onboarding to retirement.
* Managing major cross-College projects, supports budget and strategic planning, maintains policies, documentation, and usage statistics, and is accountable for timely, accurate communications.
* Managing vendor, sector, and internal partnerships through negotiating contracts, master agreements, SLAs, and End User License Agreements (EULA)s for all contracted services, including cloud-based services, and administers breach procedures such as responses to service disruptions.
* Maintaining relationships with account managers and other vendor representatives, stays apprised of product and service roadmaps, and leads vendor crisis management when service is disrupted or degraded.
* Providing leadership, strategic direction, and supervision to SLATE staff and other digital learning teams, ensuring adequate coverage, prompt response to user support requests, and proper escalation of issues to internal resources or vendors, with all issues documented and tracked to resolution.
* Hiring, supervising, coaching, and managing staff performance in compliance with the Collective Agreement, keeps certifications and training current, and recommends professional development aligned with Sheridan’s strategic vision, while fostering a safe, respectful, and inclusive work environment.
* Accountable for resource stewardship and compliance with Sheridan policies, legislation, and agreements, including Health and Safety, Human Rights, AODA, Acceptable Use, and WHMIS, as well as the secure management of records and confidential information under Sheridan’s Records and Information Management Policy.
* Ensuring the delivery of standard and ad hoc instructions and information on the use of learning technologies, including SLATE procedures, and prepares reports and presentations on SLATE, pilot projects, and other educational technologies for decision-making groups.
* Serves on committees and cross-organizational teams that need expertise in teaching and learning technology or input on SLATE implementation for other Sheridan initiatives, and represents the portfolio’s interests on institutional working groups such as legal, privacy, and web governance.
* Leads project teams, analyzing requirements, developing plans, scheduling resources, and tracking and reporting on deliverables to senior leadership.
* Performing additional responsibilities, projects and initiatives, as required.

You are deeply committed to **academic excellence and student success** and are passionate about creating high-quality learning experiences that prepare students to thrive in their studies, careers and communities.

You are an **exceptional communicator** with strong verbal, written and **presentation skills**, and can communicate complex ideas clearly and effectively with a variety of audiences.

You are a **collaborative and inclusive leader** with exceptional **relationship-building and interpersonal skills**. You inspire trust, engage others and build strong relationships that enable teams and individuals to succeed.

You have strong **organizational and managerial skills** and the ability to **multi-task, prioritize and manage multiple complex and competing demands**, while maintaining focus on broader strategic and operational priorities.

You exercise sound **judgement**, and your strong **problem-solving and conflict resolution skills**, coupled with your openness to new ways of thinking, allow you to navigate complex challenges and develop creative solutions that advance organizational goals.

You demonstrate a strong understanding of **cultural diversity** and the varied experiences and needs of diverse populations and are committed to creating learning and working environments where individuals feel **welcomed, respected and supported**.

You demonstrate a strong commitment to **equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging** and to fostering an educational and employment environment that removes barriers and creates equitable opportunities for individuals to participate, contribute and succeed.

**The ideal candidate will also possess the following qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in educational technology, online learning, education or related field;
* 7 years of experience as a senior practitioner, technical advisor, consultant or supervisor with progressive experience in learning and educational technologies (software and hardware) (equivalencies to be considered)
* Operational knowledge of IT infrastructure which interface with learning and educational technologies
* Familiarity with cloud-based computing, enterprise applications and vendor management

Title: Senior Portfolio & Program Manager, Operational Technology & Controls
Description:
**Who are we?**
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
  
  
A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
  
  
A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Senior Portfolio & Program Manager, Operational Technology & Controls is responsible for the integrated portfolio of Operational Technology & Engineering (OT&E) initiatives across controls, central monitoring, OT infrastructure, cybersecurity, data, and automation, ensuring programs are sequenced, governed, funded, and transitioned to operations as one connected roadmap rather than as separate projects.
  
  
This role combines disciplined portfolio and program management with proven, hands-on expertise in industrial controls and operational technology, including how controls systems integrate across critical facilities. It does not replace technical owners: engineering owns design, architecture, and engineering acceptance, while this role owns portfolio governance, integration, and transition to operations, and recommends sequencing, funding, and prioritization decisions to leadership. This position collaborates with engineering, operations, cybersecurity, IT, network, architecture, finance, procurement, vendors, system integrators, and regional teams across Global Operations Excellence to deliver key initiatives such as GMCC and central SCADA, and to strengthen the reliability, security, and supportability of Equinix’s critical facilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Maintain a single, current view of all OT&E initiatives, including scope, funding, dependencies, risk, and expected value
* Run intake, scoring, and prioritization of new work against strategy, architectural standards, and capacity
* Lead quarterly and annual planning, roadmap development, and investment cases, partnering with Finance on forecasting and variance reporting
* Lead multi-team programs end to end, including integrated plans, critical paths, and phased global rollouts to site teams
* Define and enforce stage gates and readiness criteria (design, security review, pilot, production)
* Ensure programs conform to approved architecture and engineering standards, working closely with architecture and review boards
* Run program governance, including steering committees, status cadences, RAID logs, and decision records
* Creates clarity from complexity by turning strategy, competing priorities, and incomplete information into an executable roadmap
* Balances pace, cost, technical quality, cybersecurity, and long-term supportability in program decisions
* Translate technical detail into executive-ready narratives, dashboards, and decision requests
* Manage vendor and integrator engagements, including SOWs, deliverables, and performance
* Track benefits realization and report whether delivered programs achieved their intended outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* Typically, 10+ years in program or portfolio management, including 5+ years leading complex technical programs
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, technology, or a related field is desired.
* Nice to Have: PMP or PMI certification, P.Eng., Lean, or Agile certification; ITIL Foundation or ServiceNow experience
* Experience managing concurrent programs with shared dependencies and constrained resources
* Proven, hands-on expertise in industrial controls and operational technology within data centre or critical facilities environments
* Brings solid controls and OT expertise to engage engineers as a credible peer, challenge plans, and recognize material technical dependencies, while respecting engineering as the technical authority
* Technical knowledge of Building Management Systems (BMS), power monitoring, SCADA, telemetry, and OT/IT network segmentation, including how these systems integrate, sufficient to challenge estimates and technical plans and spot risk
* Strong financial acumen, including budget ownership and business case development
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive decisions without direct authority
* Experience with both stage-gate and agile delivery approaches
* Excellent facilitation, negotiation, written communication, and executive presentation skills, able to influence in a global, matrixed environment without direct authority

Title: Director of Information Technology

The Director of Information Technology leads the Firm’s day-to-day end-user technology operations and is accountable for delivering a secure, reliable, and service-focused technology experience to attorneys, business professionals, and clients. Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, the Director oversees end-user computing, the Service Desk, onsite and remote technical support, and conference room audio visual technology, document management, IT project management, legal and business application integration, and endpoint asset and vendor management. The Director partners with Information Security, Innovation, Technology Engineering & Operations, and practice leadership to evaluate and adopt technologies, including AI, that improve client service and firm efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Leadership and Strategy**

* Partners with the Chief Information Officer and the senior IT leadership team to develop and execute the Firm’s IT strategy, multi-year technology roadmap, and annual operating and capital budgets, aligned with Firm priorities.

**Service Delivery and End-User Experience**

* Ensures reliable conference room, hybrid meeting, and trial and courtroom technology support.
* Oversees technology onboarding and offboarding for new hires and lateral partners, and ensures effective end-user training and documentation.

**Legal and Business Applications**

* Oversees support, integration, and optimization of core legal platforms, including document management (e.g., iManage or NetDocuments), financial and practice management (e.g., Aderant or 3E), time entry, conflicts and intake (e.g., Intapp), CRM (e.g., InterAction), e-billing, and litigation support tools.

**AI and Innovation**

**Cybersecurity, Risk, and Compliance**

* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive IT experience, including 5+ years in an IT leadership role managing managers and technical teams.
* Law firm or professional services experience strongly preferred (Am Law 200 preferred).
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, Azure, Intune, and enterprise networking.
* Experience supporting legal applications such as document management, financial and practice management, and conflicts and intake systems.
* Proven track record leading enterprise technology projects (e.g., cloud migration, endpoint modernization, application upgrades).
* Experience managing IT budgets, vendor contracts, and IT asset management.
* Experience supporting client security audits and security and compliance frameworks.
* Executive presence and the ability to build trusted relationships with partners and Firm leadership.
* Strong service orientation and commitment to excellence.
* Working knowledge of generative AI tools, their risks, and practical uses in a law firm.
* Sound understanding of cybersecurity principles and controls.
* Excellent project management, organizational, and prioritization skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical topics to non-technical audiences.
* Strong negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage conflict and maintain a positive, high-performance team environment.
* Ability to work under pressure, meet tight deadlines, and handle competing priorities.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

Under the direction of the General Manager and Account Executive and in close partnership with the Strategic Account Managers, the Managing Director, Services is responsible for accelerating services growth across the FSG client base. This leader identifies, shapes, and advances consulting-led opportunities spanning Management Consulting and IT Services, including managed services and capabilities across Security, Data and Analytics, Cloud, Networking, Infrastructure, and adjacent technology domains. The role brings a management consulting approach to client discovery, executive alignment, solution development, pursuit leadership, and commercial strategy, connecting client business priorities to measurable outcomes and executable services engagements. This is a services sales leadership role, not an account ownership or day-to-day delivery management position. Account Executive and Strategic Account Managers retain account ownership, while this role leads the services strategy and selling motion in partnership with them.

**Services Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth**

* Develop and execute account-level services growth strategies in partnership with the General Manager, Account Executives, and Strategic Account Managers.

* Identify, qualify, shape, and advance Management Consulting and IT Services opportunities within existing clients and selected prospects.

* Create demand by connecting client business priorities, operational challenges, risk exposure, and transformation goals to relevant consulting and technology services.

* Lead complex, multi-workstream services pursuits from early discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.

* Build, maintain, and forecast a qualified services pipeline with clear next steps, decision criteria, competitive positioning, and close plans.

* Meet or exceed assigned bookings, revenue, gross profit, and pipeline objectives.

**Executive Client Engagement & Consultative Selling**

* Build trusted relationships with senior business and technology leaders, including C-suite executives, transformation leaders, security leaders, data leaders, infrastructure leaders, and procurement stakeholders.

* Lead executive discovery sessions and working meetings to clarify business problems, desired outcomes, priorities, constraints, and investment rationale.

* Use hypothesis-driven, outcome-oriented consulting techniques to frame opportunities and build consensus across business and technology stakeholders.

* Translate complex client needs into clear problem statements, value propositions, roadmaps, and services recommendations.

* Position Trace3 as a long-term advisory and services partner rather than a transactional technology provider.

**Management Consulting & IT Services Portfolio Leadership**

* Drive sales across Management Consulting offerings such as strategy, operating model, organizational change, program leadership, maturity assessments, roadmaps, governance, and transformation planning.

* Drive sales across IT Services, including managed services and project-based services in Security, Data and Analytics, Cloud, Networking, Infrastructure, and related technology domains.

* Partner with consulting, managed services, engineering, architecture, delivery, and domain leaders to assemble integrated solutions across multiple practices.

* Identify opportunities to expand from advisory work into implementation and managed services, and from technical engagements into broader consulting relationships.

* Maintain sufficient knowledge of the services portfolio, delivery models, commercial constructs, and relevant partner capabilities to credibly lead executive sales conversations.

**Pursuit Leadership, Solution Development & Commercial Strategy**

* Orchestrate pursuit teams, establish win strategy, define roles, and maintain momentum across complex sales cycles.

* Lead the development of proposals, statements of work, presentations, business cases, and executive-level recommendations in collaboration with solution and delivery leaders.

* Ensure proposed scope, assumptions, outcomes, staffing model, pricing, timeline, and delivery approach are aligned before client commitment.

* Partner with account leadership, legal, finance, operations, and delivery teams on pricing, risk review, contracting, and negotiation.

* Conduct effective handoffs to delivery leadership while preserving client context, intended outcomes, commercial commitments, and expansion opportunities.

**Account Planning & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Embed a services strategy into priority account plans, including whitespace analysis, stakeholder mapping, relationship development, and pursuit sequencing.

* Partner with Account Executives and Strategic Account Managers to coordinate client messaging, coverage, opportunity ownership, and executive engagement.

* Collaborate with marketing and practice leaders on campaigns, events, thought leadership, and market-facing programs that generate services demand.

* Engage strategic technology and services partners when their capabilities strengthen the client solution and improve the probability of winning.

* Escalate commercial, resourcing, solution, or delivery risks early and drive cross-functional resolution.

**Performance Management & Business Reporting**

* Maintain accurate opportunity data, pipeline stages, forecasts, activity, and pursuit plans in the company CRM and related operating tools.

* Report services pipeline, bookings, revenue outlook, pursuit health, conversion rates, and account penetration to leadership.

* Use win/loss analysis, client feedback, delivery outcomes, and market intelligence to improve positioning and sales execution.

* Provide visibility into capability gaps, investment needs, competitive threats, and emerging client demand.

* Services Strategy, Opportunity Identification & Account Planning (25%)

* Executive Client Engagement & Consultative Discovery (25%)

* Pursuit Leadership, Solution Development & Commercial Strategy (25%)

* Pipeline Management, Forecasting & Performance Reporting (15%)

* Cross-Functional, Practice & Partner Collaboration (10%)

**REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, technology, engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

* 10+ years of experience in management consulting, technology consulting, professional services, managed services, or complex B2B services sales.

* Demonstrated success leading consulting or technology-services selling efforts, including executive discovery, opportunity shaping, proposal development, commercial negotiation, and closing.

* Experience in a management consulting environment or consulting-led services organization, with direct responsibility for originating or expanding client engagements strongly preferred.

* Proven ability to sell multi-disciplinary services across two or more of the following areas: Management Consulting, Managed Services, Security, Data and Analytics, Cloud, Networking, and Infrastructure.

* Experience partnering with account executives or client partners in a matrixed account model, with clear role alignment and shared revenue objectives.

* Strong executive presence and ability to communicate business value, financial impact, operating risk, and transformation outcomes to senior stakeholders.

* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including business-case development, pricing, margin, utilization, contract risk, and services delivery economics.

Title: Senior Program Manager, Strategy and Expansion, MEATR DSP Strategy, Planning and Expansion
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Customers want what they need in minutes, not days. Join Amazon's Last Mile team in the Middle East, Africa and Turkey to shape how our fastest delivery services, including Amazon Now and Amazon Rush, grow and run for customers, delivery associates, Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) and Amazon.  
  
As Senior Program Manager, you will own and lead the strategic programmes that set how our Speed last mile network runs across the region. At the core is flexible capacity: designing models that let DSP capacity move up and down with demand, setting how they fit into annual and weekly planning, and getting Operations, Finance, People teams and DSP partners behind them. Your portfolio may also cover partner commercials, compliance and training, and it will change as priorities change.  
  
Many problems won't arrive well defined. You will frame them, find the ones worth solving, align senior stakeholders on a path forward and build mechanisms that make the answers scale across countries. You will also help shape the team's wider strategy and roadmap.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Set the strategy: own the multi-year capacity and growth plan for Quick Commerce and Speed, and the region's input to annual planning.
* Plan capacity: within the regional plan, build short, mid and long range plans that match DSP and delivery associate supply to demand by hour, day and season.
* Build flexible capacity: design, launch and scale flexible models alongside the fixed DSP network, with the operating, commercial and compliance framework to run them.
* Grow the channel: launch new cities, stores and countries with capacity ready before go-live.
* Improve efficiency: raise utilisation and lower cost per delivery without moving cost onto DSPs or associates.
* Build partner economics: shape DSP commercial models with Finance that work at every volume level, and lead the trade-off decisions.
* Look after delivery associates: design fair, safe, compliant schedules and lead the regional response to labour rule changes.
* Align and lead change: bring Operations, Finance, People, Legal, Tech and DSPs behind one plan, and run readiness and approvals.
* Build mechanisms: set planning tool requirements with Tech, and the metrics, guardrails and reviews that run the channel, using automation and AI.
* Lead and write: influence senior leaders, mentor PMs and analysts, and write documents that drive decisions.

  
A day in the life  
You start with yesterday's Quick Commerce and Speed performance: where capacity matched demand, where routes ran short or associates sat idle, and what it cost. Mid-morning, you join the weekly planning review to agree where flexible capacity steps in next week. You then meet a DSP owner to test a new flexible model against their margin and their associates' hours. After lunch, you work with Finance and Legal on the case for scaling it to a second country. You end the day writing for senior leaders: what the pilot showed, what you recommend and what you need from them.  
  
About the team  
This is a new role reporting to the Senior Manager, Strategy and Expansion, MEATr DSP. Quick Commerce and Speed, including Amazon Now and Amazon Rush, are delivered by DSPs, and flexible capacity is a lead theme in the region's 2027 plan. You will own Speed capacity and flexible capacity programmes across the region, planning inside the regional capacity plan and working with the Network Optimisation team, who own rate cards. You will mentor PMs and analysts and write planning papers reviewed at Director and VP level.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

Toronto Parks and Recreation delivers services and spaces that enhance the quality of life for millions of residents. From neighbourhood parks and sports fields to trails, horticultural displays and public gathering spaces, Toronto's parks system is fundamental to creating vibrant, healthy and connected communities.

  

The City of Toronto is seeking a strategic and accomplished leader to serve as Senior Director, Parks Operations.

  

Reporting to the General Manager, Parks and Recreation, the Senior Director provides executive leadership for a broad and highly visible parks operations portfolio responsible for the maintenance, stewardship, safety and operational readiness of parks, facilities and public spaces across Toronto. Leading one of the division's largest operational teams, this role ensures residents experience clean, safe, accessible and well-maintained parks every day.

  

Leading through a team of Directors and multidisciplinary professionals, you will oversee complex operations delivered across diverse geographies, service areas and workforce groups. You will ensure resources, workforce capacity and service delivery models remain aligned with community needs while fostering a culture grounded in accountability, safety, service excellence and innovation.

  

A defining priority of this role is ensuring operational excellence is embedded across one of the largest municipal parks systems in North America. You will champion a culture of performance, responsiveness and continuous improvement, ensuring services are delivered consistently, public assets are stewarded effectively, and residents receive a high-quality experience across Toronto's parks and public spaces. Through strong leadership, clear accountability and a commitment to excellence, you will strengthen organizational performance and build public confidence in the services Parks Operations delivers every day.

  

Success in this role requires exceptional political acuity, sound judgment and strong relationship management skills. You will regularly engage with elected officials, bargaining agents, community partners, residents and stakeholder groups to resolve complex issues, respond to emerging concerns and maintain public confidence in the delivery of parks services across Toronto.

  

### **What You Bring to the Role:**

* Post-secondary education in Parks Management, Environmental Services, Engineering or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

* Extensive senior leadership experience overseeing large-scale operations, maintenance, facilities, public works, parks or service delivery portfolios within a complex organization.

* Significant experience leading large operational teams and diverse workforces in a unionized environment, including workforce planning, labour relations and organizational effectiveness initiatives.

* Demonstrated expertise in operational governance, maintenance management, service standards, quality assurance, performance management and continuous improvement.

* Experience managing significant operating budgets and aligning resources, workforce strategies and service priorities to achieve organizational objectives.

* Proven ability to lead senior managers and multidisciplinary teams while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, safety and service excellence.

* Experience building productive relationships with bargaining agents, community partners, residents and external stakeholders in support of service excellence and organizational goals.

SKF drives the industries that support our way of life, powers the machines that put food on the table, and even helps explore the cosmos.

We’re a company committed to a culture of belonging, where all our people are encouraged to be themselves and grow their careers in an equitable environment.

Learn about SKF at www.skf.com.
